4.143.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
mahāśāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi mahādevena bhāṣitām..
pārthivānāṃ hitārthāya mahādustaratāriṇīm.. 1 ..
4.143.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
महाशांतिं प्रवक्ष्यामि महादेवेन भाषिताम्॥
पार्थिवानां हितार्थाय महादुस्तरतारिणीम्॥ 1 ॥
4.143.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / I shall declare the Great Pacification spoken by Mahādeva, / for the welfare of earthly rulers, which delivers from great difficulties.

4.143.s:
nṛpābhiṣeke sā kāryā yātrākāle nṛpasya tu ..
duḥsvapne durnimitte ca grahavaiguṇyasaṃbhave .. .. 2 ..
4.143.d:
नृपाभिषेके सा कार्या यात्राकाले नृपस्य तु ॥
दुःस्वप्ने दुर्निमित्ते च ग्रहवैगुण्यसंभवे ॥ ॥ 2 ॥
4.143.m: It should be performed at the coronation of a king, or at the time of a king's military march, / upon bad dreams, ill omens, and the occurrence of planetary adversity,

4.143.s:
vidyudulkānipāte ca janmarkṣe grahadaivate ..
ketūdaye'tha saṃjāte nirghāte kṣitikampane .. 3 ..
4.143.d:
विद्युदुल्कानिपाते च जन्मर्क्षे ग्रहदैवते ॥
केतूदयेऽथ संजाते निर्घाते क्षितिकम्पने ॥ 3 ॥
4.143.m: at the falling of lightning and meteors, when a malignant planet presides over the birth star, / when a comet appears, at an earthquake, or at a thunder-crash,

4.143.s:
prasūtau mūlagaṇḍānte yamalasya tu saṃbhave ..
chatrāṇāṃ ca dhvajānāṃ ca svasthānātpatane bhuvi ..
kākolūkakapotānāṃ praveśe veśmanastathā .. 4 ..
4.143.d:
प्रसूतौ मूलगण्डान्ते यमलस्य तु संभवे ॥
छत्राणां च ध्वजानां च स्वस्थानात्पतने भुवि ॥
काकोलूककपोतानां प्रवेशे वेश्मनस्तथा ॥ 4 ॥
4.143.m: at childbirth occurring at the end of Mūla or in a gaṇḍānta, at the birth of twins, / when royal parasols and banners fall from their place to the ground, / and when crows, owls, or pigeons enter the house.

4.143.s:
krūragrahāṇāṃ vakratve janmādiṣu viśeṣataḥ ..
janmani dvādaśe caiva caturthe vāṣṭame tathā .. 5 ..
4.143.d:
क्रूरग्रहाणां वक्रत्वे जन्मादिषु विशेषतः ॥
जन्मनि द्वादशे चैव चतुर्थे वाष्टमे तथा ॥ 5 ॥
4.143.m: When malefic planets turn retrograde, especially in the natal [sign] and others, / or in the natal [sign], the twelfth, the fourth, or likewise the eighth,

4.143.s:
yadā syurgurumandā''rāḥ sūryaścaiva viśeṣataḥ ..
yuddhe grahāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ sūryaśītāṃśukīlake .. 6 ..
4.143.d:
यदा स्युर्गुरुमन्दा'ऽराः सूर्यश्चैव विशेषतः ॥
युद्धे ग्रहाणां सर्वेषां सूर्यशीतांशुकीलके ॥ 6 ॥
4.143.m: when Jupiter, Saturn, Mars, and especially the Sun are [so placed], / at the planetary war of all planets, or at solar and lunar meteoric apparitions,

4.143.s:
vastrāyudhagavāśveṣu maṇikeśavināśane ..
yadyagre paridṛśyeta rātrāviṃdradhanustathā .. 7 ..
4.143.d:
वस्त्रायुधगवाश्वेषु मणिकेशविनाशने ॥
यद्यग्रे परिदृश्येत रात्राविंद्रधनुस्तथा ॥ 7 ॥
4.143.m: at the destruction of clothes, weapons, cattle, horses, gems, or hair, / if a rainbow is seen in front at night,

4.143.s:
veśmanaśca tulābhaṃge garbheṣvaśvatarīṣu ca..
ravīndvoruparāgeṣu mahāśāṃtiḥ praśasyate .. 8 ..
4.143.d:
वेश्मनश्च तुलाभंगे गर्भेष्वश्वतरीषु च॥
रवीन्द्वोरुपरागेषु महाशांतिः प्रशस्यते ॥ 8 ॥
4.143.m: at the breaking of the balance-beam of a house, in the wombs of she-mules, / and at eclipses of the sun and moon, the Great Pacification (Mahāśānti) is praised.

4.143.s:
sarvāṇi durnimittāni praśamaṃ yānti sarvathā ..
tāṃ kuryurbrāhmaṇāḥ paṃca kulaśīlasamanvitāḥ .. 9 ..
4.143.d:
सर्वाणि दुर्निमित्तानि प्रशमं यान्ति सर्वथा ॥
तां कुर्युर्ब्राह्मणाः पंच कुलशीलसमन्विताः ॥ 9 ॥
4.143.m: All evil portents are completely pacified. / Five brāhmaṇas endowed with noble lineage and conduct should perform it,

4.143.s:
caturvedāstrivedāśca dvivedāścāpi pāṃḍava ..
ātharvaṇā viśeṣeṇa bahvṛcā yajusaṃyutāḥ .. 4.143.10 ..
4.143.d:
चतुर्वेदास्त्रिवेदाश्च द्विवेदाश्चापि पांडव ॥
आथर्वणा विशेषेण बह्वृचा यजुसंयुताः ॥ 4.143.10 ॥
4.143.m: who know four Vedas, three Vedas, or even two Vedas, O Pāṇḍava, / especially knowers of the Atharvaveda, and knowers of the Ṛgveda together with the Yajurveda,

4.143.s:
śucayaḥ śrutasaṃpannā japahomaparāyaṇāḥ ..
kṛcchrapārākanaktādyaiḥ kṛtakāya viśodhanāḥ .. 11 ..
4.143.d:
शुचयः श्रुतसंपन्ना जपहोमपरायणाः ॥
कृच्छ्रपाराकनक्ताद्यैः कृतकाय विशोधनाः ॥ 11 ॥
4.143.m: pure, accomplished in Vedic learning, devoted to recitation and oblations, / their bodies purified by kṛcchra, pārāka, nocturnal meals, and the like.

4.143.s:
pūrvamārādhya maṃtraistu prārabheta kriyāṃ tataḥ ..
daśadvādaśahastaṃ vā maṃḍapaṃ kārayecchubham .. 12 ..
4.143.d:
पूर्वमाराध्य मंत्रैस्तु प्रारभेत क्रियां ततः ॥
दशद्वादशहस्तं वा मंडपं कारयेच्छुभम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.143.m: First worshipping with mantras, one should then begin the rite: / one should have an auspicious pavilion made, ten or twelve cubits [wide].

4.143.s:
tanmadhye vedikāṃ kuryāccaturhasta pramāṇataḥ ..
āgneyyāṃ kārayetkuṃḍaṃ hastamātraṃ suśobhanam .. 13 ..
4.143.d:
तन्मध्ये वेदिकां कुर्याच्चतुर्हस्त प्रमाणतः ॥
आग्नेय्यां कारयेत्कुंडं हस्तमात्रं सुशोभनम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.143.m: In its middle one should make an altar measuring four cubits. / In the south-east one should have a very beautiful sacrificial pit made, measuring just a cubit,

4.143.s:
mekhalātrayasaṃyuktaṃ yonyā cāpi vibhūṣitam ..
baddhacandanamālaṃ ca toraṇālaṃkṛtaṃ tathā .. 14 ..
4.143.d:
मेखलात्रयसंयुक्तं योन्या चापि विभूषितम् ॥
बद्धचन्दनमालं च तोरणालंकृतं तथा ॥ 14 ॥
4.143.m: furnished with three stepped tiers (mekhalā) and adorned with a vulva-shaped hearth-edge (yoni), / strung with garlands of sandalwood and adorned with arches.

4.143.s:
gomayenopalipte ca maṃḍape tu dvijātayaḥ ..
śuklāmbaradharaḥ snātāḥ śuklamālyānulepanāḥ .. 15 ..
4.143.d:
गोमयेनोपलिप्ते च मंडपे तु द्विजातयः ॥
शुक्लाम्बरधरः स्नाताः शुक्लमाल्यानुलेपनाः ॥ 15 ॥
4.143.m: In the pavilion smeared with cow dung, the twice-born, / wearing white garments, bathed, wearing white garlands and unguents,

4.143.s:
tataśca pañca kalaśāṃstasyāṃ vedyāṃ niyojayet ..
āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu pañcamaṃ madhyatastathā .. 16 ..
4.143.d:
ततश्च पञ्च कलशांस्तस्यां वेद्यां नियोजयेत् ॥
आग्नेयादिषु कोणेषु पञ्चमं मध्यतस्तथा ॥ 16 ॥
4.143.m: should then place five water jars upon that altar: / in the corners beginning with the south-east, and likewise a fifth in the center.

4.143.s:
aṣṭāsrālaṃkṛte padme cūtapallavaśobhite ..
brahmakūrcavidhānena paṃcagavyaṃ tu kārayet .. 17 ..
4.143.d:
अष्टास्रालंकृते पद्मे चूतपल्लवशोभिते ॥
ब्रह्मकूर्चविधानेन पंचगव्यं तु कारयेत् ॥ 17 ॥
4.143.m: On an eight-petalled lotus adorned with mango sprouts, / one should prepare the five products of the cow (pañcagavya) according to the rule of the brahmakūrca.

4.143.s:
auṣadhīḥ pañcaratnāni rocanāṃ candanaṃ tathā ..
siddhārthakāñchamīdūrvāḥ kuśānvrīhiryavāṃstathā .. 18 ..
4.143.d:
औषधीः पञ्चरत्नानि रोचनां चन्दनं तथा ॥
सिद्धार्थकाञ्छमीदूर्वाः कुशान्व्रीहिर्यवांस्तथा ॥ 18 ॥
4.143.m: Medicinal herbs, five jewels, yellow pigment (rocanā), and sandalwood, / white mustard, śamī leaves, dūrvā grass, kuśa grass, and rice and barley,

4.143.s:
apāmārgaṃ phalavatīṃ nyagrodhoduṃbarau tathā ..
plakṣāśvatthakapitthāṃśca priyaṃgucūtapallavān .. 19 ..
4.143.d:
अपामार्गं फलवतीं न्यग्रोधोदुंबरौ तथा ॥
प्लक्षाश्वत्थकपित्थांश्च प्रियंगुचूतपल्लवान् ॥ 19 ॥
4.143.m: apāmārga, fruit-bearing plants, and the nyagrodha and udumbara trees, / and shoots of plakṣa, aśvattha, kapittha, priyaṅgu, and mango,

4.143.s:
hastidaṃtamṛdaṃ caiva koṇakumbheṣu nikṣipet ..
puṇyatīrthodakānnaṃ ca dhānyaṃ gavyaṃ ca madhyame .. 4.143.20 ..
4.143.d:
हस्तिदंतमृदं चैव कोणकुम्भेषु निक्षिपेत् ॥
पुण्यतीर्थोदकान्नं च धान्यं गव्यं च मध्यमे ॥ 4.143.20 ॥
4.143.m: and earth from elephant tusks—these one should place into the corner jars; / and holy water from sacred fords, food, grain, and cow products into the central one.

4.143.s:
kūrcaṃ vācamitīdaṃ ca vahnikumbhābhimantraṇam ..
āśuḥ śiśāno mantreṇa mantraṇaṃ vāyugocare.. .. 21 ..
4.143.d:
कूर्चं वाचमितीदं च वह्निकुम्भाभिमन्त्रणम् ॥
आशुः शिशानो मन्त्रेण मन्त्रणं वायुगोचरे॥ ॥ 21 ॥
4.143.m: The mantra "kūrcaṃ vācam..." is for consecrating the jar of the fire-god; / with the mantra "āśuḥ śiśānaḥ...", the consecration [is done] for the [jar] in the realm of Vāyu;

4.143.s:
īśāvāsyaṃ caturthasya kumbhasya cābhimaṃtraṇam ..
madhyame japitavyāstu rudrakumbhe bhavodbhavāḥ ..22..
4.143.d:
ईशावास्यं चतुर्थस्य कुम्भस्य चाभिमंत्रणम् ॥
मध्यमे जपितव्यास्तु रुद्रकुम्भे भवोद्भवाः ॥22॥
4.143.m: and "īśāvāsyam..." is the consecration of the fourth jar; / in the central jar, the jar of Rudra, the [verses beginning with] "bhavodbhava" are to be recited.

4.143.s:
gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatairvastrairnaivaidyairghṛtapācitaiḥ..
phalaiśca nārikelādyairdīpakaiḥ kuṃbhapūjanam .. 23 ..
4.143.d:
गंधपुष्पाक्षतैर्वस्त्रैर्नैवैद्यैर्घृतपाचितैः॥
फलैश्च नारिकेलाद्यैर्दीपकैः कुंभपूजनम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.143.m: The worship of the jars is performed with perfumes, flowers, unhusked grains, garments, / cooked offerings fried in clarified butter, fruits such as coconuts, and lamps.

4.143.s:
svastivācanakaṃ caiva kārayettadanaṃtaram ..
krameṇānena śanakairagnikāryaṃ prayojayet.. 24 ..
4.143.d:
स्वस्तिवाचनकं चैव कारयेत्तदनंतरम् ॥
क्रमेणानेन शनकैरग्निकार्यं प्रयोजयेत्॥ 24 ॥
4.143.m: Immediately after that, one should cause the svastivācana recitation to be made. / In this order, one should slowly perform the ritual of the fire:

4.143.s:
agniṃ dūtamiti hyagniṃ pūrvameva nidhāpayet ..
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samiti brahmāsananiyojanam .. 25 ..
4.143.d:
अग्निं दूतमिति ह्यग्निं पूर्वमेव निधापयेत् ॥
हिरण्यगर्भः समिति ब्रह्मासननियोजनम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.143.m: One should first establish the fire with [the mantra] "agniṃ dūtam..."; / the placement of the seat of Brahmā is performed with "hiraṇyagarbhaḥ sam...";

4.143.s:
kapotasupraṇītena maṃtreṇa viniśeṣayet ..
kṛtvā cāvaraṇaṃ vahnerājyasaṃskārameva ca .. 26 ..
4.143.d:
कपोतसुप्रणीतेन मंत्रेण विनिशेषयेत् ॥
कृत्वा चावरणं वह्नेराज्यसंस्कारमेव च ॥ 26 ॥
4.143.m: one should consecrate it with the mantra beginning with "kapotasupraṇīta..."; / and having made the enclosure of the fire and the purification of clarified butter,

4.143.s:
atha cāsādayeddravyaṃ yathāvatsaprayojanam ..
tataḥ puruṣasūktena pāyasaśrapaṇaṃ bhavet .. 27 ..
4.143.d:
अथ चासादयेद्द्रव्यं यथावत्सप्रयोजनम् ॥
ततः पुरुषसूक्तेन पायसश्रपणं भवेत् ॥ 27 ॥
4.143.m: one should then set down the substances properly, along with their intended use. / Then the cooking of the milk-rice porridge should be done with the Puruṣasūkta.

4.143.s:
abhighāryātha saṃsiddhaṃ tathā saṃsthāpayedbhuvi ..
aṣṭādaśapramāṇedhmāndadyādatha śamīmayān .. 28 ..
4.143.d:
अभिघार्याथ संसिद्धं तथा संस्थापयेद्भुवि ॥
अष्टादशप्रमाणेध्मान्दद्यादथ शमीमयान् ॥ 28 ॥
4.143.m: Then, having drizzled clarified butter over the cooked [offering], one should place it on the ground; / then one should offer eighteen kindling sticks made of śamī wood;

4.143.s:
pālāśī samidhaḥ sapta tathā sapteti dāpayet ..
āghārāvājyabhāgau tu hutvā pūrvakrameṇa tu .. 29 ..
4.143.d:
पालाशी समिधः सप्त तथा सप्तेति दापयेत् ॥
आघारावाज्यभागौ तु हुत्वा पूर्वक्रमेण तु ॥ 29 ॥
4.143.m: one should offer seven palāśa firewood sticks, and likewise [another] seven. / Then, having offered the two liquid portions of clarified butter (āghāra) and the two portions of clarified butter (ājyabhāga) in the prescribed order,

4.143.s:
juhuyādāhutīḥ sapta jātavedasa ityṛcā ..
sthālīpākasya juhuyātpunarvai jātavedasā .. 4.143.30 ..
4.143.d:
जुहुयादाहुतीः सप्त जातवेदस इत्यृचा ॥
स्थालीपाकस्य जुहुयात्पुनर्वै जातवेदसा ॥ 4.143.30 ॥
4.143.m: one should offer seven oblations with the verse "jātavedase..."; / one should offer [the oblation] of the boiled offering (sthālīpāka) again with [the verse to] Jātavedas.

4.143.s:
taratsamaṃdī sūktena catasro juhuyāttataḥ ..
yamāyeti ca saptānyāḥ svāhāṃtā juhuyāttataḥ .. 31 ..
4.143.d:
तरत्समंदी सूक्तेन चतस्रो जुहुयात्ततः ॥
यमायेति च सप्तान्याः स्वाहांता जुहुयात्ततः ॥ 31 ॥
4.143.m: Then one should offer four oblations with the hymn "taratsamandī..."; / and then one should offer seven others ending with svāhā with [the mantra] "yamāya...";

4.143.s:
idaṃ viṣṇustataḥ sapta juhuyādāhutīrnṛpa ..
nakṣatrebhyastataḥ svāhā saptaviṃśada thāhutīḥ .. 32 ..
4.143.d:
इदं विष्णुस्ततः सप्त जुहुयादाहुतीर्नृप ॥
नक्षत्रेभ्यस्ततः स्वाहा सप्तविंशद थाहुतीः ॥ 32 ॥
4.143.m: then one should offer seven oblations with "idaṃ viṣṇuḥ...", O king; / then twenty-seven oblations with "svāhā to the lunar mansions!";

4.143.s:
yatkarmaṇaiti juhuyāttataḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ punaḥ ..
grahahomastataḥ kāryastilairājyapariplutaiḥ .. 33 ..
4.143.d:
यत्कर्मणैति जुहुयात्ततः स्विष्टकृतं पुनः ॥
ग्रहहोमस्ततः कार्यस्तिलैराज्यपरिप्लुतैः ॥ 33 ॥
4.143.m: then one should offer with "yatkarmaṇā...", and then again the sviṣṭakṛt oblation; / then the planetary oblation should be made with sesame seeds soaked in clarified butter.

4.143.s:
prāyaścittaṃ tato hutvā homakarma samāpayet ..
tatastu tūryanirghoṣaiḥ kāhalāśaṃkhaniḥsvanaiḥ .. 34 ..
4.143.d:
प्रायश्चित्तं ततो हुत्वा होमकर्म समापयेत् ॥
ततस्तु तूर्यनिर्घोषैः काहलाशंखनिःस्वनैः ॥ 34 ॥
4.143.m: Then, having offered the expiation, one should conclude the ritual of oblations. / Then, amidst the sounds of musical instruments and the noises of horns and conches,

4.143.s:
yajamānasya kartavyo hyabhiṣeko dvijottamaiḥ ..
kāśmaryavṛkṣasaṃbhūte bhadre bhadrāsane sthitam .. 35 ..
4.143.d:
यजमानस्य कर्तव्यो ह्यभिषेको द्विजोत्तमैः ॥
काश्मर्यवृक्षसंभूते भद्रे भद्रासने स्थितम् ॥ 35 ॥
4.143.m: the consecration (abhiṣeka) of the patron of the sacrifice must indeed be performed by the best of the twice-born. / Seated upon the auspicious bhadrāsana chair made of kāśmarya wood,

4.143.s:
vedimadhyagataṃ kṛtvā durnimittapraśāṃtaye ..
paṃcabhiḥ kalaśaiḥ pūrṇairmaṃtrairebhiryathākramam .. 36 ..
4.143.d:
वेदिमध्यगतं कृत्वा दुर्निमित्तप्रशांतये ॥
पंचभिः कलशैः पूर्णैर्मंत्रैरेभिर्यथाक्रमम् ॥ 36 ॥
4.143.m: placed in the middle of the altar, for the pacification of evil portents, / with the five full jars, with these mantras in proper order:

4.143.s:
sahasrākṣeṇa prathamaṃ tataścaiva śatā yuṣā ..
sajoṣasā ca indreti viśvānītyṛgbhireva ca .. 37 ..
4.143.d:
सहस्राक्षेण प्रथमं ततश्चैव शता युषा ॥
सजोषसा च इन्द्रेति विश्वानीत्यृग्भिरेव च ॥ 37 ॥
4.143.m: concentrated, they should bathe [him], first with "sahasrākṣeṇa...", and then with "śatāyuṣā...", / and with the verses "sajoṣasā...", "indra...", "viśvāni...", / and then with "ṛtamastu...".

4.143.s:
ṛtamastviti ca tataḥ snāpayeyuḥ samāhitāḥ ..
tato diśāṃ baliṃ dadyādvicitrānna samāyutam .. 38 ..
4.143.d:
ऋतमस्त्विति च ततः स्नापयेयुः समाहिताः ॥
ततो दिशां बलिं दद्याद्विचित्रान्न समायुतम् ॥ 38 ॥
4.143.m: Then one should present the offering (bali) to the directions, accompanied by varied cooked food,

4.143.s:
namostu sarvabhūtebhya iti mantramudāharan ..
snātasya brāhmaṇāḥ sarve paṭheyuḥ śāṃtimuttamām .. 39 ..
4.143.d:
नमोस्तु सर्वभूतेभ्य इति मन्त्रमुदाहरन् ॥
स्नातस्य ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे पठेयुः शांतिमुत्तमाम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.143.m: uttering the mantra "namo 'stu sarvabhūtebhyaḥ...". / For him when he has bathed, all the brāhmaṇas should recite the supreme pacification formula;

4.143.s:
śāṃtitoyena dhārāṃ ca pātayitvā saṃmatataḥ ..
puṇyāhavācanaṃ kṛtvā śāṃtikarma samāpayet .. 4.143.40 ..
4.143.d:
शांतितोयेन धारां च पातयित्वा संमततः ॥
पुण्याहवाचनं कृत्वा शांतिकर्म समापयेत् ॥ 4.143.40 ॥
4.143.m: and having poured a continuous stream with water of pacification, / having performed the proclamation of an auspicious day (puṇyāhavācana), one should conclude the pacification rite.

4.143.s:
kṣitiṃ hiraṇyaṃ vāsāṃsi śayanānyāsanāni ca ..
viprebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyathā śaktyā vimatsaraḥ .. 41 ..
4.143.d:
क्षितिं हिरण्यं वासांसि शयनान्यासनानि च ॥
विप्रेभ्यो दक्षिणां दद्याद्यथा शक्त्या विमत्सरः ॥ 41 ॥
4.143.m: Land, gold, clothes, beds, and seats / one should give as a sacrificial fee to the brāhmaṇas according to one's ability, free from envy.

4.143.s:
dīnānāthaviśiṣṭebhyaḥ śrotriyebhyaśca dāpayet ..
bhojanaṃ śobhanaṃ dattvā tataḥ sarvaṃ prasiddhyati .. 42 ..
4.143.d:
दीनानाथविशिष्टेभ्यः श्रोत्रियेभ्यश्च दापयेत् ॥
भोजनं शोभनं दत्त्वा ततः सर्वं प्रसिद्ध्यति ॥ 42 ॥
4.143.m: One should cause gifts to be given to the poor, the helpless, the distinguished, and learned brāhmaṇas; / having given excellent food, then everything succeeds.

4.143.s:
āyuśca labhate dīrghaṃ śatrūnvijayate kṣaṇāt ..
durgāṇi cāsya sidyanti putrāṃśca labhate śubhān .. 43 ..
4.143.d:
आयुश्च लभते दीर्घं शत्रून्विजयते क्षणात् ॥
दुर्गाणि चास्य सिद्यन्ति पुत्रांश्च लभते शुभान् ॥ 43 ॥
4.143.m: And he attains a long life, conquers enemies in an instant, / his difficulties are resolved, and he obtains auspicious sons.

4.143.s:
yathāśastraprahārāṇāṃ kavacaṃ vāraṇaṃ bhavet..
tathā daivopaghātānāṃ śāntirbhavati vāraṇam .. 44 ..
4.143.d:
यथाशस्त्रप्रहाराणां कवचं वारणं भवेत्॥
तथा दैवोपघातानां शान्तिर्भवति वारणम् ॥ 44 ॥
4.143.m: Just as armor is a shield against blows from weapons, / so pacification is a shield against the afflictions of fate.

4.143.s:
ahiṃsakasya dāṃtasya dharmārjitadhanasya ca ..
dayādākṣiṇyayuktasya sarve sānugrahā grahāḥ.. 45..
4.143.d:
अहिंसकस्य दांतस्य धर्मार्जितधनस्य च ॥
दयादाक्षिण्ययुक्तस्य सर्वे सानुग्रहा ग्रहाः॥ 45॥
4.143.m: For one who is non-violent, self-controlled, who has acquired wealth righteously, / and who is endowed with compassion and courtesy, all planets are gracious.

4.143.s:
arthānsamarthayati varddhayate ca dharmaṃ kāmaṃ prasādhayati tasya pinaṣṭi pāpam ..
yaḥ kārayetsakaladoṣaharīṃ samarthāṃ śāṃtiṃ praśāṃtahṛdayaḥ puruṣaḥ sadaiva .. .. 46 ..
gaṇanāthaśāntivarṇanam
4.143.d:
अर्थान्समर्थयति वर्द्धयते च धर्मं कामं प्रसाधयति तस्य पिनष्टि पापम् ॥
यः कारयेत्सकलदोषहरीं समर्थां शांतिं प्रशांतहृदयः पुरुषः सदैव ॥ ॥ 46 ॥
गणनाथशान्तिवर्णनम्
4.143.m:
For that man who, with a calm heart, always has this efficacious pacification performed / which removes all defects, it accomplishes goals, increases righteousness, / achieves desires, and crushes his sin.
Description of the pacification rite for Gaṇanātha

4.144.s:
.. .. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
śāṃtiṃ kathaya deveśa gaṇanāthasya me vibho ..
yāṃ kṛtvā sarvadurgāṇi tarate mānavo'khilaḥ .. 1 .. .. ..
4.144.d:
॥ ॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
शांतिं कथय देवेश गणनाथस्य मे विभो ॥
यां कृत्वा सर्वदुर्गाणि तरते मानवोऽखिलः ॥ 1 ॥ ॥ ॥
4.144.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Tell me, O Lord of gods, O all-pervading one, the propitiatory rite of Gaṇanātha,
by performing which every mortal crosses over all difficulties.

4.144.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śāṃtiṃ vakṣyāmi rājendra gaṇanāthapriyāṃ parām ..
yasyā ācaraṇenaiva sarvāriṣṭakṣayo bhavet .. 2 ..
4.144.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शांतिं वक्ष्यामि राजेन्द्र गणनाथप्रियां पराम् ॥
यस्या आचरणेनैव सर्वारिष्टक्षयो भवेत् ॥ 2 ॥
4.144.m:
The venerable Kṛṣṇa said:
I shall proclaim to you, O king of kings, the supreme propitiatory rite dear to Gaṇanātha,
by the very practice of which all afflictions are destroyed.

4.144.s:
vināyakaṃ karmāvighnasiddhyarthaṃ vinibodhata ..
svapne'vagāhate'tyarthaṃ jalaṃ muṃḍāṃśca paśyati .. 3 ..
4.144.d:
विनायकं कर्माविघ्नसिद्ध्यर्थं विनिबोधत ॥
स्वप्नेऽवगाहतेऽत्यर्थं जलं मुंडांश्च पश्यति ॥ 3 ॥
4.144.m:
Understand [the possession by] Vināyaka, for the sake of the unobstructed accomplishment of rituals:
In dreams one plunges deeply into water and sees shaven-headed men.

4.144.s:
kāṣāyavāsasaścaiva kravyādānadhirohati ..
apamūrdhaiḥ śave rudraiḥ sahaikatra ca tiṣṭhati .. 4 ..
4.144.d:
काषायवाससश्चैव क्रव्यादानधिरोहति ॥
अपमूर्धैः शवे रुद्रैः सहैकत्र च तिष्ठति ॥ 4 ॥
4.144.m:
And [one sees] men wearing ochre garments, and mounts carnivorous animals;
one remains in one place with headless corpses [and] terrifying beings.

4.144.s:
vrajannapi tathātmānaṃ manyatenugataṃ paraiḥ ..
vimanā viphalāraṃbhaḥ saṃsīdatyanimittataḥ .. 5 ..
4.144.d:
व्रजन्नपि तथात्मानं मन्यतेनुगतं परैः ॥
विमना विफलारंभः संसीदत्यनिमित्ततः ॥ 5 ॥
4.144.m:
Even while walking, one considers oneself followed by others;
one is dejected, one's undertakings are futile, and one sinks into despondency without cause.

4.144.s:
tenopasṛṣṭo labhate na rājyaṃ rājanaṃdanaḥ ..
kumārī na ca bhartāramapatyaṃ garbhiṇī tathā .. 6 ..
4.144.d:
तेनोपसृष्टो लभते न राज्यं राजनंदनः ॥
कुमारी न च भर्तारमपत्यं गर्भिणी तथा ॥ 6 ॥
4.144.m:
Asslicted by him, a prince does not obtain a kingdom;
a maiden does not obtain a husband, nor does a pregnant woman obtain offspring.

4.144.s:
ācāryatvaṃ śrotriyaśca na śiṣyo'dhyāpanaṃ tathā ..
vaṇiglābhaṃ na cāpnoti na kṛṣiṃ ca kṛṣīvalaḥ .. 7 ..
4.144.d:
आचार्यत्वं श्रोत्रियश्च न शिष्योऽध्यापनं तथा ॥
वणिग्लाभं न चाप्नोति न कृषिं च कृषीवलः ॥ 7 ॥
4.144.m:
A learned Vedic scholar does not obtain teacherhood, nor does a pupil obtain instruction;
a merchant does not obtain profit, and a farmer does not obtain a harvest.

4.144.s:
snapanaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ puṇye'hni vidhipūrvakam ..
gaurasarṣapakalkena sājyenotsāditasya tu .. 8 ..
4.144.d:
स्नपनं तस्य कर्तव्यं पुण्येऽह्नि विधिपूर्वकम् ॥
गौरसर्षपकल्केन साज्येनोत्सादितस्य तु ॥ 8 ॥
4.144.m:
A bath should be performed for him on an auspicious day according to the rules,
when he has been anointed with a paste of white mustard seeds mixed with clarified butter,

4.144.s:
sugandhakuṃkumāliptaśarīraśirasastathā ..
bhadrāsanopaviṣṭasya svasti vācya dvijāñchubhān .. 9 ..
4.144.d:
सुगन्धकुंकुमालिप्तशरीरशिरसस्तथा ॥
भद्रासनोपविष्टस्य स्वस्ति वाच्य द्विजाञ्छुभान् ॥ 9 ॥
4.144.m:
and whose body and head are smeared with fragrant saffron,
seated upon an auspicious seat, having auspicious twice-born priests recite benedictions.

4.144.s:
aśvasthānādgajasthānādvalmīkātsaṃgamāddhradāt ..
mṛttikāṃ rocanāṃ gaṃdhānguggulaṃ cāpsu nikṣipet .. 4.144.10 ..
4.144.d:
अश्वस्थानाद्गजस्थानाद्वल्मीकात्संगमाद्ध्रदात् ॥
मृत्तिकां रोचनां गंधान्गुग्गुलं चाप्सु निक्षिपेत् ॥ 4.144.10 ॥
4.144.m:
From a horse stable, an elephant stable, an anthill, a confluence, and a deep pool,
one should cast soil, yellow orpiment, perfumes, and bdellium into the waters.

4.144.s:
yadā hṛtā hyekavaṇairmanubhiḥ kalaśairhradāt ..
carmaṇyānaḍuhe rakte sthāpya bhadrāsanaṃ tathā .. ..1 1..
4.144.d:
यदा हृता ह्येकवणैर्मनुभिः कलशैर्ह्रदात् ॥
चर्मण्यानडुहे रक्ते स्थाप्य भद्रासनं तथा ॥ ॥1 1॥
4.144.m:
When [the waters] are brought from a deep pool in jars of uniform colour with mantras,
having placed the auspicious seat on a red bull's hide,

4.144.s:
sahasrākṣaṃ śatadhāramṛṣiṇā vacanaṃ kṛtam ..
tena tvāmabhiṣiṃcāmi pāvamānyaḥ punaṃtu te ..12..
4.144.d:
सहस्राक्षं शतधारमृषिणा वचनं कृतम् ॥
तेन त्वामभिषिंचामि पावमान्यः पुनंतु ते ॥12॥
4.144.m:
“The utterance made by the sage has a thousand eyes and a hundred streams;
with that I sprinkle you; may the purifying mantras purify you.

4.144.s:
bhagaṃ te varuṇo rājā bhagaṃ sūryo bṛhaspatiḥ ..
bhagamindraśca vāyuśca bhagaṃ saptarṣayo daduḥ .. 13 ..
4.144.d:
भगं ते वरुणो राजा भगं सूर्यो बृहस्पतिः ॥
भगमिन्द्रश्च वायुश्च भगं सप्तर्षयो ददुः ॥ 13 ॥
4.144.m:
King Varuṇa has given you good fortune; Sūrya and Bṛhaspati have given good fortune;
Indra and Vāyu have given good fortune; the seven sages have given good fortune.

4.144.s:
yatte keśeṣu daurbhāgyaṃ sīmaṃte yacca mūrddhani ..
lalāṭe karṇayorakṣṇorāpastadghnantu te sadā .. 14 ..
4.144.d:
यत्ते केशेषु दौर्भाग्यं सीमंते यच्च मूर्द्धनि ॥
ललाटे कर्णयोरक्ष्णोरापस्तद्घ्नन्तु ते सदा ॥ 14 ॥
4.144.m:
Whatever misfortune is in your hair, in the parting of your hair, and upon your head,
on your forehead, your ears, and your eyes—may the waters destroy that forever.”

4.144.s:
snātasya sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ sruveṇaudumbareṇa ca ..
juhuyānmūrddhani kuśānsavyena parigṛhya ca .. 15 ..
4.144.d:
स्नातस्य सार्षपं तैलं स्रुवेणौदुम्बरेण च ॥
जुहुयान्मूर्द्धनि कुशान्सव्येन परिगृह्य च ॥ 15 ॥
4.144.m:
For him who has bathed, one should offer mustard oil with an udumbara ladle
upon his head, holding kuśa grass with the left hand.

4.144.s:
mitaśca samitaścaiva tathā sālakaṭaṃkaṭau ..
kūṣmāṃḍo rājaputraśca aṃte svāhāsamanvitaiḥ .. 16 ..
4.144.d:
मितश्च समितश्चैव तथा सालकटंकटौ ॥
कूष्मांडो राजपुत्रश्च अंते स्वाहासमन्वितैः ॥ 16 ॥
4.144.m:
[With the names] Mita, Samita, as well as Sālakaṭaṅkaṭa,
Kūṣmāṇḍa, and Rājaputra, accompanied at the end by “svāhā”,

4.144.s:
nāmabhirbalimaṃtraiśca namaskārasamanvitaiḥ ..
dadyāccatuṣpathe śūrpe kuśānāstīrya sarvaśaḥ .. 17 ..
4.144.d:
नामभिर्बलिमंत्रैश्च नमस्कारसमन्वितैः ॥
दद्याच्चतुष्पथे शूर्पे कुशानास्तीर्य सर्वशः ॥ 17 ॥
4.144.m:
with these names, mantras of offering, and accompanied by obeisance,
one should present [the offering] at a crossroads in a winnowing basket, having strewn kuśa grass all around:

4.144.s:
kṛtā kṛtāṃstaṃḍulāṃśca palalaudanameva ca ..
matsyānpakvāṃstathaivāmānmāṃsametāvadeva tu .. 18 ..
4.144.d:
कृता कृतांस्तंडुलांश्च पललौदनमेव च ॥
मत्स्यान्पक्वांस्तथैवामान्मांसमेतावदेव तु ॥ 18 ॥
4.144.m:
cooked and uncooked rice grains, and rice boiled with sesame paste,
cooked fish as well as raw, and just as much meat,

4.144.s:
puṣpaṃ citraṃ sugandhaṃ ca surāṃ ca trividhāmapi ..
mūlakaṃ pūri kāpūpaṃ tathaivoṃḍerakasrajam .. 19 ..
4.144.d:
पुष्पं चित्रं सुगन्धं च सुरां च त्रिविधामपि ॥
मूलकं पूरि कापूपं तथैवोंडेरकस्रजम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.144.m:
variegated and fragrant flowers, and three kinds of spirituous liquor,
radishes, purīs, rice cakes, and garlands of uṇḍeraka cakes.

4.144.s:
dūrvāṃ sarvaprapuṣpāṇāṃ dattvārghyaṃ pūrṇamaḍalām ..
vināyakasya jananīmupatiṣṭhettatoṃ'bikām .. 4.144.20 ..
4.144.d:
दूर्वां सर्वप्रपुष्पाणां दत्त्वार्घ्यं पूर्णमडलाम् ॥
विनायकस्य जननीमुपतिष्ठेत्ततोंऽबिकाम् ॥ 4.144.20 ॥
4.144.m:
Having offered an arghya of dūrvā grass with all flowers [forming] a complete circle,
one should then attend upon Ambikā, the mother of Vināyaka:

4.144.s:
rūpaṃ dehi yaśo dehi bhagaṃ bhavati dehi me ..
putrāndehi dhanaṃ dehi sarvakāmāṃśca dehi me .. 21 ..
4.144.d:
रूपं देहि यशो देहि भगं भवति देहि मे ॥
पुत्रान्देहि धनं देहि सर्वकामांश्च देहि मे ॥ 21 ॥
4.144.m:
“Give me beauty, give me fame, give me good fortune, O goddess;
give me sons, give me wealth, and give me all desires.”

4.144.s:
tataḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuklamālyānulepanaḥ ..
bhojayedbrāhmaṇāndadyādvastrayugmaṃ gurorapi .. 22 ..
4.144.d:
ततः शुक्लांबरधरः शुक्लमाल्यानुलेपनः ॥
भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणान्दद्याद्वस्त्रयुग्मं गुरोरपि ॥ 22 ॥
4.144.m:
Then, wearing white garments, adorned with white garlands and unguents,
he should feed brāhmaṇas and give a pair of garments to his guru as well.

4.144.s:
evaṃ vināyakaṃ pūjya grahāṃścaiva vidhānataḥ ..
karmaṇāṃ phalamāpnoti śriyamāpnoti cottamām .. 23 ..
4.144.d:
एवं विनायकं पूज्य ग्रहांश्चैव विधानतः ॥
कर्मणां फलमाप्नोति श्रियमाप्नोति चोत्तमाम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.144.m:
Having thus worshipped Vināyaka and the planets according to the rules,
he obtains the fruit of his actions and obtains supreme prosperity.

4.144.s:
ādityasya tathā pūjāṃ tilakaṃ svāminastathā ..
mahāgaṇapateścaiva kurvansiddhimavāpnuyāt .. 24 ..
4.144.d:
आदित्यस्य तथा पूजां तिलकं स्वामिनस्तथा ॥
महागणपतेश्चैव कुर्वन्सिद्धिमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 24 ॥
4.144.m:
Performing likewise the worship of the Sun, the sectarian mark of the Lord,
and of Mahāgaṇapati, he will attain accomplishment.

4.144.s:
śvetārkasya tu yo mūle mahāgaṇapatiḥ kṛtaḥ ..
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇaḥ so'pi siddhikaraḥ smṛtaḥ .. 25 ..
4.144.d:
श्वेतार्कस्य तु यो मूले महागणपतिः कृतः ॥
सर्वलक्षणसंपूर्णः सोऽपि सिद्धिकरः स्मृतः ॥ 25 ॥
4.144.m:
A Mahāgaṇapati made at the root of a white arka plant,
endowed with all auspicious marks, is also considered to bring accomplishment.

4.144.s:
saṃjapyate śucau deśe vighnaṃ nātra hi dehinaḥ ..
paramaṃ pūjayennityaṃ gandhamālyasragādibhiḥ .. 26 ..
kṣīṇabhāgyo'pi puruṣaḥ pūjitaśca nareśvaraḥ ..
sarvasiddhimavāpnoti jayī bhavati sarvadā .. .27 .. ..
nakṣatrahomavidhivarṇanam
4.144.d:
संजप्यते शुचौ देशे विघ्नं नात्र हि देहिनः ॥
परमं पूजयेन्नित्यं गन्धमाल्यस्रगादिभिः ॥ 26 ॥
क्षीणभाग्योऽपि पुरुषः पूजितश्च नरेश्वरः ॥
सर्वसिद्धिमवाप्नोति जयी भवति सर्वदा ॥ .27 ॥ ॥
नक्षत्रहोमविधिवर्णनम्
4.144.m:
When he is chanted to in a pure place, no obstacle exists for the embodied soul here;
one should always worship the Supreme One with perfumes, garlands, wreaths, and the like.
Even a man whose fortune is depleted, and a king who has worshipped him,
attains all accomplishment and becomes victorious at all times.
Description of the rules for the constellation burnt-offering

4.145.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
agnihotre sukhāsīnaṃ gargaḥ pṛcchati kauśikam ..
baṃdhane saṃnirodheṅgā vyādhīnāṃ saṃprapīḍane .. 1 ..
4.145.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अग्निहोत्रे सुखासीनं गर्गः पृच्छति कौशिकम् ॥
बंधने संनिरोधेङ्गा व्याधीनां संप्रपीडने ॥ 1 ॥
4.145.m:
The venerable Kṛṣṇa said:
Garga asks Kauśika, who is seated comfortably by the sacred fire:
“In bondage, confinement, and the affliction of the limbs by diseases,

4.145.s:
kathaṃ mokṣo bhavettasya sādhyāsādhyaṃ bravīhi me ..
gargeṇa kauśikaḥ pṛṣṭa idaṃ vacanamabravīt ..2..
4.145.d:
कथं मोक्षो भवेत्तस्य साध्यासाध्यं ब्रवीहि मे ॥
गर्गेण कौशिकः पृष्ट इदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥2॥
4.145.m:
how might there be release for him? Tell me what is curable and incurable.”
Being questioned by Garga, Kauśika spoke these words:

4.145.s:
ādhāne janmanakṣatre naidhanapratyayeṣu ca ..
vyādhirutpadyate yasya kleśāya maraṇāya ca ..3..
4.145.d:
आधाने जन्मनक्षत्रे नैधनप्रत्ययेषु च ॥
व्याधिरुत्पद्यते यस्य क्लेशाय मरणाय च ॥3॥
4.145.m:
“When a disease arises under the constellation of conception, of birth, or in the destructive positions,
it leads to suffering and to death.

4.145.s:
kṛttikāsu yadā kaścidvyādhiṃ saṃpratipadyate ..
navarātraṃ bhavetpīḍā trirātraṃ rohiṇīṣu ca ..4..
4.145.d:
कृत्तिकासु यदा कश्चिद्व्याधिं संप्रतिपद्यते ॥
नवरात्रं भवेत्पीडा त्रिरात्रं रोहिणीषु च ॥4॥
4.145.m:
When anyone contracts a disease under the Kṛttikās,
there will be affliction for nine nights, and for three nights under the Rohiṇīs.

4.145.s:
mṛgaśīrṣe pañcarātramārdrā prāṇaviyojinī ..
punarvasau ca puṣye ca saptarātraṃ vidhīyate .. .. 5 ..
4.145.d:
मृगशीर्षे पञ्चरात्रमार्द्रा प्राणवियोजिनी ॥
पुनर्वसौ च पुष्ये च सप्तरात्रं विधीयते ॥ ॥ 5 ॥
4.145.m:
Under Mṛgaśīrṣa it lasts five nights; Ārdrā deprives one of life;
and under Punarvasu and Puṣya, seven nights are prescribed.

4.145.s:
navarātraṃ tathāśleṣā śmaśānāṃtaṃ maghāsu ca ..
dvau māsau phālgunī caiva uttarāsu tripakṣakam .. 6 ..
4.145.d:
नवरात्रं तथाश्लेषा श्मशानांतं मघासु च ॥
द्वौ मासौ फाल्गुनी चैव उत्तरासु त्रिपक्षकम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.145.m:
Under Āśleṣā it lasts nine nights, and under the Maghās it ends at the cremation ground;
under [Pūrva-]Phālgunī two months, and under the Uttarās [Uttara-Phālgunī] three fortnights.

4.145.s: haste ca tanu dṛśyeta citrāyāṃ tvarddhamāsa kam ..7..
4.145.d: हस्ते च तनु दृश्येत चित्रायां त्वर्द्धमास कम् ॥7॥
4.145.m: Under Hasta it is seen to be slight; under Citrā, half a month.

4.145.s:
māsadvayaṃ tathā svātau viśākhā viṃśatirdināḥ ..
maitre caiva daśāhaṃ tu jyeṣṭhā caivārddhamāsikā ..8..
4.145.d:
मासद्वयं तथा स्वातौ विशाखा विंशतिर्दिनाः ॥
मैत्रे चैव दशाहं तु ज्येष्ठा चैवार्द्धमासिका ॥8॥
4.145.m:
Likewise, two months under Svāti; Viśākhā lasts twenty days;
under Maitra [Anurādhā] ten days, and Jyeṣṭhā lasts half a month.

4.145.s:
mūlena jāyate mokṣaścāṣāḍhāsu tripañcakam ..
uttarādinaviṃśatyā dvau māsau śravaṇena tu .. 9 ..
4.145.d:
मूलेन जायते मोक्षश्चाषाढासु त्रिपञ्चकम् ॥
उत्तरादिनविंशत्या द्वौ मासौ श्रवणेन तु ॥ 9 ॥
4.145.m:
Under Mūla release occurs; under the Āṣāḍhās [Pūrvāṣāḍhā], fifteen [days];
under the Uttarā [Uttarāṣāḍhā] twenty days, and two months under Śravaṇa.

4.145.s:
dhaniṣṭhāyāmarddhamāsaṃ vāruṇe tu daśāhakaiḥ ..
nava bhādrapadāṛkṣa uttarāsu tripaṃcakam .. 4.145.10 ..
4.145.d:
धनिष्ठायामर्द्धमासं वारुणे तु दशाहकैः ॥
नव भाद्रपदाऋक्ष उत्तरासु त्रिपंचकम् ॥ 4.145.10 ॥
4.145.m:
Under Dhaniṣṭhā half a month, but under Vāruṇa [Śatabhiṣaj] ten days;
nine under the Bhādrapadā constellation [Pūrvabhādrapadā], and fifteen under the Uttarās [Uttarabhādrapadā].

4.145.s:
revatī daśarātraṃ tu ahorātraṃ tathāśvinī ..
prāṇairviyojayennityaṃ garga nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ .. 11 ..
4.145.d:
रेवती दशरात्रं तु अहोरात्रं तथाश्विनी ॥
प्राणैर्वियोजयेन्नित्यं गर्ग नास्त्यत्र संशयः ॥ 11 ॥
4.145.m:
Revatī lasts ten nights, and Aśvinī a day and night;
it always deprives one of life, O Garga, there is no doubt about this.

4.145.s:
kauśikena samādiṣṭo nakṣatravyādhisaṃbhavaḥ ..
daivajñenāpi jñātavyaṃ nakṣatramatha janmanā .. 12 ..
4.145.d:
कौशिकेन समादिष्टो नक्षत्रव्याधिसंभवः ॥
दैवज्ञेनापि ज्ञातव्यं नक्षत्रमथ जन्मना ॥ 12 ॥
4.145.m:
The origin of disease according to constellations has been declared by Kauśika;
the astrologer should also know the constellation from birth.

4.145.s:
kṣīravṛkṣasya samidho juhuyādaśvadaivate ..
tilānmadhuplutānyāmye yavamevāgnidaivate .. 13 ..
4.145.d:
क्षीरवृक्षस्य समिधो जुहुयादश्वदैवते ॥
तिलान्मधुप्लुतान्याम्ये यवमेवाग्निदैवते ॥ 13 ॥
4.145.m:
One should offer sacrificial sticks of a milky tree under the horse-deity [Aśvinī];
sesame flooded with honey under the Yamya [Bharaṇī]; barley indeed under the fire-deity [Kṛttikā].

4.145.s:
prājāpatye tu juhuyādbhogyabījakaraṃ bakam ..
saumye priyaṃgavo raudre sarpirmāṃsasamanvitam .. 14 ..
4.145.d:
प्राजापत्ये तु जुहुयाद्भोग्यबीजकरं बकम् ॥
सौम्ये प्रियंगवो रौद्रे सर्पिर्मांससमन्वितम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.145.m:
Under the Prājāpatya [Rohiṇī] one should offer a mixture of edible grains;
under the Saumya [Mṛgaśīrṣa] priyaṅgu grains; under the Raudra [Ārdrā] clarified butter accompanied by meat.

4.145.s:
āditye ca prayatnena ghṛtāktāḥ sitataṃḍulāḥ ..
payasā sarpiṣā sākaṃ bṛhaspatyadhidaivate .. 15 ..
4.145.d:
आदित्ये च प्रयत्नेन घृताक्ताः सिततंडुलाः ॥
पयसा सर्पिषा साकं बृहस्पत्यधिदैवते ॥ 15 ॥
4.145.m:
And under the Āditya [Punarvasu] carefully [offer] white rice grains smeared with clarified butter;
with milk and clarified butter under the deity presided over by Bṛhaspati [Puṣya].

4.145.s:
grāmyoṣadhairvaṭapatraiḥ sarpiḥ sarpādhidaivate ..
homaḥ proktaḥ priyaṃgūnāṃ nakṣatre yāmadaivate .. 16 ..
4.145.d:
ग्राम्योषधैर्वटपत्रैः सर्पिः सर्पाधिदैवते ॥
होमः प्रोक्तः प्रियंगूनां नक्षत्रे यामदैवते ॥ 16 ॥
4.145.m: In the [nakṣatra] presided over by the serpents, the oblation is of clarified butter with wild herbs and vaṭa leaves; / the oblation in the nakṣatra presided over by Yama is declared to be of priyaṅgu.

4.145.s: sāvitre dadhihomotra tvāṣṭraṃ citraudanaṃ haviḥ .. 17 ..
4.145.d: सावित्रे दधिहोमोत्र त्वाष्ट्रं चित्रौदनं हविः ॥ 17 ॥
4.145.m: In the [nakṣatra] of Savitṛ, the oblation here is of curds; that of Tvaṣṭṛ is variegated boiled rice as the sacrificial offering.

4.145.s:
yavānsahājyena hunedraudre'gnau tu payodanam ..
maitreṇātha tu maṃtreṇa maitre kaṭakamiśritam .. 18 ..
4.145.d:
यवान्सहाज्येन हुनेद्रौद्रेऽग्नौ तु पयोदनम् ॥
मैत्रेणाथ तु मंत्रेण मैत्रे कटकमिश्रितम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.145.m: One should offer barley together with clarified butter, but in the Raudra [nakṣatra] one should offer rice cooked in milk into the fire; / then, with the Mitra mantra, [an oblation] mixed with lentils in the Maitra [nakṣatra].

4.145.s:
nairṛtye tilahomaḥ syādavyakte ca hutāśane ..
abdaivatye śālibījairvaiśvadevaṃ tu kārayet .. 19 ..
4.145.d:
नैरृत्ये तिलहोमः स्यादव्यक्ते च हुताशने ॥
अब्दैवत्ये शालिबीजैर्वैश्वदेवं तु कारयेत् ॥ 19 ॥
4.145.m: In the Nairṛta [nakṣatra], there should be an oblation of sesame seeds, and into the unmanifest fire; / in that presided over by the Waters, one should perform the Vaiśvadeva [offering] with grains of śāli rice.

4.145.s:
raktāśca taṃḍulāścaiva hotavyā viṣṇudaivate ..
vāruṇe pārijātānāṃ puṣpāṇāṃ homa iṣyate .. 4.145.20 ..
4.145.d:
रक्ताश्च तंडुलाश्चैव होतव्या विष्णुदैवते ॥
वारुणे पारिजातानां पुष्पाणां होम इष्यते ॥ 4.145.20 ॥
4.145.m: And red unhusked rice grains should be offered in the [nakṣatra] presided over by Viṣṇu; / in the Vāruṇa [nakṣatra], an oblation of pārijāta flowers is prescribed.

4.145.s:
ajaikapāde nakṣatre prājāpatyena tatsamam ..
āhirbudhnye tu nakṣatre vaiśvadevaṃ tu kārayet .. 21 ..
4.145.d:
अजैकपादे नक्षत्रे प्राजापत्येन तत्समम् ॥
आहिर्बुध्न्ये तु नक्षत्रे वैश्वदेवं तु कारयेत् ॥ 21 ॥
4.145.m: In the Ajaikapāda nakṣatra, it is equal to that of the Prājāpatya; / in the Āhirbudhnya nakṣatra, one should perform the Vaiśvadeva [offering].

4.145.s:
raktāśca taṇḍulāścaiva hotavyā viṣṇudaivate ..
pauṣe phalānyakhaṃḍāni juhuyādaṣṭottaraṃ śatam .. 22 ..
4.145.d:
रक्ताश्च तण्डुलाश्चैव होतव्या विष्णुदैवते ॥
पौषे फलान्यखंडानि जुहुयादष्टोत्तरं शतम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.145.m: And red unhusked rice grains should be offered in the [nakṣatra] presided over by Viṣṇu; / in Pauṣa, one should offer one hundred and eight unbroken fruits.

4.145.s:
sāvitrī homamekaṃ tu brahmābhihitavānpurā ..
sarvajvarapraśamanaṃ sadyo jvaraharaṃ param .. 23 ..
aparādhaśatavratavarṇanam
4.145.d:
सावित्री होममेकं तु ब्रह्माभिहितवान्पुरा ॥
सर्वज्वरप्रशमनं सद्यो ज्वरहरं परम् ॥ 23 ॥
अपराधशतव्रतवर्णनम्
4.145.m:
Brahmā formerly declared a single Sāvitrī oblation, / which pacifies all fevers and immediately removes fever, being supreme.
Description of the Hundred-Transgression Observance.

4.146.s:
.. śrīvasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
athānyadapi te vacmi vrataṃ rājanmahāphalam ..
aparādhaśataṃ yena kṣayaṃ yāti śṛṇuṣva tat .. 1 ..
4.146.d:
॥ श्रीवसिष्ठ उवाच ॥ ॥
अथान्यदपि ते वच्मि व्रतं राजन्महाफलम् ॥
अपराधशतं येन क्षयं याति शृणुष्व तत् ॥ 1 ॥
4.146.m: Śrī Vasiṣṭha said: / Now I shall tell you another observance of great fruit, O king, / by which a hundred transgressions are destroyed; listen to it.

4.146.s:
.. ikṣvākuruvāca .. ..
kiṃ vrataṃ tanmamācakṣva ko'parādhastu taṃ vada ..
kaḥ pūjyate ca vai tasminkadā vā kriyate naraiḥ .. 2 ..
4.146.d:
॥ इक्ष्वाकुरुवाच ॥ ॥
किं व्रतं तन्ममाचक्ष्व कोऽपराधस्तु तं वद ॥
कः पूज्यते च वै तस्मिन्कदा वा क्रियते नरैः ॥ 2 ॥
4.146.m: Ikṣvāku said: / Tell me what that observance is, and state what the transgression is; / who is worshipped in it, and when is it performed by men?

4.146.s:
.. śrīvasiṣṭha uvāca ..
śṛṇu rājanmahābāho aparādhaśatavratam..
yenānuṣṭhitamātreṇa kāmamokṣau labheta nā .. 3 ..
4.146.d:
॥ श्रीवसिष्ठ उवाच ॥
शृणु राजन्महाबाहो अपराधशतव्रतम्॥
येनानुष्ठितमात्रेण काममोक्षौ लभेत ना ॥ 3 ॥
4.146.m: Śrī Vasiṣṭha said: / Listen, O mighty-armed king, to the Hundred-Transgression observance, / merely by performing which a man obtains desire and liberation.

4.146.s:
prāyaścittānyaśeṣāṇi sarvapāpāpanuttaye ..
kṛtānyapyakṛtāni syuriti hovāca padmajaḥ .. 4 ..
4.146.d:
प्रायश्चित्तान्यशेषाणि सर्वपापापनुत्तये ॥
कृतान्यप्यकृतानि स्युरिति होवाच पद्मजः ॥ 4 ॥
4.146.m: All expiations for the removal of all sins, / even when performed, become as if unperformed; so spoke the Lotus-born [Brahmā].

4.146.s:
pāpaṃ gurutaraṃ cāpi dahyate tūlarāśivat ..
aparādhaśataṃ rājañśṛṇuṣva gadato mama .. 5 ..
4.146.d:
पापं गुरुतरं चापि दह्यते तूलराशिवत् ॥
अपराधशतं राजञ्शृणुष्व गदतो मम ॥ 5 ॥
4.146.m: Even a very heavy sin is burnt away like a heap of cotton. / Listen, O king, as I recite the hundred transgressions:

4.146.s:
na karoti naro mohādvratametaddinedine..
anāśramitvaṃ prathamo'nagnitā vratahīnatā .. 6 ..
4.146.d:
न करोति नरो मोहाद्व्रतमेतद्दिनेदिने॥
अनाश्रमित्वं प्रथमोऽनग्निता व्रतहीनता ॥ 6 ॥
4.146.m: A man out of delusion does not perform this observance day by day. / Being without a life-stage is the first; being without sacred fire; lack of observances;

4.146.s:
adātṛtvamaśaucaṃ ca nirdayatvaṃ spṛhālutā ..
akṣāṃtirjanapīḍā ca māyitvamapyamaṃgalam .. 7 ..
4.146.d:
अदातृत्वमशौचं च निर्दयत्वं स्पृहालुता ॥
अक्षांतिर्जनपीडा च मायित्वमप्यमंगलम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.146.m: Uncharitableness and impurity, mercilessness, covetousness, / lack of patience, tormenting people, deceptiveness, and inauspiciousness;

4.146.s:
kṣatavratatvaṃ nāstikyaṃ vedaniṃdā kaṭhoratā ..
asatyatā hiṃsakatvaṃ stainyami ndriyaviplavaḥ .. 8 ..
4.146.d:
क्षतव्रतत्वं नास्तिक्यं वेदनिंदा कठोरता ॥
असत्यता हिंसकत्वं स्तैन्यमि न्द्रियविप्लवः ॥ 8 ॥
4.146.m: Broken vows, atheism, reviling the Vedas, harshness, / untruthfulness, injuriousness, theft, unrestraint of the senses;

4.146.s:
manaso'nigrahaścaiva krodha īrṣyātha matsaraḥ ..
daṃbhaḥ śāṭhyaṃ ca dhaurtyaṃ ca kaṭukoktiḥ pramādatā .. 9 ..
4.146.d:
मनसोऽनिग्रहश्चैव क्रोध ईर्ष्याथ मत्सरः ॥
दंभः शाठ्यं च धौर्त्यं च कटुकोक्तिः प्रमादता ॥ 9 ॥
4.146.m: Lack of control over the mind, anger, envy, and malice; / hypocrisy, deceit, knavery, bitter speech, negligence;

4.146.s:
bhāryāmātṛsutādīnāṃ tyāgaścāpūjya pūjanam ..
śrāddhahānirjapatyāgaḥ paṃcayajñavivarjanam .. 4.146.10 ..
4.146.d:
भार्यामातृसुतादीनां त्यागश्चापूज्य पूजनम् ॥
श्राद्धहानिर्जपत्यागः पंचयज्ञविवर्जनम् ॥ 4.146.10 ॥
4.146.m: Abandonment of wife, mother, son, and others, and worshipping the unworthy of worship; / omission of ancestral rites, abandoning silent prayer, neglect of the five daily sacrifices;

4.146.s:
saṃdhyātarpaṇahomānāṃ hāniragneḥ praṇāśanam ..
anṛtau maithunaṃ pārtha parvaṇyapi ca maithunam .. 11 ..
4.146.d:
संध्यातर्पणहोमानां हानिरग्नेः प्रणाशनम् ॥
अनृतौ मैथुनं पार्थ पर्वण्यपि च मैथुनम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.146.m: Loss of twilight devotions, libations, and fire-oblations; extinction of the sacred fire; / sexual intercourse outside the fertile period, O king, and intercourse on sacred days;

4.146.s:
paiśunyaṃ paradāreṣu dānaṃ veśyābhigāmitā ..
apātradānaṃ cālpaṃ ca mūlikākulibhakṣaṇam .. 12 ..
4.146.d:
पैशुन्यं परदारेषु दानं वेश्याभिगामिता ॥
अपात्रदानं चाल्पं च मूलिकाकुलिभक्षणम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.146.m: Malicious gossip, giving gifts for another's wife, consorting with courtesans, / giving gifts to the unworthy, and eating little or forbidden roots;

4.146.s:
aṃtyajāgamanaṃ mātṛtyāgaḥ pitṛvivarjanam ..
pitrorabhaktirvādaśca purāṇasmṛtivarjanam .. 13 ..
4.146.d:
अंत्यजागमनं मातृत्यागः पितृविवर्जनम् ॥
पित्रोरभक्तिर्वादश्च पुराणस्मृतिवर्जनम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.146.m: Intercourse with outcaste women, abandoning the mother, forsaking the father, / lack of devotion to parents and arguing [with them], abandoning the Purāṇas and Smṛtis;

4.146.s:
abhakṣyabhojanaṃ cāpi patidroho'vicāratā ..
kṛṣikarmakriyāvāhaṃ bhāryāsaṃgrahakāritā .. 14 ..
4.146.d:
अभक्ष्यभोजनं चापि पतिद्रोहोऽविचारता ॥
कृषिकर्मक्रियावाहं भार्यासंग्रहकारिता ॥ 14 ॥
4.146.m: Eating forbidden food, betrayal of one's master, thoughtlessness, / [unauthorized] engagement in agriculture, procurement of wives;

4.146.s:
iṃdriyājayamāyitvaṃ vidyāvismaraṇaṃ tathā ..
śāstratyāga ṛṇaṃ citrakarma cānaṃgadhāvanam .. 15 ..
4.146.d:
इंद्रियाजयमायित्वं विद्याविस्मरणं तथा ॥
शास्त्रत्याग ऋणं चित्रकर्म चानंगधावनम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.146.m: Non-restraint of the senses, fraudulence, forgetting sacred knowledge, / abandoning the scriptures, incurring debt, strange acts, and pursuit of lust;

4.146.s:
bhāryāputrasutādīnāṃ vikrayaḥ paśumaithunam..
indhanārthaṃ drumacchedo bile vāryādipūraṇam .. 16 ..
4.146.d:
भार्यापुत्रसुतादीनां विक्रयः पशुमैथुनम्॥
इन्धनार्थं द्रुमच्छेदो बिले वार्यादिपूरणम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.146.m: Selling one's wife, son, daughter, and others; bestiality; / cutting trees for firewood; filling a hole with water and the like;

4.146.s:
taḍāgāgamane vṛttaṃ vidyāvikrayakāritā ..
vṛttilopo mahīpāla yācakatvaṃ kumitratā .. 17 ..
4.146.d:
तडागागमने वृत्तं विद्याविक्रयकारिता ॥
वृत्तिलोपो महीपाल याचकत्वं कुमित्रता ॥ 17 ॥
4.146.m: Conduct regarding approach to reservoirs; selling knowledge; / loss of livelihood, O protector of the earth; mendicancy; keeping bad company;

4.146.s:
strīvadho govadhaścaiva paurohityaṃ suhṛdvadhaḥ ..
bhrūṇahatyā parānnaṃ ca śūdrānnasya niṣevaṇam .. 18 ..
4.146.d:
स्त्रीवधो गोवधश्चैव पौरोहित्यं सुहृद्वधः ॥
भ्रूणहत्या परान्नं च शूद्रान्नस्य निषेवणम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.146.m: Killing a woman, killing a cow, officiating for the unworthy, killing a friend, / killing an embryo, eating another's food, and consumption of a Śūdra's food;

4.146.s:
śūdrasya cāgnikarmatvamavidhitvaṃ kuputratā ..
vidvadbhyo yācakatvaṃ hi vācāṭatvaṃ pratigrahaḥ .. 19 ..
4.146.d:
शूद्रस्य चाग्निकर्मत्वमविधित्वं कुपुत्रता ॥
विद्वद्भ्यो याचकत्वं हि वाचाटत्वं प्रतिग्रहः ॥ 19 ॥
4.146.m: A Śūdra performing fire-rituals, lack of proper ritual, being a bad son, / begging from the learned, loquacity, and accepting improper gifts;

4.146.s:
śrautasaṃskāra dīnatvamārtatrāṇavivarjanam ..
brahmahatyāsurāpānarukmastainyamataḥ param .. 4.146.20 ..
4.146.d:
श्रौतसंस्कार दीनत्वमार्तत्राणविवर्जनम् ॥
ब्रह्महत्यासुरापानरुक्मस्तैन्यमतः परम् ॥ 4.146.20 ॥
4.146.m: Deficiency in Vedic rites, abandonment of protecting the distressed, / killing a Brahmin, drinking spirituous liquor, theft of gold; beyond this,

4.146.s:
gurudārābhigāmitvaṃ saṃyogaścāpi taiḥ saha ..
aparādhaśataṃ tvetatkathitaṃ te mayānagha .. 21 ..
4.146.d:
गुरुदाराभिगामित्वं संयोगश्चापि तैः सह ॥
अपराधशतं त्वेतत्कथितं ते मयानघ ॥ 21 ॥
4.146.m: Sexual intercourse with the guru's wife, and association with such [sinners]— / this hundred of transgressions has been declared to you by me, O sinless one.

4.146.s:
anye'pi vividhāḥ saṃti proktāḥ prādhānyatastvamī ..
yadi vaktrasahasrāṇi vaktre jihvāśatāni ca .. 22 ..
4.146.d:
अन्येऽपि विविधाः संति प्रोक्ताः प्राधान्यतस्त्वमी ॥
यदि वक्त्रसहस्राणि वक्त्रे जिह्वाशतानि च ॥ 22 ॥
4.146.m: There are also other diverse kinds, but these have been spoken by way of prominence. / Even if one had a thousand mouths and a hundred tongues in each mouth,

4.146.s:
tathāpyete na śakyaṃte vaktuṃ yasmādanaṃtakāḥ ..
aparādhasahasrāṇi lakṣakoṭiśatāni ca .. 23 ..
4.146.d:
तथाप्येते न शक्यंते वक्तुं यस्मादनंतकाः ॥
अपराधसहस्राणि लक्षकोटिशतानि च ॥ 23 ॥
4.146.m: Even so, they cannot be spoken, because they are endless. / Thousands, hundreds of thousands, and hundreds of millions of transgressions

4.146.s:
naśyaṃti tatkṣaṇānnūnaṃ satyeśasyānupūjanāt ..
pūjye bhagavānatra kṛtakṛtye parājite .. 24 ..
4.146.d:
नश्यंति तत्क्षणान्नूनं सत्येशस्यानुपूजनात् ॥
पूज्ये भगवानत्र कृतकृत्ये पराजिते ॥ 24 ॥
4.146.m: Are surely destroyed in that very instant by worshipping Satyeśa. / The Lord is to be worshipped here as one whose purpose is accomplished, undefeated;

4.146.s:
dhvaje satye sthitaścāyaṃ lakṣmyā saha jagatpatiḥ ..
vāmadevastataḥ pūrvaṃ nṛsiṃho dakṣiṇe sthitaḥ ..25 ..
4.146.d:
ध्वजे सत्ये स्थितश्चायं लक्ष्म्या सह जगत्पतिः ॥
वामदेवस्ततः पूर्वं नृसिंहो दक्षिणे स्थितः ॥25 ॥
4.146.m: And he, the Lord of the universe, abides on the banner of truth together with Lakṣmī. / Vāmadeva is in the east, Nṛsiṃha is situated in the south,

4.146.s:
kapilaḥ paścimāsye tu vārāhaścottare sthitaḥ..
ūrdhvavaktro'cyuto jñeya etadvai brahmapaṃcakam .. 26 ..
4.146.d:
कपिलः पश्चिमास्ये तु वाराहश्चोत्तरे स्थितः॥
ऊर्ध्ववक्त्रोऽच्युतो ज्ञेय एतद्वै ब्रह्मपंचकम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.146.m: Kapila is in the western face, and Vārāha is situated in the north; / Acyuta is to be known as the upward face: this indeed is the group of five Brahmans.

4.146.s:
taṃ satyeśaṃ sthitaṃ rājanpūjayecca sadaiva hi ..
kṣīrodayārdhacandrasthapadmakarṇikasaṃsthitam .. 27 ..
4.146.d:
तं सत्येशं स्थितं राजन्पूजयेच्च सदैव हि ॥
क्षीरोदयार्धचन्द्रस्थपद्मकर्णिकसंस्थितम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.146.m: One should always worship that Satyeśa abiding there, O king, / who is situated on the pericarp of a lotus resting on the crescent moon arising from the milk-ocean,

4.146.s:
padmakaumodakīśaṃkhacakrāyudhavidhāraṇam ..
vāme cādhastathā dakṣe ūrdhve paścādadho nṛpa .. 28 ..
4.146.d:
पद्मकौमोदकीशंखचक्रायुधविधारणम् ॥
वामे चाधस्तथा दक्षे ऊर्ध्वे पश्चादधो नृप ॥ 28 ॥
4.146.m: Holding the lotus, the Kaumodakī club, the conch, and the discus as weapons, / on the lower left, on the right, above, and then below, O king.

4.146.s:
pādādhastādviniṣkrāṃtā gaṃgā pūtā sadā nṛbhiḥ ..
śaktyaṣṭakaṃ tathā cānyattannāmāni ca me śṛṇu .. 29 ..
4.146.d:
पादाधस्ताद्विनिष्क्रांता गंगा पूता सदा नृभिः ॥
शक्त्यष्टकं तथा चान्यत्तन्नामानि च मे शृणु ॥ 29 ॥
4.146.m: From beneath his feet emerges the Gaṅgā, ever purified by men; / and there is another group of eight Śaktis; listen to their names from me:

4.146.s:
jayā ca vijayā caiva jayaṃtī pāpanāśinī..
unmīlinī vaṃjulī ca trispṛśātha vivarddhanā ..4.146.30..
4.146.d:
जया च विजया चैव जयंती पापनाशिनी॥
उन्मीलिनी वंजुली च त्रिस्पृशाथ विवर्द्धना ॥4.146.30॥
4.146.m: Jayā, Vijayā, Jayantī, Pāpanāśinī, / Unmīlinī, Vañjulī, Trispṛśā, and Vivardhanā.

4.146.s:
etābhiḥ śaktibhiryuktaṃ lokadikpālavarjitam ..
śuklāṃbaradharaṃ saumyaṃ prahṛṣṭavadanaṃ śivam .. .. 31 ..
4.146.d:
एताभिः शक्तिभिर्युक्तं लोकदिक्पालवर्जितम् ॥
शुक्लांबरधरं सौम्यं प्रहृष्टवदनं शिवम् ॥ ॥ 31 ॥
4.146.m: Endowed with these Śaktis, devoid of the world guardians and guardians of the directions, / wearing white garments, gentle, with a delighted face, auspicious,

4.146.s:
sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ harim ..
pūjayecca prayatnena vidhinā yena taṃ śṛṇu .. 32 ..
4.146.d:
सर्वाभरणशोभाढ्यं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं हरिम् ॥
पूजयेच्च प्रयत्नेन विधिना येन तं शृणु ॥ 32 ॥
4.146.m: Abundantly adorned with all ornaments, bestowing enjoyment and liberation, Hari— / one should worship him with effort; hear the rite by which [it is done].

4.146.s:
mārgaśīrṣādimāseṣu dvādaśasvapi sarvadā ..
dvādaśyāmapyamāyāṃ vā aṣṭamyāṃ ca sitāsite .. 33 ..
4.146.d:
मार्गशीर्षादिमासेषु द्वादशस्वपि सर्वदा ॥
द्वादश्यामप्यमायां वा अष्टम्यां च सितासिते ॥ 33 ॥
4.146.m: In the twelve months beginning with Mārgaśīrṣa, always / on the twelfth, on the new moon, or on the eighth, bright or dark,

4.146.s:
kṛtopavāsaḥ śuddhātmā kuryādvratamataṃdritaḥ ..
pakṣayorubhayorevaṃ pūjaye'haṃ janārdanam .. 34 ..
4.146.d:
कृतोपवासः शुद्धात्मा कुर्याद्व्रतमतंद्रितः ॥
पक्षयोरुभयोरेवं पूजयेऽहं जनार्दनम् ॥ 34 ॥
4.146.m: Having observed a fast, pure in mind, unwearied, one should perform the observance: / 'In both fortnights, thus shall I worship Janārdana.'

4.146.s:
evaṃ tu niyamaṃ kṛtvā daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam ..
gacchettatastaḍāge vā puṣkariṇyāṃ gṛhe'pi vā .. 35 ..
4.146.d:
एवं तु नियमं कृत्वा दंतधावनपूर्वकम् ॥
गच्छेत्ततस्तडागे वा पुष्करिण्यां गृहेऽपि वा ॥ 35 ॥
4.146.m: Having made such a resolve preceded by cleaning the teeth, / he should then go to a pond, a lotus lake, or even in the house.

4.146.s:
snātvā tu naityakaṃ karma kṛtvā naimittikaṃ tataḥ ..
kuryātsarvaṃ prayatnena yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ .. 36 ..
4.146.d:
स्नात्वा तु नैत्यकं कर्म कृत्वा नैमित्तिकं ततः ॥
कुर्यात्सर्वं प्रयत्नेन यथावदनुपूर्वशः ॥ 36 ॥
4.146.m: Having bathed and performed the obligatory rites, and then the occasional rites, / one should carefully carry out everything in proper order according to rule.

4.146.s:
sauvarṇaṃ kārayeddevaṃ pūrvoktaṃ satyarūpiṇam ..
śaktyaṣṭakayutaṃ lakṣmyā yuktaṃ padmāsanasthayā .. 37 ..
4.146.d:
सौवर्णं कारयेद्देवं पूर्वोक्तं सत्यरूपिणम् ॥
शक्त्यष्टकयुतं लक्ष्म्या युक्तं पद्मासनस्थया ॥ 37 ॥
4.146.m: One should cause to be made a golden image of the god, as previously described, whose nature is truth, / endowed with the eight powers, and joined with Lakṣmī seated upon a lotus.

4.146.s:
suvarṇapalamānena kāryametatsavistaram ..
dugdhakuṃbhopariṣṭāttu svarṇapadmaṃ prakalpayet .. 38 ..
4.146.d:
सुवर्णपलमानेन कार्यमेतत्सविस्तरम् ॥
दुग्धकुंभोपरिष्टात्तु स्वर्णपद्मं प्रकल्पयेत् ॥ 38 ॥
4.146.m: This should be made fully with the weight of a pala of gold. / Then, upon a pot filled with milk, one should place a golden lotus.

4.146.s:
tatkarṇikāgataṃ devaṃ śaktivṛndasamanvitam ..
pūjayedvidhivatpaścādgurumaṃtrapracoditaḥ .. 39 ..
4.146.d:
तत्कर्णिकागतं देवं शक्तिवृन्दसमन्वितम् ॥
पूजयेद्विधिवत्पश्चाद्गुरुमंत्रप्रचोदितः ॥ 39 ॥
4.146.m: Upon the deity seated on its pericarp, accompanied by the host of śaktis, / one should afterward worship according to rule, inspired by the guru's mantra:

4.146.s:
śuddhaśuklāṃbaradharo maṃtrasaṃbhārasaṃsthitaḥ ..
devakṣīrasamudre'sminvṛtte candre ca puṣkare ..
tatra tvaṃ satyayā sārddhaṃ satyeśa bhava sannidhau .. 4.146.40 ..
4.146.d:
शुद्धशुक्लांबरधरो मंत्रसंभारसंस्थितः ॥
देवक्षीरसमुद्रेऽस्मिन्वृत्ते चन्द्रे च पुष्करे ॥
तत्र त्वं सत्यया सार्द्धं सत्येश भव सन्निधौ ॥ 4.146.40 ॥
4.146.m: "Wearing pure white garments, present with all the materials of worship, / in this divine ocean of milk, in the circle, the moon, and the lotus, / there be present, O Lord of truth, together with Satyā!

4.146.s:
oṃ kṣīrasāgarakallole snāhi pāpaniṣūdana ..
anena bhūtabhavyena dattena jalabindunā .. 41 ..
4.146.d:
ओं क्षीरसागरकल्लोले स्नाहि पापनिषूदन ॥
अनेन भूतभव्येन दत्तेन जलबिन्दुना ॥ 41 ॥
4.146.m: Oṃ! Bathe in the waves of the milk ocean, O destroyer of sins! / By this drop of water, representing past and future, offered [to you],

4.146.s:
harasva sarvaṃ duritaṃ mama nātha janārdana ..
vastradānena śubhreṇa satyeśa kuru me śubham .. 42 ..
4.146.d:
हरस्व सर्वं दुरितं मम नाथ जनार्दन ॥
वस्त्रदानेन शुभ्रेण सत्येश कुरु मे शुभम् ॥ 42 ॥
4.146.m: take away all my misfortune, O Lord Janārdana! / By the gift of a white garment, O Lord of truth, grant me good fortune!

4.146.s:
yajñe yoge tathā sāṃkhye pavitrastvaṃ sadocyase ..
yajñopavītadānena kuru māṃ sarvapāvanam .. 43 ..
4.146.d:
यज्ञे योगे तथा सांख्ये पवित्रस्त्वं सदोच्यसे ॥
यज्ञोपवीतदानेन कुरु मां सर्वपावनम् ॥ 43 ॥
4.146.m: In sacrifice, in Yoga, and likewise in Sāṃkhya, you are always called the purifier; / by the gift of a sacred thread, make me completely pure!

4.146.s:
viliptaṃ karmaṇā sarvaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ na kenacit ..
mama candanaliptāṃgaḥ sarvalepāpaho bhava .. 44 ..
4.146.d:
विलिप्तं कर्मणा सर्वं सत्यं सत्यं न केनचित् ॥
मम चन्दनलिप्तांगः सर्वलेपापहो भव ॥ 44 ॥
4.146.m: Everything is smeared by action; truth, truth is smeared by nothing! / With limbs smeared with sandalwood paste for me, remove all defilements from me!

4.146.s:
satyanātha namastubhyaṃ mūrtāmūrtasvarūpiṇe ..
vāsudeva nṛsiṃhākhya kapilādivyabhūdhara .. 45 ..
4.146.d:
सत्यनाथ नमस्तुभ्यं मूर्तामूर्तस्वरूपिणे ॥
वासुदेव नृसिंहाख्य कपिलादिव्यभूधर ॥ 45 ॥
4.146.m: O Lord of truth, praise to you whose nature is both manifest and unmanifest! / O Vāsudeva, named Nṛsiṃha, O divine bearer of the earth beginning with Kapila,

4.146.s:
vārāhācyuta yajñeśa lakṣmīkāṃta nṛpeśvara ..
paśuṃ putraṃ ca me dehi pāpaśatro niraṃjana .. 46 ..
4.146.d:
वाराहाच्युत यज्ञेश लक्ष्मीकांत नृपेश्वर ॥
पशुं पुत्रं च मे देहि पापशत्रो निरंजन ॥ 46 ॥
4.146.m: O Boar, O Acyuta, O Lord of sacrifice, O beloved of Lakṣmī, O King of kings, / grant me cattle and a son, O enemy of sin, O stainless one!

4.146.s:
saṃkarṣaṇa mahāvīrya sarveśāmitavikrama ..
aniruddhendra govinda dhṛtacakra namo'stu te .. 47 .. (iti pūjāmaṃtraḥ)
4.146.d:
संकर्षण महावीर्य सर्वेशामितविक्रम ॥
अनिरुद्धेन्द्र गोविन्द धृतचक्र नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 47 ॥ (इति पूजामंत्रः)
4.146.m: O Saṃkarṣaṇa of great valour, O Lord of all, of boundless might, / O Aniruddha, O Indra, O Govinda, bearer of the discus, praise to you!" (Thus the worship mantra)

4.146.s:
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa prabho rāmarāma kṛṣṇa vibho hare ..
trāhi māṃ sarvaduḥkhebhyo ramayā saha mādhava .. 48 ..
4.146.d:
कृष्णकृष्ण प्रभो रामराम कृष्ण विभो हरे ॥
त्राहि मां सर्वदुःखेभ्यो रमया सह माधव ॥ 48 ॥
4.146.m: "O Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, O Lord! O Rāma, Rāma, Kṛṣṇa, O all-pervading Hari! / Protect me from all sufferings together with Ramā, O Mādhava!

4.146.s:
pūjā ceyaṃ mayā dattā pitāmahajagadguro ..
gṛhāṇa jagadīśāna nārāyaṇa namo'stu te .. 49 ..
4.146.d:
पूजा चेयं मया दत्ता पितामहजगद्गुरो ॥
गृहाण जगदीशान नारायण नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 49 ॥
4.146.m: And this worship has been offered by me, O Grandfather, O Teacher of the world! / Accept it, O Ruler of the universe, O Nārāyaṇa, praise to you!"

4.146.s:
dhanaṃ guptaṃ mahīpāla sarvapāpāpanuttaye ..
ekasyaiva tu viprasya yāvadvarṣaṃ samarpayet .. 4.146.50 ..
4.146.d:
धनं गुप्तं महीपाल सर्वपापापनुत्तये ॥
एकस्यैव तु विप्रस्य यावद्वर्षं समर्पयेत् ॥ 4.146.50 ॥
4.146.m: For the removal of all sins, O protector of the earth, / one should bestow secret wealth on a single brāhmaṇa for as long as a year.

4.146.s:
dānaṃ dadyānmahārāja hyaśaktau tadabhāvataḥ ..
pakṣepakṣe prakartavyaṃ vratametanmahattaram .. 51 ..
4.146.d:
दानं दद्यान्महाराज ह्यशक्तौ तदभावतः ॥
पक्षेपक्षे प्रकर्तव्यं व्रतमेतन्महत्तरम् ॥ 51 ॥
4.146.m: One should give a gift, O great king, or in case of inability, in the absence of that, / this most eminent votive observance is to be performed fortnight after fortnight.

4.146.s:
saṃvatsare tataḥ pūrṇe kuryādudyāpanaṃ budhaḥ ..
pūrvavatpūjayedevaṃ bahusaṃbhāravi staraiḥ .. 52 ..
4.146.d:
संवत्सरे ततः पूर्णे कुर्यादुद्यापनं बुधः ॥
पूर्ववत्पूजयेदेवं बहुसंभारवि स्तरैः ॥ 52 ॥
4.146.m: Then, when a year has elapsed, the wise person should perform the concluding rite. / One should worship as before, with extensive and plentiful provisions.

4.146.s:
anujñāṃ prārthayedviprānpāpaghvaṃso mamāstu vai ..
pāpadhvaṃso'stu satataṃ taveti ca dvijo vadet .. 53 ..
4.146.d:
अनुज्ञां प्रार्थयेद्विप्रान्पापघ्वंसो ममास्तु वै ॥
पापध्वंसोऽस्तु सततं तवेति च द्विजो वदेत् ॥ 53 ॥
4.146.m: One should pray to the brāhmaṇas for permission: "May my sins indeed be destroyed!" / And the twice-born should say: "May your sins be destroyed forever!"

4.146.s:
tataḥ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇāya samarpya ca kṣamāpayet ..
asminvrate kṛte rājanbhavedbahuphalodayaḥ .. 54 ..
4.146.d:
ततः सर्वं ब्राह्मणाय समर्प्य च क्षमापयेत् ॥
अस्मिन्व्रते कृते राजन्भवेद्बहुफलोदयः ॥ 54 ॥
4.146.m: Then, presenting everything to the brāhmaṇa, one should ask for his forgiveness. / When this votive observance is performed, O king, there arises an abundance of fruits.

4.146.s:
yatphalaṃ sarvavedeṣu sarvatīrtheṣu yatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ vratasyāsya niṣevaṇāt .. 55 ..
4.146.d:
यत्फलं सर्ववेदेषु सर्वतीर्थेषु यत्फलम् ॥
तत्फलं कोटिगुणितं व्रतस्यास्य निषेवणात् ॥ 55 ॥
4.146.m: Whatever fruit is found in all the Vedas, whatever fruit is in all sacred bathing places, / that fruit is multiplied ten million times through the practice of this votive observance.

4.146.s:
ihaloke dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ putramitrasukhādikam ..
prāpnoti puruṣaḥ samyagvidyārogyakalāyudham .. 56 ..
4.146.d:
इहलोके धनं धान्यं पुत्रमित्रसुखादिकम् ॥
प्राप्नोति पुरुषः सम्यग्विद्यारोग्यकलायुधम् ॥ 56 ॥
4.146.m: In this world, a man attains wealth, grain, sons, friends, happiness, and other blessings, / along with learning, health, arts, and longevity.

4.146.s:
dharmamatha ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca nṛpasattama ..
labhate nātra saṃdeho brahmaṇo vacanaṃ yathā .. 57 ..
4.146.d:
धर्ममथ च कामं च मोक्षं च नृपसत्तम ॥
लभते नात्र संदेहो ब्रह्मणो वचनं यथा ॥ 57 ॥
4.146.m: Dharma, artha, kāma, and liberation, O best of kings, / he obtains without any doubt, in accordance with the word of Brahmā.

4.146.s:
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ..
yaḥ kuryātpunaretaddhi so'nantaphalabhāgbhavet .. 58 ..
4.146.d:
यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
यः कुर्यात्पुनरेतद्धि सोऽनन्तफलभाग्भवेत् ॥ 58 ॥
4.146.m: Whoever recites or even listens to it is freed from all sins; / and whoever actually performs it comes to share in an endless reward.

4.146.s:
aśaktastu tathā śakto vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ..
vrataṃ kurvannaro bhaktyā labhate śāśvataṃ padam .. 59 ..
4.146.d:
अशक्तस्तु तथा शक्तो वित्तशाठ्यविवर्जितः ॥
व्रतं कुर्वन्नरो भक्त्या लभते शाश्वतं पदम् ॥ 59 ॥
4.146.m: Whether unable or able, free from deceit regarding wealth, / a man performing this votive observance with devotion attains the eternal abode.

4.146.s:
kṛte vai kriyamāṇe tu kartā phalamavāpnuyāt ..
aparādhaśatāghaughaṃ vratenānena nāśayet .. 4.146.60 ..
kāñcanavratavarṇanam
4.146.d:
कृते वै क्रियमाणे तु कर्ता फलमवाप्नुयात् ॥
अपराधशताघौघं व्रतेनानेन नाशयेत् ॥ 4.146.60 ॥
काञ्चनव्रतवर्णनम्
4.146.m:
Whether it has been performed or is being performed, the doer attains the reward; / he destroys a multitude of sins consisting of hundreds of offences by means of this votive observance.
Description of the Golden Votive Observance

4.147.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śvetadvīpe sukhāsīnaṃ devadevaṃ jagatprabhum ..
vāsudevaṃ jagannāthaṃ sthitisaṃyamakārakam .. 1 ..
4.147.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
श्वेतद्वीपे सुखासीनं देवदेवं जगत्प्रभुम् ॥
वासुदेवं जगन्नाथं स्थितिसंयमकारकम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.147.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / To the god of gods, the lord of the universe, comfortably seated in Śvetadvīpa, / Vāsudeva, master of the universe, who causes maintenance and dissolution,

4.147.s:
parāvarāṇāṃ sraṣṭāraṃ purāṇaṃ paramavyayam ..
ādidevaṃ jagannāthaṃ jagataḥ kāraṇātma kam.. 2 ..
4.147.d:
परावराणां स्रष्टारं पुराणं परमव्ययम् ॥
आदिदेवं जगन्नाथं जगतः कारणात्म कम्॥ 2 ॥
4.147.m: the creator of higher and lower beings, ancient, supreme, imperishable, / the primordial god, master of the universe, the material cause of the world,

4.147.s:
praṇipatya mahādevaṃ carācaraguruṃ harim ..
lakṣmīḥ provāca rājendra pādasaṃvāhane sthitā .. 3 ..
4.147.d:
प्रणिपत्य महादेवं चराचरगुरुं हरिम् ॥
लक्ष्मीः प्रोवाच राजेन्द्र पादसंवाहने स्थिता ॥ 3 ॥
4.147.m: having bowed down to the great god Hari, the teacher of the moving and unmoving, / Lakṣmī, engaged in massaging his feet, said, O lord of kings:

4.147.s:
bhagavandevadeveśa bhaktānāmanukampaka ..
praṣṭavyaṃ kiñcidicchāmi praṣṭuṃ praśnavidāṃ vara .. 4 ..
4.147.d:
भगवन्देवदेवेश भक्तानामनुकम्पक ॥
प्रष्टव्यं किञ्चिदिच्छामि प्रष्टुं प्रश्नविदां वर ॥ 4 ॥
4.147.m: "O Lord, ruler of the gods, compassionate toward your devotees, / there is something I wish to ask, O best of those who know how to answer questions.

4.147.s:
prakuruṣva mahābhāga dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari ..
vrataṃ kiñcitkathaya me rūpasaubhāgyadāyakam .. 5 ..
4.147.d:
प्रकुरुष्व महाभाग दयां कृत्वा ममोपरि ॥
व्रतं किञ्चित्कथय मे रूपसौभाग्यदायकम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.147.m: Show mercy upon me, O fortunate one, / and tell me of a votive observance that bestows beauty and good fortune,

4.147.s:
uttamaṃ sarvavarṇānāṃ vratānāmapi cottamam..
kṛtena yena deveśa sarvatīrthaphalaṃ bhavet .. 6 ..
4.147.d:
उत्तमं सर्ववर्णानां व्रतानामपि चोत्तमम्॥
कृतेन येन देवेश सर्वतीर्थफलं भवेत् ॥ 6 ॥
4.147.m: the highest among all castes, and also the highest among votive observances, / by the performance of which, O Lord of gods, the fruit of all sacred bathing places is attained."

4.147.s:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
gṛhasthaścāśramāṇāṃ ca varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yathā ..
yathā nadīṣu sarvāsu jāhnavī lokaviśrutā .. 7 ..
4.147.d:
॥ विष्णुरुवाच ॥ ॥
गृहस्थश्चाश्रमाणां च वर्णानां ब्राह्मणो यथा ॥
यथा नदीषु सर्वासु जाह्नवी लोकविश्रुता ॥ 7 ॥
4.147.m: Viṣṇu said: / "Just as the householder is [highest] among the stages of life, and the brāhmaṇa among castes, / just as among all rivers the Ganges is renowned throughout the world,

4.147.s:
hradānāmudadhiḥ śreṣṭho devānāṃ viṣṇuruttamaḥ ..
strīṇāṃ devā yathā lakṣmīstathedaṃ vratamuttamam.. 8 ..
4.147.d:
ह्रदानामुदधिः श्रेष्ठो देवानां विष्णुरुत्तमः ॥
स्त्रीणां देवा यथा लक्ष्मीस्तथेदं व्रतमुत्तमम्॥ 8 ॥
4.147.m: just as the ocean is best among reservoirs of water, and Viṣṇu is supreme among gods, / just as you, Lakṣmī, are divine among women, so this votive observance is supreme.

4.147.s:
na gaṅgā na kurukṣetraṃ na kāśī na ca puṣkaram ..
pāvanāni mahābhāge yathedaṃ vratamuttamam .. 9 ..
4.147.d:
न गङ्गा न कुरुक्षेत्रं न काशी न च पुष्करम् ॥
पावनानि महाभागे यथेदं व्रतमुत्तमम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.147.m: Neither the Gaṅgā, nor Kurukṣetra, nor Kāśī, nor Puṣkara / are as purifying, O fortunate one, as this supreme votive observance.

4.147.s:
gauryā devyā kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā ..
rāmeṇa sītayā sārddhaṃ rājyaṃ prāpya kṛtaṃ purā .. 4.147.10 ..
4.147.d:
गौर्या देव्या कृतं पूर्वं शंकरेण महात्मना ॥
रामेण सीतया सार्द्धं राज्यं प्राप्य कृतं पुरा ॥ 4.147.10 ॥
4.147.m: It was performed of old by Goddess Gaurī, and by the high-souled Śaṅkara; / it was performed formerly by Rāma together with Sītā when he attained kingship;

4.147.s:
damayantīviyogena nalena tu tathā kṛtam ..
kṛṣṇayā sahitaiḥ pārtha pāṃḍavairvana vāsibhiḥ .. 11 ..
4.147.d:
दमयन्तीवियोगेन नलेन तु तथा कृतम् ॥
कृष्णया सहितैः पार्थ पांडवैर्वन वासिभिः ॥ 11 ॥
4.147.m: and it was likewise performed by Nala when separated from Damayantī; / by the Pāṇḍavas residing in the forest, accompanied by Draupadī, O Pārtha,

4.147.s:
kṛtametadvrataṃ bhadre svargamokṣapradāyakam ..
raṃbhayā menayā vāpi paulomyā satyabhāmayā .. 12 ..
4.147.d:
कृतमेतद्व्रतं भद्रे स्वर्गमोक्षप्रदायकम् ॥
रंभया मेनया वापि पौलोम्या सत्यभामया ॥ 12 ॥
4.147.m: this auspicious votive observance, granting heaven and liberation, was performed; / by Rambhā and Menakā, by Paulomī and Satyabhāmā,

4.147.s:
śāṃḍilyā cāpyarundhatyā urvaśyā devadattayā ..
kṛtaṃ vratamidaṃ bhadraṃ saubhāgyasukhakāmyayā .. 13 ..
4.147.d:
शांडिल्या चाप्यरुन्धत्या उर्वश्या देवदत्तया ॥
कृतं व्रतमिदं भद्रं सौभाग्यसुखकाम्यया ॥ 13 ॥
4.147.m: by Śāṇḍilyā and Arundhatī, by Urvaśī and Devadattā, / this auspicious votive observance was performed with the desire for good fortune and happiness;

4.147.s:
pātāle nāgakanyābhiḥ kṛtametatsuśobhanam ..
gāyatryā ca sarasvatyā sāvitryā brahmabhāryayā .. 14 ..
4.147.d:
पाताले नागकन्याभिः कृतमेतत्सुशोभनम् ॥
गायत्र्या च सरस्वत्या सावित्र्या ब्रह्मभार्यया ॥ 14 ॥
4.147.m: it was performed in Pātāla by the serpent maidens, very beautifully; / by Gāyatrī, Sarasvatī, and Sāvitrī the wife of Brahmā,

4.147.s:
anyābhiḥ sarvanārībhiḥ sarvakāmaphalepsubhiḥ ..
tasmātte'haṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 15 ..
4.147.d:
अन्याभिः सर्वनारीभिः सर्वकामफलेप्सुभिः ॥
तस्मात्तेऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.147.m: and by other women, all desiring the fruit of all their wishes. / Therefore I shall declare it to you, destroying all sins.

4.147.s:
vasuprītikaraṃ ramyaṃ vratānāṃ paramaṃ śṛṇu ..
brahmahā mucyate pāpātsurāpo vasuhārakaḥ .. 16 ..
4.147.d:
वसुप्रीतिकरं रम्यं व्रतानां परमं शृणु ॥
ब्रह्महा मुच्यते पापात्सुरापो वसुहारकः ॥ 16 ॥
4.147.m: Pleasing to the Vasus, delightful, supreme among votive observances, listen: / the killer of a brāhmaṇa is freed from sin, the drinker of liquor, the stealer of wealth,

4.147.s:
gurubhāryābhigāmī ca hyeteṣāṃ saṃgamī ca yaḥ ..
mānakūṭaṃ tulākūṭaṃ kanyāvṛttirgavāṃ vratī .. 17 ..
4.147.d:
गुरुभार्याभिगामी च ह्येतेषां संगमी च यः ॥
मानकूटं तुलाकूटं कन्यावृत्तिर्गवां व्रती ॥ 17 ॥
4.147.m: he who violates the guru's wife, and whoever associates with these; / one who cheats with measures, cheats with balances, lives off a daughter, or has pledged vows to cattle,

4.147.s:
agamyāgamano yastu māṃsāśī vṛṣalīpatiḥ ..
kuṇḍāgnibhojī yastu syādbhūbhihartā tathaiva ca .. 18 ..
4.147.d:
अगम्यागमनो यस्तु मांसाशी वृषलीपतिः ॥
कुण्डाग्निभोजी यस्तु स्याद्भूभिहर्ता तथैव च ॥ 18 ॥
4.147.m: one who approaches women not to be approached, who eats meat, the husband of a low-caste woman, / one who eats food offered into a sacrificial pit, and likewise a stealer of land—

4.147.s:
ebhiḥ sarvairmahāpāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
ebhiḥ syānnaranārībhiḥ kartavyaṃ vratamuttamam ..19..
4.147.d:
एभिः सर्वैर्महापापैर्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ॥
एभिः स्यान्नरनारीभिः कर्तव्यं व्रतमुत्तमम् ॥19॥
4.147.m: from all these great sins he is freed; there is no doubt of this. / Men and women should perform this excellent votive observance.

4.147.s:
ataste'haṃ vidhiṃ vakṣye vidhānamavadhāraya ..
kāñcanākhyā purī nāma vrataṃ trailokyaviśrutam .. 4.147.20 ..
4.147.d:
अतस्तेऽहं विधिं वक्ष्ये विधानमवधारय ॥
काञ्चनाख्या पुरी नाम व्रतं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् ॥ 4.147.20 ॥
4.147.m: Therefore I shall tell you the rule; listen to the injunction: / the votive observance named 'The Golden City' is famous throughout the three worlds.

4.147.s:
yaḥ karoti naro devi nārī vā bhaktisaṃyutā ..
tasya putrāśca pautrāśca jāyate vipulaṃ dhanam .. 21 ..
4.147.d:
यः करोति नरो देवि नारी वा भक्तिसंयुता ॥
तस्य पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च जायते विपुलं धनम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.147.m: Whichever man, O goddess, or woman endowed with devotion performs it, / to him sons and grandsons are born, and vast wealth.

4.147.s:
tasminmāse ca kartavyaṃ vratametacca sundari ..
tasminmāse ca kartavyā kāñcanākhyā purī śubhā .. 22 ..
4.147.d:
तस्मिन्मासे च कर्तव्यं व्रतमेतच्च सुन्दरि ॥
तस्मिन्मासे च कर्तव्या काञ्चनाख्या पुरी शुभा ॥ 22 ॥
4.147.m: In that month this votive observance is to be performed, O beautiful lady; / in that month the auspicious Golden City is to be prepared.

4.147.s:
śuklakṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāmekādaśyāṃ ca pūrṇimā ..
saṃkrāṃtirvā mahābhāge kuhūrvā cāṣṭamī tithiḥ .. 23 ..
4.147.d:
शुक्लकृष्णतृतीयायामेकादश्यां च पूर्णिमा ॥
संक्रांतिर्वा महाभागे कुहूर्वा चाष्टमी तिथिः ॥ 23 ॥
4.147.m: On the third lunar day of the bright or dark fortnight, on the eleventh, on the full moon, / on a solar transition, O fortunate one, on the new moon, or on the aṣṭamī lunar day,

4.147.s:
parvasvanyeṣu sarveṣu dātavyā kāñcanī purī ..
vratī snātvā tu pūrvāhṇe nadyādau vimale jale .. 24 ..
4.147.d:
पर्वस्वन्येषु सर्वेषु दातव्या काञ्चनी पुरी ॥
व्रती स्नात्वा तु पूर्वाह्णे नद्यादौ विमले जले ॥ 24 ॥
4.147.m: on all other festive occasions, the Golden City should be given. / Having bathed in the morning in the clear water of a river or similar watercourse, the performer of the votive observance

4.147.s:
mṛttikālaṃbhanaṃ kāryaṃ maṃtreṇānena suvrate ..
uddhṛtāsi yathāpūrvaṃ viṣṇunā kroḍarūpiṇā ..25..
4.147.d:
मृत्तिकालंभनं कार्यं मंत्रेणानेन सुव्रते ॥
उद्धृतासि यथापूर्वं विष्णुना क्रोडरूपिणा ॥25॥
4.147.m: should perform the touching of clay with this mantra, O lady of good vows: / 'As you were previously lifted up by Viṣṇu in the form of a boar,

4.147.s:
lokānāmupakārārthaṃ vandanātsiddhikāmadā ..
tasmāttvaṃ vaṃditā pāpaṃ hara me'nekajanmajam .. 26 .. ( iti mṛttikāmaṃtraḥ ..) ..
4.147.d:
लोकानामुपकारार्थं वन्दनात्सिद्धिकामदा ॥
तस्मात्त्वं वंदिता पापं हर मेऽनेकजन्मजम् ॥ 26 ॥ ( इति मृत्तिकामंत्रः ॥) ॥
4.147.m: for the benefit of the worlds, granting desired success through reverence, / therefore, praised by me, remove my sin born of many births.' (Thus the mantra for the clay.)

4.147.s:
āpastu viśvayonirhi viṣṇunā nirmitāḥ svayam ..
sānnidhyaṃ tīrthasahitaṃ kartavyaṃ mama sāṃpratam .. 27 .. ( ityammaṃtraḥ ..) ..
4.147.d:
आपस्तु विश्वयोनिर्हि विष्णुना निर्मिताः स्वयम् ॥
सान्निध्यं तीर्थसहितं कर्तव्यं मम सांप्रतम् ॥ 27 ॥ ( इत्यम्मंत्रः ॥) ॥
4.147.m: 'The waters are indeed the source of the universe, created by Viṣṇu himself; / their presence together with the sacred fords must now be brought about for me.' (Thus the mantra for the water.)

4.147.s:
anena vidhinā snātvā yajamānaḥ samāhitaḥ ..
gṛhamāgamya śuddhātmā nālapanpiśunāṃstva rāt .. 28 ..
4.147.d:
अनेन विधिना स्नात्वा यजमानः समाहितः ॥
गृहमागम्य शुद्धात्मा नालपन्पिशुनांस्त्व रात् ॥ 28 ॥
4.147.m: Having bathed according to this rule, composed, / having returned home, pure-minded, not speaking in haste to malicious persons,

4.147.s:
pākhaṃḍino vikarmasthāndhūrtāṃśca kitavācchaṭhān ..
prakṣālya pāṇivadanaṃ kuryāttvācamanaṃ tataḥ .. 29 ..
4.147.d:
पाखंडिनो विकर्मस्थान्धूर्तांश्च कितवाच्छठान् ॥
प्रक्षाल्य पाणिवदनं कुर्यात्त्वाचमनं ततः ॥ 29 ॥
4.147.m: heretics, those engaging in unlawful acts, rogues, gamblers, and cheats, / having washed his hands and face, he should then perform the sipping of water.

4.147.s:
upavāsasya niyamaṃ kuryānnaktasya vā punaḥ ..
śaṃkhapravaramādāya hemayuktaṃ jalairbhṛtam .. 4.147.30 ..
4.147.d:
उपवासस्य नियमं कुर्यान्नक्तस्य वा पुनः ॥
शंखप्रवरमादाय हेमयुक्तं जलैर्भृतम् ॥ 4.147.30 ॥
4.147.m: He should undertake the restriction of fasting, or else of a nocturnal meal. / Taking an excellent conch containing gold and filled with water,

4.147.s:
dvādaśākṣaramaṃtreṇa tajjalaṃ cābhimaṃtrayet ..
pibetto'yaṃ gṛhe gatvā harirityakṣaraṃ japet .. 31 ..
4.147.d:
द्वादशाक्षरमंत्रेण तज्जलं चाभिमंत्रयेत् ॥
पिबेत्तोऽयं गृहे गत्वा हरिरित्यक्षरं जपेत् ॥ 31 ॥
4.147.m: he should consecrate that water with the twelve-syllable mantra. / Having gone into the house, he should drink the water and repeat the syllable 'Hari'.

4.147.s:
śamīvṛkṣamayā vedī catuḥstaṃbhasamanvitā ..
caturhastapramāṇena kāryyā caiva suśobhanā .. 32 ..
4.147.d:
शमीवृक्षमया वेदी चतुःस्तंभसमन्विता ॥
चतुर्हस्तप्रमाणेन कार्य्या चैव सुशोभना ॥ 32 ॥
4.147.m: An altar made of the wood of the śamī tree, equipped with four pillars, / measuring four cubits, very beautiful, should be made.

4.147.s:
vastreṇāveṣṭitāḥ stambhā vitānavara maṇḍitāḥ ..
puṣpamālānvitāḥ kāryā divyadhūpādhivāsitāḥ .. 33 ..
4.147.d:
वस्त्रेणावेष्टिताः स्तम्भा वितानवर मण्डिताः ॥
पुष्पमालान्विताः कार्या दिव्यधूपाधिवासिताः ॥ 33 ॥
4.147.m: The pillars should be wrapped in cloth, adorned with an excellent canopy, / provided with flower garlands, and perfumed with divine incense.

4.147.s:
madhye tu maṃḍalaṃ kāryaṃ padmākhyaṃ varṇakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
yena dṛṣṭena deveśi sarvapāpa kṣayo bhavet ..
maṃḍalasya tu madhye vai bhadrapīṭhaṃ suśobhanam .. 34 ..
4.147.d:
मध्ये तु मंडलं कार्यं पद्माख्यं वर्णकैः शुभैः ॥
येन दृष्टेन देवेशि सर्वपाप क्षयो भवेत् ॥
मंडलस्य तु मध्ये वै भद्रपीठं सुशोभनम् ॥ 34 ॥
4.147.m: In the middle, a maṇḍala called the lotus should be made with auspicious pigments, / upon seeing which, O ruler of gods, all sins are destroyed. / In the middle of the maṇḍala, an auspicious seat of honour,

4.147.s:
āsanaṃ tatra vinyasya komalaṃ vastraveṣṭitam ..
tasyopari nyaseddevaṃ lakṣmyā yuktaṃ janārdanam .. 35 ..
4.147.d:
आसनं तत्र विन्यस्य कोमलं वस्त्रवेष्टितम् ॥
तस्योपरि न्यसेद्देवं लक्ष्म्या युक्तं जनार्दनम् ॥ 35 ॥
4.147.m: a soft seat wrapped in cloth, should be placed there. / Upon it he should place the god Janārdana accompanied by Lakṣmī.

4.147.s:
agre tu kalaśaḥ kāryo jalapūrṇaḥ suśobhanaḥ ..
kṣīrasāgaranāmā sa kalpitavyaḥ prayatnataḥ .. 36 ..
4.147.d:
अग्रे तु कलशः कार्यो जलपूर्णः सुशोभनः ॥
क्षीरसागरनामा स कल्पितव्यः प्रयत्नतः ॥ 36 ॥
4.147.m: In front, a very beautiful jar filled with water should be prepared; / it should be carefully conceived as bearing the name of the Ocean of Milk.

4.147.s:
pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ vastreṇāve ṣṭayeddhanam ..
kumbhaṃ prapūrṇamudakaistasyopari nyasedbudhaḥ .. 37 ..
4.147.d:
पञ्चरत्नसमायुक्तं वस्त्रेणावे ष्टयेद्धनम् ॥
कुम्भं प्रपूर्णमुदकैस्तस्योपरि न्यसेद्बुधः ॥ 37 ॥
4.147.m: Equipped with the five gems, he should wrap the precious object with cloth; / the wise person should place a pot filled with water upon it.

4.147.s:
tasyopariṣṭātsaṃsthāpya kāṃcanākhyāṃ purīṃ śubhām..
catuṣpalā hyuttamā syāddvipalā madhyamā smṛtā .. 38 ..
4.147.d:
तस्योपरिष्टात्संस्थाप्य कांचनाख्यां पुरीं शुभाम्॥
चतुष्पला ह्युत्तमा स्याद्द्विपला मध्यमा स्मृता ॥ 38 ॥
4.147.m: Having established upon it the auspicious Golden City— / four palas in weight is excellent, two palas is considered middling,

4.147.s:
sāmānyaikapalā kāryā kalaśaistu samanvitā ..
modakānsthāpayeddivyānsamaṃtātsuṃdarākṛtīn .. 39 ..
4.147.d:
सामान्यैकपला कार्या कलशैस्तु समन्विता ॥
मोदकान्स्थापयेद्दिव्यान्समंतात्सुंदराकृतीन् ॥ 39 ॥
4.147.m: the ordinary one should be made of one pala—furnished with jars, / he should place divine modakas of beautiful shape all around.

4.147.s:
tadagre kadalīstambhaistoraṇaṃ parikalpayet ..
cātuścaraṇikāṃstatra viprānāvāhya suṃdari .. 4.147.40 ..
4.147.d:
तदग्रे कदलीस्तम्भैस्तोरणं परिकल्पयेत् ॥
चातुश्चरणिकांस्तत्र विप्रानावाह्य सुंदरि ॥ 4.147.40 ॥
4.147.m: In front of it, he should construct an archway with banana trunks. / Having invited there Brahmins learned in the four branches of the Veda, O beautiful lady,

4.147.s:
pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayettasya vedamantraiḥ suśobhanaiḥ ..
tasyā madhye nyasedviṣṇuṃ haimaṃ lakṣmyā samanvitam .. 41 ..
4.147.d:
प्रतिष्ठां कारयेत्तस्य वेदमन्त्रैः सुशोभनैः ॥
तस्या मध्ये न्यसेद्विष्णुं हैमं लक्ष्म्या समन्वितम् ॥ 41 ॥
4.147.m: he should have its consecration performed with auspicious Vedic mantras. / In its centre he should place a golden Viṣṇu accompanied by Lakṣmī.

4.147.s:
netre ratnamaye kārye daśanā vajrabhūṣitāḥ ..
muktāphalamayaṃ tasya bhūṣaṇaṃ parikalpayet .. 42 ..
4.147.d:
नेत्रे रत्नमये कार्ये दशना वज्रभूषिताः ॥
मुक्ताफलमयं तस्य भूषणं परिकल्पयेत् ॥ 42 ॥
4.147.m: The two eyes should be made of jewels; the teeth adorned with diamonds; / his ornaments should be made of pearls.

4.147.s:
aṃgaṃ svarṇamayaṃ kāryaṃ śaṃkhacakragadāyudham ..
pañcāmṛtena deveśaṃ snāpya nārāyaṇaṃ vibhum .. 43 ..
4.147.d:
अंगं स्वर्णमयं कार्यं शंखचक्रगदायुधम् ॥
पञ्चामृतेन देवेशं स्नाप्य नारायणं विभुम् ॥ 43 ॥
4.147.m: The body should be made of gold, wielding the conch, discus, and mace. / Having bathed the all-pervading lord of gods, Nārāyaṇa, with the five nectars,

4.147.s:
tameva gaṃdhapuṣpādyairmaṃtramuccārya pūjayet ..
brāhmaṇo vaidikairmantraiḥ pūjayenmadhusūdanam .. 44 ..
4.147.d:
तमेव गंधपुष्पाद्यैर्मंत्रमुच्चार्य पूजयेत् ॥
ब्राह्मणो वैदिकैर्मन्त्रैः पूजयेन्मधुसूदनम् ॥ 44 ॥
4.147.m: he should worship him alone with scents, flowers, and the like, reciting the mantra. / A Brahmin should worship Madhusūdana with Vedic mantras.

4.147.s:
śeṣā varṇāḥ purāṇoktaistāñchṛṇuṣva mama priye ..
vāsudevāya pādau tu gulphau saṃkarṣaṇāya ca .. 45 ..
4.147.d:
शेषा वर्णाः पुराणोक्तैस्ताञ्छृणुष्व मम प्रिये ॥
वासुदेवाय पादौ तु गुल्फौ संकर्षणाय च ॥ 45 ॥
4.147.m: The remaining castes [should worship] with mantras spoken in the Purāṇas; hear them, my beloved: / 'To Vāsudeva' for the feet, and 'To Saṃkarṣaṇa' for the ankles;

4.147.s:
trailokyajanakāyeti jānunī pūjayeddhareḥ ..
trailokyanāthāya guhye jñānamayāya vai kaṭim .. 46 ..
4.147.d:
त्रैलोक्यजनकायेति जानुनी पूजयेद्धरेः ॥
त्रैलोक्यनाथाय गुह्ये ज्ञानमयाय वै कटिम् ॥ 46 ॥
4.147.m: saying 'To the Generator of the Three Worlds', he should worship Hari's two knees; / 'To the Lord of the Three Worlds' for the private parts; 'To the Embodiment of Knowledge' for the waist;

4.147.s:
dāmodarāyetyudaraṃ hṛdayaṃ viśvarūpiṇe ..
nityaṃ hi pūjayeddevi uraḥ śrīvatsadhāriṇe .. 47 ..
4.147.d:
दामोदरायेत्युदरं हृदयं विश्वरूपिणे ॥
नित्यं हि पूजयेद्देवि उरः श्रीवत्सधारिणे ॥ 47 ॥
4.147.m: 'To Dāmodara' for the belly; 'To the Universal-Formed' for the heart; / O goddess, he should always worship the chest saying 'To the Bearer of the Śrīvatsa';

4.147.s:
kaṇṭhaṃ kaustubhanāthāya āsyaṃ yajñamukhāya ca ..
daityāṃtakāriṇe bāhū svairnāmairāyudhāni ca .. 48 ..
4.147.d:
कण्ठं कौस्तुभनाथाय आस्यं यज्ञमुखाय च ॥
दैत्यांतकारिणे बाहू स्वैर्नामैरायुधानि च ॥ 48 ॥
4.147.m: the throat 'To the Lord of the Kaustubha'; the mouth 'To the Mouth of the Sacrifice'; / the arms 'To the Slayer of Daityas', and the weapons with their own names;

4.147.s:
śiraḥ sarvātmane devi devadevasya pūjayet ..
śriyaṃ prapūjayeddevīṃ devyā maṃtraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 49 ..
4.147.d:
शिरः सर्वात्मने देवि देवदेवस्य पूजयेत् ॥
श्रियं प्रपूजयेद्देवीं देव्या मंत्रैः पृथग्विधैः ॥ 49 ॥
4.147.m: the head 'To the Self of All', O goddess, of the god of gods he should worship. / He should worship the goddess Śrī with various mantras of the goddess.

4.147.s:
indrādilokapālānāṃ pūjā kāryā yathākramam ..
navagrahāṇāṃ homaśca kartavyo vighnanāśanaḥ ..4.147.50..
4.147.d:
इन्द्रादिलोकपालानां पूजा कार्या यथाक्रमम् ॥
नवग्रहाणां होमश्च कर्तव्यो विघ्ननाशनः ॥4.147.50॥
4.147.m: The worship of the world protectors, Indra and the rest, should be performed in due order, / and a fire offering to the nine planets should be performed to destroy obstacles.

4.147.s:
pūjā gaṇapateḥ kāryā tathā homo vidhānataḥ ..
agre naivadyamatulaṃ dāpayeddhṛtapācitam .. 51 ..
4.147.d:
पूजा गणपतेः कार्या तथा होमो विधानतः ॥
अग्रे नैवद्यमतुलं दापयेद्धृतपाचितम् ॥ 51 ॥
4.147.m: Worship of Gaṇapati should be performed, as well as a fire offering according to rule. / In front, he should present peerless food offerings cooked in clarified butter:

4.147.s:
pāyasaṃ ghṛtapūrāṃśca modakānpūrikāstathā ..
sohālikādinaivedyaṃ pheṇikāḥ śarkarāstathā .. 52 ..
4.147.d:
पायसं घृतपूरांश्च मोदकान्पूरिकास्तथा ॥
सोहालिकादिनैवेद्यं फेणिकाः शर्करास्तथा ॥ 52 ॥
4.147.m: rice pudding, cakes filled with clarified butter, modakas, and pūrikās, / food offerings such as sohālikās, pheṇikās, and sugars.

4.147.s:
deśakālodbhavānyeva phalāni vinivedayet ..
dīpāndaśa diśo dadyātpārthivānraktavartikān..53..
4.147.d:
देशकालोद्भवान्येव फलानि विनिवेदयेत् ॥
दीपान्दश दिशो दद्यात्पार्थिवान्रक्तवर्तिकान्॥53॥
4.147.m: He should offer fruits produced according to season and place. / He should offer lamps to the ten directions, made of clay and with red wicks.

4.147.s:
etena tu viśālākṣi mūlamantreṇa dāpayet ..
puṣpamālānvitānkṛtvā caṃdanena vibhūṣitān ..54..
4.147.d:
एतेन तु विशालाक्षि मूलमन्त्रेण दापयेत् ॥
पुष्पमालान्वितान्कृत्वा चंदनेन विभूषितान् ॥54॥
4.147.m: With this root mantra, O large-eyed lady, he should make the offering, / having provided them with flower garlands and adorned them with sandalwood paste.

4.147.s:
abhimaṃtrya prayatnena viṣṇustabakavācakaiḥ ..
sahasraśīrṣādibhirmaṃtrairjapadbhirbrāhmaṇottamaiḥ .. 55 ..
4.147.d:
अभिमंत्र्य प्रयत्नेन विष्णुस्तबकवाचकैः ॥
सहस्रशीर्षादिभिर्मंत्रैर्जपद्भिर्ब्राह्मणोत्तमैः ॥ 55 ॥
4.147.m: Having carefully consecrated it through reciters of praise-clusters to Viṣṇu, / through excellent Brahmins chanting the mantras beginning with 'A Thousand Heads',

4.147.s:
ṣoḍaśātha sapatnīkānpūjayecca yathāvidhi ..
bhūṣayecca śubhairvastraistathālaṃkāraṇādibhiḥ .. 56 ..
4.147.d:
षोडशाथ सपत्नीकान्पूजयेच्च यथाविधि ॥
भूषयेच्च शुभैर्वस्त्रैस्तथालंकारणादिभिः ॥ 56 ॥
4.147.m: he should then worship sixteen [Brahmins] with their wives according to the rule, / and adorn them with auspicious garments and ornaments and the like.

4.147.s:
viṣṇuṃ matvā dvijaḥ pūjyo lakṣmīṃ matvā ca brāhmaṇīm ..
chatraṃ copānahau caiva aṃgulyābharaṇaṃ tathā ..57..
4.147.d:
विष्णुं मत्वा द्विजः पूज्यो लक्ष्मीं मत्वा च ब्राह्मणीम् ॥
छत्रं चोपानहौ चैव अंगुल्याभरणं तथा ॥57॥
4.147.m: Considering him Viṣṇu, the twice-born is to be worshipped, and considering her Lakṣmī, the Brahmin woman: / a royal parasol and shoes, and also a finger-ornament,

4.147.s:
