phalāni sapta dhānyāni bhojanaṃ ca yadīpsitam ..
dātavyaṃ ca sabhāryāya kṛṣṇo me prīyatāmiti .. 58 ..
4.147.d:
फलानि सप्त धान्यानि भोजनं च यदीप्सितम् ॥
दातव्यं च सभार्याय कृष्णो मे प्रीयतामिति ॥ 58 ॥
4.147.m: fruits, the seven grains, and desired food, / are to be given to him together with his wife, saying: 'May Kṛṣṇa be pleased with me.'

4.147.s:
śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ caiva vastreṇācchādya yatnataḥ ..
tathā prakalpayedvittaśaktyā ca suṃdarī yathā .. 59 ..
4.147.d:
शय्यां सोपस्करां चैव वस्त्रेणाच्छाद्य यत्नतः ॥
तथा प्रकल्पयेद्वित्तशक्त्या च सुंदरी यथा ॥ 59 ॥
4.147.m: A bed furnished with utensils, carefully covered with a cloth, / he should also prepare according to his financial capacity, O beautiful lady.

4.147.s:
vrate pūrṇe ca gaurdeyā sarvopaskarasaṃyutā ..
purīṃ ghaṭāpayetpūrvaṃ vastreṇācchādyayastaḥ ..
yathā kuryātprayāsena yathā kartā na paśyati .. 4.147.60 ..
4.147.d:
व्रते पूर्णे च गौर्देया सर्वोपस्करसंयुता ॥
पुरीं घटापयेत्पूर्वं वस्त्रेणाच्छाद्ययस्तः ॥
यथा कुर्यात्प्रयासेन यथा कर्ता न पश्यति ॥ 4.147.60 ॥
4.147.m: When the votive observance is completed, a cow equipped with all utensils should be given. / He should previously have the city fashioned, carefully covered with a cloth, / taking care in such a way that the maker does not see it.

4.147.s:
dīpāṃstu dīpitāṃstatra ānayedyajñamaṇḍapam ..
śvetavastreṇa netre tu yajamānasya ca priye..61..
4.147.d:
दीपांस्तु दीपितांस्तत्र आनयेद्यज्ञमण्डपम् ॥
श्वेतवस्त्रेण नेत्रे तु यजमानस्य च प्रिये॥61॥
4.147.m:
He should bring lighted lamps there into the sacrificial pavilion,
and [cover] the eyes of the sacrificer with a white cloth, O beloved.

4.147.s:
śrutavāñchāstravitprājñaḥ kṛtasarvāghasaṃkṣayaḥ ..
ābadhya netre suprājña ācāryastamidaṃ vadet ..62..
4.147.d:
श्रुतवाञ्छास्त्रवित्प्राज्ञः कृतसर्वाघसंक्षयः ॥
आबध्य नेत्रे सुप्राज्ञ आचार्यस्तमिदं वदेत् ॥62॥
4.147.m:
Learned, versed in scripture, wise, having destroyed all his sins,
the very wise ācārya, having bound his eyes, should say this to him:

4.147.s:
sarvakāmapradāṃ paśya kāṃcanākhyāṃ purīmimām..
varavastrayutāṃ ramyāṃ duḥkhadaurbhāgyanāśinīm.. 63 ..
4.147.d:
सर्वकामप्रदां पश्य कांचनाख्यां पुरीमिमाम्॥
वरवस्त्रयुतां रम्यां दुःखदौर्भाग्यनाशिनीम्॥ 63 ॥
4.147.m:
"Behold this city named Kāñcanā, which grants all desires,
adorned with excellent clothes, delightful, the destroyer of sorrow and misfortune!"

4.147.s:
evamukto mahābhāga paṭamunmucya netrayoḥ ..
puṣpāñjaliṃ gurau kṣiptvā sa paśyettāṃ purīṃ śubhām..64..
4.147.d:
एवमुक्तो महाभाग पटमुन्मुच्य नेत्रयोः ॥
पुष्पाञ्जलिं गुरौ क्षिप्त्वा स पश्येत्तां पुरीं शुभाम्॥64॥
4.147.m:
Thus addressed, O fortunate one, removing the cloth from his eyes
and casting a handful of flowers to his guru, he should behold that auspicious city.

4.147.s:
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ nagarīṃ devi yajamānaḥ samāhitaḥ ..
sauvarṇaṃ pātramādāya raupyaṃ tāmramathāpi vā .. 65 ..
4.147.d:
दृष्ट्वा तां नगरीं देवि यजमानः समाहितः ॥
सौवर्णं पात्रमादाय रौप्यं ताम्रमथापि वा ॥ 65 ॥
4.147.m:
Having beheld that city, O goddess, the sacrificer, composed in mind,
taking a golden vessel, or a silver or copper one,

4.147.s:
atha vā śaṃkhamādāya pātrālābhe tu sundari ..
pañcaratnaṃ kṣipetpātre jalaṃ gāṅgaṃ tathā phalam .. 66 ..
4.147.d:
अथ वा शंखमादाय पात्रालाभे तु सुन्दरि ॥
पञ्चरत्नं क्षिपेत्पात्रे जलं गाङ्गं तथा फलम् ॥ 66 ॥
4.147.m:
or taking a conch, O lovely woman, if a vessel cannot be obtained,
should cast into the vessel the five jewels, water of the Gaṅgā, and fruit,

4.147.s:
siddhārthamakṣatāḥ pūrvaṃ rocanā dadhi vā punaḥ ..
tataścārdhyaṃ pradātavyaṃ kṛṣṇāya prabhaviṣṇave .. 67 ..
4.147.d:
सिद्धार्थमक्षताः पूर्वं रोचना दधि वा पुनः ॥
ततश्चार्ध्यं प्रदातव्यं कृष्णाय प्रभविष्णवे ॥ 67 ॥
4.147.m:
white mustard seeds, unhusked barley beforehand, yellow pigment, or curd.
Then arghya should be offered to the all-powerful Kṛṣṇa:

4.147.s:
lakṣmīnārāyaṇau devau sarvakāmaphalapradau ..
rukmapuryāḥ pradānena yacchaitāṃ vāṃchitaṃ mama .. 68 ..
4.147.d:
लक्ष्मीनारायणौ देवौ सर्वकामफलप्रदौ ॥
रुक्मपुर्याः प्रदानेन यच्छैतां वांछितं मम ॥ 68 ॥
4.147.m:
"O deities Lakṣmī and Nārāyaṇa, givers of the fruit of all desires!
By the gift of this city of gold, grant my wish.

4.147.s:
nārāyaṇa hṛṣīkeśa jñānajñeya niraṃjana..
lakṣmīkāṃta jagannātha gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namostu te..69.. ( ityarghamaṃtraḥ) ..
4.147.d:
नारायण हृषीकेश ज्ञानज्ञेय निरंजन॥
लक्ष्मीकांत जगन्नाथ गृहाणार्घ्यं नमोस्तु ते॥69॥ ( इत्यर्घमंत्रः) ॥
4.147.m:
O Nārāyaṇa, Hṛṣīkeśa, known through knowledge, stainless one,
beloved of Lakṣmī, lord of the world, accept this arghya; praise be to you!" (Thus the arghya mantra.)

4.147.s:
evamarghyaṃ tato dattvā viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave..
devyāstvarghyaṃ pradātavyaṃ bhaktiyukte na cetasā..4.147.70..
4.147.d:
एवमर्घ्यं ततो दत्त्वा विष्णवे प्रभविष्णवे॥
देव्यास्त्वर्घ्यं प्रदातव्यं भक्तियुक्ते न चेतसा॥4.147.70॥
4.147.m:
Having thus offered arghya to the all-powerful Viṣṇu,
arghya should then be given to the goddess with a mind full of devotion.

4.147.s:
jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā maṃtrametamudīrayet ..
brahmaṇā pūjitā devī viṣṇunā śaṃkareṇa ca ..71..
4.147.d:
जानुभ्यामवनिं गत्वा मंत्रमेतमुदीरयेत् ॥
ब्रह्मणा पूजिता देवी विष्णुना शंकरेण च ॥71॥
4.147.m:
Going down on his knees to the earth, he should utter this mantra:
"The goddess worshipped by Brahmā, by Viṣṇu, and by Śaṅkara,

4.147.s:
pārvatyā pūjitā lakṣmīḥ skaṃdavaiśravaṇena ca..
mayā ca pūjitā devi dharmasya vijigīṣayā ..72..
4.147.d:
पार्वत्या पूजिता लक्ष्मीः स्कंदवैश्रवणेन च॥
मया च पूजिता देवि धर्मस्य विजिगीषया ॥72॥
4.147.m:
Lakṣmī worshipped by Pārvatī, by Skanda and by Vaiśravaṇa,
and worshipped by me, O goddess, through the desire to conquer for dharma:

4.147.s:
saubhāgyaṃ dehi me putrāndhanaṃ pautrāṃśca pūjitān ..
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ devi saukhyaṃ prayaccha me ..73..
4.147.d:
सौभाग्यं देहि मे पुत्रान्धनं पौत्रांश्च पूजितान् ॥
गृहाणार्घ्यं मया दत्तं देवि सौख्यं प्रयच्छ मे ॥73॥
4.147.m:
Grant me good fortune, grant me sons, wealth, and revered grandsons!
Accept the arghya given by me, O goddess, and grant me happiness!"

4.147.s:
ya evaṃ purato dattvā pūrvoktavidhinā tava ..
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādbhaktiyuktena cetasā ..74..
4.147.d:
य एवं पुरतो दत्त्वा पूर्वोक्तविधिना तव ॥
रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्याद्भक्तियुक्तेन चेतसा ॥74॥
4.147.m:
He who, having thus made the gift before you according to the aforesaid rule,
keeps vigil at night with a mind filled with devotion,

4.147.s:
gītanṛtyavinodena upākhyānaiśca vaiṣṇavaiḥ..
yena kena vinodena nidrā naiva prajāyate ..75..
4.147.d:
गीतनृत्यविनोदेन उपाख्यानैश्च वैष्णवैः॥
येन केन विनोदेन निद्रा नैव प्रजायते ॥75॥
4.147.m:
with the delight of songs and dances, and with tales of Viṣṇu,
with whatever entertainment so that sleep does not arise at all,

4.147.s:
unnidro jāgṛyādyastu śatayajñaphalaṃ labhet ..
prabhāte vimale snātvā saṃpūjya pitṛdevatāḥ ..76..
4.147.d:
उन्निद्रो जागृयाद्यस्तु शतयज्ञफलं लभेत् ॥
प्रभाते विमले स्नात्वा संपूज्य पितृदेवताः ॥76॥
4.147.m:
whoever, remaining sleepless, keeps vigil, obtains the fruit of a hundred sacrifices.
At clean daybreak, having bathed and worshipped the ancestors and gods,

4.147.s:
brāhmaṇāṃśca sapatnīkānparidhāpyānubhojayet ..
dakṣiṇāśca yathāśaktyā pradāya ca kṣamāpayet .. 77 ..
4.147.d:
ब्राह्मणांश्च सपत्नीकान्परिधाप्यानुभोजयेत् ॥
दक्षिणाश्च यथाशक्त्या प्रदाय च क्षमापयेत् ॥ 77 ॥
4.147.m:
he should clothe and feed brāhmaṇas together with their wives,
and having given priestly gifts according to his means, he should ask their forgiveness.

4.147.s:
dīnāṃdhabadhirānpaṃgūnsarvāṃstānparitoṣayet ..
paścātpāraṇakaṃ kāryamupavāsī bhavedyadi .. 78 ..
4.147.d:
दीनांधबधिरान्पंगून्सर्वांस्तान्परितोषयेत् ॥
पश्चात्पारणकं कार्यमुपवासी भवेद्यदि ॥ 78 ॥
4.147.m:
He should satisfy all the poor, the blind, the deaf, and the lame.
Afterward, if he is fasting, the breaking of the fast must be performed,

4.147.s:
madhuraṃ payasā yuktaṃ suhṛdbhirbāṃdhavaiḥ saha ..
evametadvrataṃ kāryamekādaśyāṃ śucismite .. 79 ..
4.147.d:
मधुरं पयसा युक्तं सुहृद्भिर्बांधवैः सह ॥
एवमेतद्व्रतं कार्यमेकादश्यां शुचिस्मिते ॥ 79 ॥
4.147.m:
sweet and accompanied by milk, together with friends and kinsmen.
Thus this vrata should be performed on the ekādaśī, O fair-smiling one,

4.147.s:
śuklāyāmatha kṛṣṇāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ tathā tithau..
saṃkrāṃtivāsare vāpi vyatīpāte ca vaidhṛtau ..4.147.80..
4.147.d:
शुक्लायामथ कृष्णायां तृतीयायां तथा तिथौ॥
संक्रांतिवासरे वापि व्यतीपाते च वैधृतौ ॥4.147.80॥
4.147.m:
in the bright or in the dark [fortnight], or on the tṛtīyā tithi,
or on the day of a saṃkrānti, and at a vyatīpāta or a vaidhṛta,

4.147.s:
yadā vā jāyate vittaṃ cittaṃ ca varavarṇini ..
gaurānīya pradātavyā kṛṣṇo me prīyatāmiti .. 81 ..
4.147.d:
यदा वा जायते वित्तं चित्तं च वरवर्णिनि ॥
गौरानीय प्रदातव्या कृष्णो मे प्रीयतामिति ॥ 81 ॥
4.147.m:
or whenever wealth and the intention arise, O fair-complexioned one.
Having brought a cow, it should be given, [saying,] 'May Kṛṣṇa be pleased with me.'

4.147.s:
evaṃ kṛte ca yatpuṇyaṃ tanna śakyaṃ niveditum ..
api varṣasahasreṇa kulalakṣaśatairapi .. 82 ..
4.147.d:
एवं कृते च यत्पुण्यं तन्न शक्यं निवेदितुम् ॥
अपि वर्षसहस्रेण कुललक्षशतैरपि ॥ 82 ॥
4.147.m:
When this is done, the merit that [accrues] cannot be fully told
even in a thousand years by hundreds of thousands of lineages.

4.147.s:
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca..
brahmalokaṃ samāsādya brahmaṇā pratimodyate .. 83 ..
4.147.d:
कल्पकोटिसहस्राणि कल्पकोटिशतानि च॥
ब्रह्मलोकं समासाद्य ब्रह्मणा प्रतिमोद्यते ॥ 83 ॥
4.147.m:
For thousands of ten millions of kalpas and hundreds of ten millions of kalpas,
having reached the world of Brahmā, he rejoices with Brahmā.

4.147.s:
brahmakādrudralokaṃ tatparaṃ viṣṇusaṃnidhau ..
indrādilokapālānāṃ vratī lokamavāpnuyāt .. 84 ..
4.147.d:
ब्रह्मकाद्रुद्रलोकं तत्परं विष्णुसंनिधौ ॥
इन्द्रादिलोकपालानां व्रती लोकमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 84 ॥
4.147.m:
From Brahmā's [world] to the world of Rudra, and beyond that to the presence of Viṣṇu,
the keeper of the vrata attains the world of the world protectors, Indra and the others.

4.147.s:
tato bhuktvā śuciḥ śrīmānbhogāṃstrailokyasuṃdari ..
cakravartī bhavedbhūmau brahmaṇyo vaiṣṇavastathā ..85..
4.147.d:
ततो भुक्त्वा शुचिः श्रीमान्भोगांस्त्रैलोक्यसुंदरि ॥
चक्रवर्ती भवेद्भूमौ ब्रह्मण्यो वैष्णवस्तथा ॥85॥
4.147.m:
Then, having enjoyed pleasures, pure and prosperous, O beauty of the three worlds,
he becomes an emperor on earth, devoted to brāhmaṇas and a devotee of Viṣṇu.

4.147.s:
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ vācayamānaṃ samaṃtataḥ ..
kulasaptakamuddhṛtya vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamāpnuyāt ..86..
4.147.d:
य इदं शृणुयान्नित्यं वाचयमानं समंततः ॥
कुलसप्तकमुद्धृत्य वैष्णवं लोकमाप्नुयात् ॥86॥
4.147.m:
Whoever constantly hears this being recited on all sides,
having delivered seven generations of his family, attains the realm of Viṣṇu.

4.147.s:
tvayā kāṃcanapuryākhyaṃ vratametatkṛtaṃ purā ..
tena puṇyena labdho'haṃ bhartā trailokyapūjitaḥ .. 87 ..
kanyāpradānavarṇanam ( atha kanyādānam)
4.147.d:
त्वया कांचनपुर्याख्यं व्रतमेतत्कृतं पुरा ॥
तेन पुण्येन लब्धोऽहं भर्ता त्रैलोक्यपूजितः ॥ 87 ॥
कन्याप्रदानवर्णनम् ( अथ कन्यादानम्)

4.148.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
brahmadeyāṃ tu yaḥ kanyāmalaṃkṛtya prayacchati ..
saptapūrvānbhaviṣyāṃśca svakule sapta mānavān..1..
4.148.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
ब्रह्मदेयां तु यः कन्यामलंकृत्य प्रयच्छति ॥
सप्तपूर्वान्भविष्यांश्च स्वकुले सप्त मानवान्॥1॥
4.148.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
He who gives away a maiden adorned [in marriage] according to the rite of Brahmā,
seven men before and seven to come in his own family—

4.148.s:
tena kanyāpradānena sa tārayatyasaṃśayam ..
lokānāpnoti ca tathā dakṣasyaiva prajāpateḥ..2..
4.148.d:
तेन कन्याप्रदानेन स तारयत्यसंशयम् ॥
लोकानाप्नोति च तथा दक्षस्यैव प्रजापतेः॥2॥
4.148.m:
by that gift of a maiden, he undoubtedly redeems them,
and likewise he attains the worlds of Dakṣa Prajāpati.

4.148.s:
prājāpatyena vidhinā ātmānaṃ ca samuddharet..
mahatpuṇyamavāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati ..3..
4.148.d:
प्राजापत्येन विधिना आत्मानं च समुद्धरेत्॥
महत्पुण्यमवाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति ॥3॥
4.148.m:
By the rite of Prajāpati, he redeems himself also;
he attains great merit and goes to the heavenly world.

4.148.s:
bhūgavāśvapradānāni gajadānaṃ tathaiva ca ..
dattvā tu varṇahīnāya ghore tamasi majjati ..4..
4.148.d:
भूगवाश्वप्रदानानि गजदानं तथैव च ॥
दत्त्वा तु वर्णहीनाय घोरे तमसि मज्जति ॥4॥
4.148.m:
Gifts of land, cows, and horses, and likewise the gift of an elephant,
if given to one devoid of caste, he sinks into terrible darkness.

4.148.s:
bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi purīṣaṃ kākamaśnute..
śulkena dattvā kanyāṃ ca ghoraṃ narakamāpnuyāt ..5..
4.148.d:
बहुवर्षसहस्राणि पुरीषं काकमश्नुते॥
शुल्केन दत्त्वा कन्यां च घोरं नरकमाप्नुयात् ॥5॥
4.148.m:
For many thousands of years he eats feces and crows.
And having given a maiden for a bride-price, he attains a terrible hell.

4.148.s:
bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi tathā aśucibhuṅnaraḥ..
savarṇāṃ ca savarṇebhyo dadyātkanyāṃ yathāvidhi ..6..
4.148.d:
बहून्यब्दसहस्राणि तथा अशुचिभुङ्नरः॥
सवर्णां च सवर्णेभ्यो दद्यात्कन्यां यथाविधि ॥6॥
4.148.m:
For many thousands of years the man thus feeds on impurity.
One should give a maiden of the same caste to those of the same caste according to the rule;

4.148.s:
dattvā cādhikavarṇāya dviguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ tathā ..
dvijaputramanāthaṃ vā saṃskuryādyaśca karmabhiḥ ..7..
4.148.d:
दत्त्वा चाधिकवर्णाय द्विगुणं निर्गुणं तथा ॥
द्विजपुत्रमनाथं वा संस्कुर्याद्यश्च कर्मभिः ॥7॥
4.148.m:
and having given [her] to one of higher caste, [he obtains] double [the fruit], but if to one devoid of virtues, [none].
Or he who consecrates a fatherless son of a twice-born with the sacred rites,

4.148.s:
cūḍopanayādyaiśca so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ..
anāthāṃ kanyakāṃ dattvā nākaloke mahīyate .. 8 ..
4.148.d:
चूडोपनयाद्यैश्च सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ॥
अनाथां कन्यकां दत्त्वा नाकलोके महीयते ॥ 8 ॥
4.148.m:
beginning with the tonsure and the sacred thread investiture, obtains the fruit of an aśvamedha.
Having given an orphaned maiden [in marriage], he is honoured in heaven.

4.148.s:
kanyayā saha dattaṃ ca suvarṇaṃ vahnimūlakam ..
sakalaṃ dviguṇaṃ tasya phalamuktaṃ purātanaiḥ .. 9 ..
4.148.d:
कन्यया सह दत्तं च सुवर्णं वह्निमूलकम् ॥
सकलं द्विगुणं तस्य फलमुक्तं पुरातनैः ॥ 9 ॥
4.148.m:
Gold, which has fire for its source, given along with the maiden—
the entire fruit of that is said by the ancients to be twofold.

4.148.s:
kanyādānādavāpnoti dakṣalokaṃ narottama ..
viṣṇupūjāsamaṃ puṇyaṃ tatkanyāpūjayā bhavet .. 4.148.10 ..
4.148.d:
कन्यादानादवाप्नोति दक्षलोकं नरोत्तम ॥
विष्णुपूजासमं पुण्यं तत्कन्यापूजया भवेत् ॥ 4.148.10 ॥
4.148.m:
From the gift of a maiden, O best of men, one attains the world of Dakṣa;
merit equal to the worship of Viṣṇu arises from the worship of that maiden.

4.148.s:
vimānamāhṛtya manobhirāmaṃ surāṅganāgītavilāsahṛdyam ..
prāpnoti lokaṃ tridaśottamānāṃ kanyāpradānānna vicāraṇeti .. 11 .. ..
brāhmaṇaśuśrūṣāvidhivarṇanam
4.148.d:
विमानमाहृत्य मनोभिरामं सुराङ्गनागीतविलासहृद्यम् ॥
प्राप्नोति लोकं त्रिदशोत्तमानां कन्याप्रदानान्न विचारणेति ॥ 11 ॥ ॥
ब्राह्मणशुश्रूषाविधिवर्णनम्
4.148.m:
Having obtained a celestial chariot pleasing to the mind, delightful with the songs and play of divine women,
he reaches the world of the foremost among the thirty [gods] through the gift of a maiden; there is no doubt of this.
Description of the Rule for Serving Brāhmaṇas

4.149.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca.. ..
brāhmaṇā daivataṃ bhūmau brāhmaṇā divi daivatam ..
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paraṃ nāsti nāsti bhūtaṃ jagattraye .. 1 ..
4.149.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच॥ ॥
ब्राह्मणा दैवतं भूमौ ब्राह्मणा दिवि दैवतम् ॥
ब्राह्मणेभ्यः परं नास्ति नास्ति भूतं जगत्त्रये ॥ 1 ॥
4.149.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Brāhmaṇas are the divinity on earth; brāhmaṇas are the divinity in heaven.
There is nothing higher than brāhmaṇas, no [greater] being in the three worlds.

4.149.s:
adevaṃ daivataṃ kuryuḥ kuryurdevamadaivatam ..
brāhmaṇā hi mahābhāgāḥ pūjyaṃte satataṃ dvijāḥ ..2..
4.149.d:
अदेवं दैवतं कुर्युः कुर्युर्देवमदैवतम् ॥
ब्राह्मणा हि महाभागाः पूज्यंते सततं द्विजाः ॥2॥
4.149.m:
They can make a non-god into a god; they can make a god into a non-god.
For brāhmaṇas are very fortunate; the twice-born are constantly to be worshipped.

4.149.s:
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samutpannā devāḥ pūrvamiti smṛtiḥ ..
brāhmaṇebhyo jagatsarvaṃ tasmātpūjyatamā dvijāḥ .. 3 ..
4.149.d:
ब्राह्मणेभ्यः समुत्पन्ना देवाः पूर्वमिति स्मृतिः ॥
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो जगत्सर्वं तस्मात्पूज्यतमा द्विजाः ॥ 3 ॥
4.149.m: From brāhmaṇas the gods were born in the beginning—so says tradition; / from brāhmaṇas came the entire universe, therefore the twice-born are most worthy of worship.

4.149.s:
yeṣāmaśnaṃti vaktreṇa devatāḥ pitarastathā ..
ṛṣayaśca tathā nāgāḥ kiṃ bhūtamadhikaṃ tataḥ .. 4 ..
4.149.d:
येषामश्नंति वक्त्रेण देवताः पितरस्तथा ॥
ऋषयश्च तथा नागाः किं भूतमधिकं ततः ॥ 4 ॥
4.149.m: Through whose mouth the deities eat, and likewise the ancestors, / the sages, and likewise the nāgas—what being is greater than them?

4.149.s:
yadaiva manujo bhaktyā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati ..
tadaivāpnoti dharmajña bahujanmani janmani .. 5 ..
4.149.d:
यदैव मनुजो भक्त्या ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रयच्छति ॥
तदैवाप्नोति धर्मज्ञ बहुजन्मनि जन्मनि ॥ 5 ॥
4.149.m: Whenever a man gives with devotion to brāhmaṇas, / just then he obtains [his reward], O knower of dharma, in birth after birth across many births.

4.149.s:
tālavṛṃtānilenaiva śrāṃtasaṃvāhanena ca ..
utsādanena gātrāṇāṃ tathā vyaṃjanakarmaṇā .. 6 ..
4.149.d:
तालवृंतानिलेनैव श्रांतसंवाहनेन च ॥
उत्सादनेन गात्राणां तथा व्यंजनकर्मणा ॥ 6 ॥
4.149.m: Merely by the breeze of a palm-leaf fan, and by massaging the weary, / by rubbing down the limbs, and likewise by the act of fanning,

4.149.s:
pādaśaucapradānena pādayoḥ secanena ca ..
paricarya yathā kāmamekenaiva dvijottama .. 7 ..
4.149.d:
पादशौचप्रदानेन पादयोः सेचनेन च ॥
परिचर्य यथा काममेकेनैव द्विजोत्तम ॥ 7 ॥
4.149.m: by offering foot-washing water, and by pouring water on their feet, / by waiting upon a single excellent twice-born according to his desire,

4.149.s:
aniṣṭvāpi samāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca śāśvatam ..
brāhmaṇānāṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā nākaloke mahīyate .. 8 ..
4.149.d:
अनिष्ट्वापि समाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च शाश्वतम् ॥
ब्राह्मणानां शुभं कृत्वा नाकलोके महीयते ॥ 8 ॥
4.149.m: even without performing sacrifices, one attains the eternal heavenly realm; / having brought about the welfare of brāhmaṇas, one is glorified in heaven.

4.149.s:
yadbrāhmaṇāstuṣṭimanto vadaṃti pratyakṣadeveṣu parokṣadevāḥ ..
tadvai śubhaṃ tasya narasya nūnaṃ bhavedatastānsatataṃ niṣevet .. 9 ..
vṛṣadānavidhivarṇanam
4.149.d:
यद्ब्राह्मणास्तुष्टिमन्तो वदंति प्रत्यक्षदेवेषु परोक्षदेवाः ॥
तद्वै शुभं तस्य नरस्य नूनं भवेदतस्तान्सततं निषेवेत् ॥ 9 ॥
वृषदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.149.m:
Whatever the contented brāhmaṇas—the invisible deities manifested as visible deities—say, / that indeed will surely become auspicious for that person; therefore, one should serve them constantly.
Description of the Rule for the Gift of a Bull

4.150.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
yuṣmadvākyāmṛtamidaṃ hyahaṃ śṛṇvañjanārdana..
na tṛptimadhigacchāmi jātaṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me .. 1 ..
4.150.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
युष्मद्वाक्यामृतमिदं ह्यहं शृण्वञ्जनार्दन॥
न तृप्तिमधिगच्छामि जातं कौतूहलं हि मे ॥ 1 ॥
4.150.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Listening to this nectar of your words, O Janārdana, / I do not find satisfaction; indeed, curiosity has arisen in me.

4.150.s:
gopatiḥ kila govindastriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ ..
govṛṣasya pradānena trailokyamabhinaṃdati .. 2 ..
4.150.d:
गोपतिः किल गोविन्दस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः ॥
गोवृषस्य प्रदानेन त्रैलोक्यमभिनंदति ॥ 2 ॥
4.150.m: Govinda is renowned throughout the three worlds as the Lord of Cattle; / through the gift of a bull, the three worlds rejoice.
Therefore, O Acyuta, declare the procedure for the rite of gifting a bull.

4.150.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
vṛṣadānaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṇuṣva kathayāmi te ..
pavitraṃ pāvanaṃ caiva sarvadānottamaṃ tathā .. 4 ..
4.150.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
वृषदानफलं पुण्यं शृणुष्व कथयामि ते ॥
पवित्रं पावनं चैव सर्वदानोत्तमं तथा ॥ 4 ॥
4.150.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Listen to the meritorious fruit of gifting a bull; I shall tell it to you; / it is pure, purifying, and indeed the best among all gifts.

4.150.s:
daśadhenusamo'naḍvānekaścaiva dhuraṃdharaḥ ..
daśadhenupradānāddhi sa evaiko viśiṣyate .. 5 ..
4.150.d:
दशधेनुसमोऽनड्वानेकश्चैव धुरंधरः ॥
दशधेनुप्रदानाद्धि स एवैको विशिष्यते ॥ 5 ॥
4.150.m: A single draught bull is equal to ten cows; / indeed, he alone surpasses the gift of ten cows.

4.150.s:
voḍhā ca cārupṛṣṭhāṃgo hyarogaḥ pāṃḍunaṃdana ..
yuvā bhadraḥ suśī laśca sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ .. 6 ..
4.150.d:
वोढा च चारुपृष्ठांगो ह्यरोगः पांडुनंदन ॥
युवा भद्रः सुशी लश्च सर्वदोषविवर्जितः ॥ 6 ॥
4.150.m: He should be a beast of burden, having a handsome back and limbs, free from disease, O son of Pāṇḍu, / young, auspicious, well-tempered, and devoid of all defects.

4.150.s:
dhuraṃdharaḥ sthāpayate eka eva kulaṃ mahat ..
trātā bhavati saṃsārānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 7 ..
4.150.d:
धुरंधरः स्थापयते एक एव कुलं महत् ॥
त्राता भवति संसारान्नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ 7 ॥
4.150.m: A single draught bull uplifts a great lineage; / he becomes a saviour from worldly existence—no doubt should be entertained on this point.

4.150.s:
alaṃkṛtya vṛṣaṃ śāṃtaṃ puṇyehni samupasthite ..
raupyalāḍgūlasaṃyuktaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet .. 8 ..
4.150.d:
अलंकृत्य वृषं शांतं पुण्येह्नि समुपस्थिते ॥
रौप्यलाड्गूलसंयुक्तं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥ 8 ॥
4.150.m: Having adorned the docile bull when an auspicious day has arrived, / furnished with silver on his tail, one should present him to a brāhmaṇa,

4.150.s:
maṃtreṇānena rājendra taṃ śṛṇuṣva vadāmi te ..
dharmastvaṃ vṛṣarūpeṇa jaga dānaṃdakāraka .. 9 ..
4.150.d:
मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र तं शृणुष्व वदामि ते ॥
धर्मस्त्वं वृषरूपेण जग दानंदकारक ॥ 9 ॥
4.150.m: with this mantra, O king of kings; listen to it, I tell you: / "You are Dharma in the form of a bull, the creator of joy for the universe;

4.150.s:
aṣṭamūrteradhiṣṭhānamataḥ pāhi sanātana ..
datvaivaṃ dakṣiṇāyuktaṃ praṇipatya visarjayet .. 4.150.10 ..
4.150.d:
अष्टमूर्तेरधिष्ठानमतः पाहि सनातन ॥
दत्वैवं दक्षिणायुक्तं प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् ॥ 4.150.10 ॥
4.150.m: the abode of the Eight-formed [Śiva], therefore protect [me], O eternal one!" / Having thus given [him] along with a priestly gift, one should bow down and dismiss [him].

4.150.s:
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vāṅmanaḥ kāyakarmajam ..
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti godānasukṛtena ca .. 11 ..
4.150.d:
सप्तजन्मकृतं पापं वाङ्मनः कायकर्मजम् ॥
तत्सर्वं विलयं याति गोदानसुकृतेन च ॥ 11 ॥
4.150.m: Sin committed through speech, mind, and bodily actions across seven births, / all that dissolves away by the merit of gifting cattle.

4.150.s:
yānaṃ vṛṣabhasaṃyuktaṃ dīpyamānaṃ suśobhitam ..
āruhya kāmagaṃ divyaṃ svarlokamadhirohati .. 12 ..
4.150.d:
यानं वृषभसंयुक्तं दीप्यमानं सुशोभितम् ॥
आरुह्य कामगं दिव्यं स्वर्लोकमधिरोहति ॥ 12 ॥
4.150.m: Mounting a vehicle yoked with bulls, blazing, exceedingly beautiful, / moving at will, celestial, he ascends to heaven.

4.150.s:
yāvaṃti tasya romāṇi govṛṣasya mahīpate ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi gavāṃ loke mahīyate .. 13 ..
4.150.d:
यावंति तस्य रोमाणि गोवृषस्य महीपते ॥
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि गवां लोके महीयते ॥ 13 ॥
4.150.m: As many hairs as there are on that bull, O king, / for that many thousands of years he is glorified in the world of cows.

4.150.s:
golokādavatīrṇastu ihaloke dvijottamaḥ ..
yajñayājī mahātejāḥ sarvabrāhmaṇapūjitaḥ .. 14 ..
4.150.d:
गोलोकादवतीर्णस्तु इहलोके द्विजोत्तमः ॥
यज्ञयाजी महातेजाः सर्वब्राह्मणपूजितः ॥ 14 ॥
4.150.m: Descending from Goloka, he becomes the best of twice-born in this world, / a performer of Vedic sacrifices, of great splendour, honoured by all brāhmaṇas.

4.150.s:
tavoktaṃ vai mahārāja kasya deyo vṛṣottamaḥ ..
tadapyahaṃ te vakṣyāmi pātraṃ trāṇapradaṃ nṛṇām .. 15 ..
4.150.d:
तवोक्तं वै महाराज कस्य देयो वृषोत्तमः ॥
तदप्यहं ते वक्ष्यामि पात्रं त्राणप्रदं नृणाम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.150.m: It has been told to you, O great king, to whom the excellent bull should be given; / I shall also describe to you that worthy recipient who grants protection to men.

4.150.s:
yeṣāṃ sadā vai śrutipūrṇakarṇā jitendriyāḥ prāṇivadhe nivṛttāḥ ..
pratigrahe saṃkucitā gṛhasthāste brāhmaṇāstārayituṃ samarthāḥ ..16 ..
4.150.d:
येषां सदा वै श्रुतिपूर्णकर्णा जितेन्द्रियाः प्राणिवधे निवृत्ताः ॥
प्रतिग्रहे संकुचिता गृहस्थास्ते ब्राह्मणास्तारयितुं समर्थाः ॥16 ॥
4.150.m: Those whose ears are ever filled with Vedic revelation, whose senses are mastered, who have desisted from slaughtering living beings, / who hesitate to accept gifts, householders—those brāhmaṇas are capable of delivering [the donor].

4.150.s:
gātre dṛḍhaṃ bhārasahaṃ supuṣṭaṃ suśṛṅgiṇaṃ sarvaguṇopapannam ..
dattvarṣabhaṃ godaśakena tulyaṃ satyaṃ bhavaṃti bhuvi tatphalabhāginaste .. 17 ..
pratyakṣadhenudānavratavidhivarṇanam( atha vividhadānāni)
4.150.d:
गात्रे दृढं भारसहं सुपुष्टं सुशृङ्गिणं सर्वगुणोपपन्नम् ॥
दत्त्वर्षभं गोदशकेन तुल्यं सत्यं भवंति भुवि तत्फलभागिनस्ते ॥ 17 ॥
प्रत्यक्षधेनुदानव्रतविधिवर्णनम्( अथ विविधदानानि)
4.150.m:
Having gifted a bull strong in body, capable of bearing burdens, well-nourished, having handsome horns, endowed with all good qualities, / which is equal to ten cows, they truly become sharers in that fruit in the world.
Description of the Rule for the Observance of the Gift of an Actual Cow (Now, Various Gifts)

4.151.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
śrutaḥ purāṇaviṣayastvatprasādānmayācyuta ..
saṃsārāsāratāṃ jñātvā śrutaśca vratavistaraḥ .. 1 ..
4.151.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
श्रुतः पुराणविषयस्त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत ॥
संसारासारतां ज्ञात्वा श्रुतश्च व्रतविस्तरः ॥ 1 ॥
4.151.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / By your grace, O Acyuta, the subjects of the Purāṇa have been heard by me; / knowing the vanity of worldly existence, the details of observances have also been heard.

4.151.s:
bhūyaśca śrotumicchāmi dānamāhātmyamuttamam ..
kiṃ dīyate kadā kṛṣṇa kenopāyena śaṃsa me .. 2 ..
4.151.d:
भूयश्च श्रोतुमिच्छामि दानमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् ॥
किं दीयते कदा कृष्ण केनोपायेन शंस मे ॥ 2 ॥
4.151.m: I wish to hear further the supreme majesty of giving: / What is to be given, when, O Kṛṣṇa, and by what means? Tell me.

4.151.s:
nahi dānātparataramanyadastīti me matiḥ ..
dhanaṃ dhanavatāṃ kiñcidahāryaṃ rājataskaraiḥ .. 3 ..
4.151.d:
नहि दानात्परतरमन्यदस्तीति मे मतिः ॥
धनं धनवतां किञ्चिदहार्यं राजतस्करैः ॥ 3 ॥
4.151.m: For in my view, there is nothing higher than giving; / it is a wealth belonging to the wealthy that cannot be taken away by kings or thieves.

4.151.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
aniścitaṃ nidhānaṃ yadaprayuktaṃ ca varddhate ..
anītaṃ yāti cādhvānaṃ dhanaṃ viprakarārpitam .. 4 ..
4.151.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अनिश्चितं निधानं यदप्रयुक्तं च वर्द्धते ॥
अनीतं याति चाध्वानं धनं विप्रकरार्पितम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.151.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Wealth placed into the hands of a brāhmaṇa is an imperishable treasure that increases without being invested, / and travels along the road [to the afterlife] without being carried.

4.151.s:
kiṃ kāyena supuṣṭena balinā cirajīvinā ..
yannasattvopakārāya tajjīvitamanarthakam .. 5 ..
4.151.d:
किं कायेन सुपुष्टेन बलिना चिरजीविना ॥
यन्नसत्त्वोपकाराय तज्जीवितमनर्थकम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.151.m: What is the use of a body well-nourished, strong, and long-lived? / That life which is not for the benefit of living beings is useless.

4.151.s:
grāsādarddhamapi grāsa marthibhyaḥ kiṃ na dīyate ..
icchānurūpo vibhavaḥ kadā kasya bhaviṣyati .. 6 ..
4.151.d:
ग्रासादर्द्धमपि ग्रास मर्थिभ्यः किं न दीयते ॥
इच्छानुरूपो विभवः कदा कस्य भविष्यति ॥ 6 ॥
4.151.m: Why is even half a morsel not given from a morsel to seekers? / When will anyone ever possess wealth according to his desires?

4.151.s:
ekasminnapyatikrāṃte dine dānavivarjite ..
dasyubhirmuṣitaścaiva divārātrau ca śocati .. 7 ..
4.151.d:
एकस्मिन्नप्यतिक्रांते दिने दानविवर्जिते ॥
दस्युभिर्मुषितश्चैव दिवारात्रौ च शोचति ॥ 7 ॥
4.151.m: Even when a single day passes devoid of giving, / one should grieve day and night as if plundered by bandits.

4.151.s:
yasya trivargaśūnyāni dinānyāyāṃti yāṃti ca ..
salohakārabhastreva śvasannapi na jīvati .. 8 ..
4.151.d:
यस्य त्रिवर्गशून्यानि दिनान्यायांति यांति च ॥
सलोहकारभस्त्रेव श्वसन्नपि न जीवति ॥ 8 ॥
4.151.m: He whose days come and go devoid of the three aims of life, / even though breathing like a blacksmith's bellows, does not truly live.

4.151.s:
yairna dattaṃ na ca hutaṃ na tīrthe maraṇaṃ kṛtam ..
hiraṇyamannamudakaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo na cārpitam .. 9 ..
4.151.d:
यैर्न दत्तं न च हुतं न तीर्थे मरणं कृतम् ॥
हिरण्यमन्नमुदकं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो न चार्पितम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.151.m: By whom nothing was given, no oblations offered, no death met at a sacred place, / and gold, food, and water were not offered to brāhmaṇas—

4.151.s:
dīnā niraśanā rūkṣāḥ kapālāṅkitapāṇayaḥ ..
te dṛśyaṃte mahārāja jāyamānā punaḥ .. 4.151.10 ..
4.151.d:
दीना निरशना रूक्षाः कपालाङ्कितपाणयः ॥
ते दृश्यंते महाराज जायमाना पुनः ॥ 4.151.10 ॥
4.151.m: wretched, starving, withered, with begging-bowls marked upon their hands, / they are seen being born again, O great king.

4.151.s:
āyāsaśatalabdhasya prāṇebhyopi garīyasaḥ ..
gatirekaiva vittasya dānamanyā vipattayaḥ .. 11 ..
4.151.d:
आयासशतलब्धस्य प्राणेभ्योपि गरीयसः ॥
गतिरेकैव वित्तस्य दानमन्या विपत्तयः ॥ 11 ॥
4.151.m: For wealth acquired through a hundred exertions, dearer even than life itself, / there is only one true path, namely giving; the others are calamities.

4.151.s:
nopabhogaiḥ kṣayaṃ yāṃti na pradānaiḥ samṛddhayaḥ ..
pūrvārjitānāmanyatra sukṛtānāṃ parikṣayāt .. 12 ..
4.151.d:
नोपभोगैः क्षयं यांति न प्रदानैः समृद्धयः ॥
पूर्वार्जितानामन्यत्र सुकृतानां परिक्षयात् ॥ 12 ॥
4.151.m: Prosperities do not waste away through enjoyments, nor through gifts, / except through the exhaustion of good deeds accumulated in the past.

4.151.s:
adṛṣṭaparatattvopi pātrebhyo visṛjeddhanam ..
yasmānmṛtasya tannāsti tasmātsāṃśayikaṃ varam .. 13 ..
4.151.d:
अदृष्टपरतत्त्वोपि पात्रेभ्यो विसृजेद्धनम् ॥
यस्मान्मृतस्य तन्नास्ति तस्मात्सांशयिकं वरम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.151.m: Even one who has not perceived the highest truth should bestow wealth upon worthy recipients; / since it does not remain with a dead man, even a doubtful venture is better.

4.151.s:
dānāni bahurūpāṇi kathayāmi tavānagha ..
vyāsavālmīkimanvādyaiḥ kathitāni purā mama .. 14 ..
4.151.d:
दानानि बहुरूपाणि कथयामि तवानघ ॥
व्यासवाल्मीकिमन्वाद्यैः कथितानि पुरा मम ॥ 14 ॥
4.151.m: I shall describe to you various forms of gifts, O sinless one, / which were related to me long ago by Vyāsa, Vālmīki, Manu, and others.

4.151.s:
kiñcidvrataṃ yatkriyate pūjyate ca trilocanaḥ ..
dīyate yacca viprebhya etajjanmataroḥ phalam .. 15 ..
4.151.d:
किञ्चिद्व्रतं यत्क्रियते पूज्यते च त्रिलोचनः ॥
दीयते यच्च विप्रेभ्य एतज्जन्मतरोः फलम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.151.m: Whatever observance is performed, and Three-Eyed [Śiva] is worshipped, / and whatever is given to brāhmaṇas—this is the fruit of the tree of birth.

4.151.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
brāhmaṇaprīṇanārthāya keśavasya śivasya ca ..
yāni dānāni deyāni tānyācakṣya yadūttama ..16..
4.151.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
ब्राह्मणप्रीणनार्थाय केशवस्य शिवस्य च ॥
यानि दानानि देयानि तान्याचक्ष्य यदूत्तम ॥16॥
4.151.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / For the sake of pleasing the brāhmaṇas, Keśava, and Śiva, / declare those gifts that should be given, O best of the Yadus!

4.151.s:
yena caiva vidhānena dānaṃ puṇyasukhāvaham ..
ehikāmuṣmikāvāptiṃ karoti nahi hanyate .. 17 ..
4.151.d:
येन चैव विधानेन दानं पुण्यसुखावहम् ॥
एहिकामुष्मिकावाप्तिं करोति नहि हन्यते ॥ 17 ॥
4.151.m: And by what procedure a gift brings merit and happiness, / accomplishes attainment in this world and the next, and is never thwarted.

4.151.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
trīṇyāhuratidānāni gāvaḥ pṛthvī sarasvatī ..
āsaptamaṃ punaṃtyete dohavāhanavedanaiḥ .. 18 ..
4.151.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
त्रीण्याहुरतिदानानि गावः पृथ्वी सरस्वती ॥
आसप्तमं पुनंत्येते दोहवाहनवेदनैः ॥ 18 ॥
4.151.m: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / They say there are three supreme gifts: cows, land, and Sarasvatī. / These purify up to the seventh generation through their milking, carriage, and instruction.

4.151.s:
godānamādau vakṣyāmi pratyakṣakramayogataḥ ..
yena caiva vidhānena anyūnādhikavistaram .. 19 ..
4.151.d:
गोदानमादौ वक्ष्यामि प्रत्यक्षक्रमयोगतः ॥
येन चैव विधानेन अन्यूनाधिकविस्तरम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.151.m: First I shall explain the gift of an actual cow according to its proper sequence, / and by what ritual procedure, in detail, neither deficient nor redundant.

4.151.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ..
deyāḥ kiṃlakṣaṇā gāvaḥ kāśca rājanvivarjitāḥ ..
kīdṛśāya pradātavyā na deyāḥ kīdṛśāya vai ..4.151.20..
4.151.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥
देयाः किंलक्षणा गावः काश्च राजन्विवर्जिताः ॥
कीदृशाय प्रदातव्या न देयाः कीदृशाय वै ॥4.151.20॥
4.151.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / What are the marks of cows that should be given, and which ones are to be avoided, O King? / To what sort [of person] should they be given, and to what sort should they indeed not be given?

4.151.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
taruṇī rūpasaṃpannā suśīlā ca payasvinī ..
nyāyārjitā savatsā ca pradeyā śrotriyāya gauḥ .. 21 ..
4.151.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
तरुणी रूपसंपन्ना सुशीला च पयस्विनी ॥
न्यायार्जिता सवत्सा च प्रदेया श्रोत्रियाय गौः ॥ 21 ॥
4.151.m: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / A cow that is young, endowed with beauty, good-tempered, abundant in milk, / righteously acquired, and with her calf should be given to a śrotriya.

4.151.s:
vṛddhā sarogā hīnāṃgī vaṃdhyā duṣṭā mṛtaprajā ..
dūrasthā'nyāyalabdhā ca deyā gaurna kathaṃcana .. 22 ..
4.151.d:
वृद्धा सरोगा हीनांगी वंध्या दुष्टा मृतप्रजा ॥
दूरस्थाऽन्यायलब्धा च देया गौर्न कथंचन ॥ 22 ॥
4.151.m: An old, diseased, mutilated, barren, vicious, or stillborn-bearing cow, / or one living far away, or acquired unjustly, should never be given.

4.151.s:
sā dattaiva haretpāpaṃ śrotriyāyāhitāgnaye ..
atithipriyāya dāṃtāya dhenuṃ dadyādguṇādhike ..23..
4.151.d:
सा दत्तैव हरेत्पापं श्रोत्रियायाहिताग्नये ॥
अतिथिप्रियाय दांताय धेनुं दद्याद्गुणाधिके ॥23॥
4.151.m: Given thus, she removes sin: one should give the cow to a śrotriya who maintains the sacred fires, / who is hospitable to guests, self-restrained, and distinguished by virtues.

4.151.s:
akulīnāya mūrkhāya lubdhāya piśunāya ca ..
havyakavyavyapetāya na deyā gauḥ kathaṃcana .. 24 ..
4.151.d:
अकुलीनाय मूर्खाय लुब्धाय पिशुनाय च ॥
हव्यकव्यव्यपेताय न देया गौः कथंचन ॥ 24 ॥
4.151.m: To a low-born man, a fool, a greedy man, or a slanderer, / or one devoid of offerings to gods and ancestors, a cow should never be given.

4.151.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
puṇyaṃ dinamathāsādya snātvātarpya pitṝṃstathā ..
ghṛtakṣīrābhiṣekaṃ ca kṛtvā viṣṇoḥ śivasya ca .. 25 ..
4.151.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
पुण्यं दिनमथासाद्य स्नात्वातर्प्य पितॄंस्तथा ॥
घृतक्षीराभिषेकं च कृत्वा विष्णोः शिवस्य च ॥ 25 ॥
4.151.m: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / Then, having arrived at an auspicious day, having bathed and gratified the ancestors, / and having performed an ablution of Viṣṇu and Śiva with ghee and milk,

4.151.s:
samabhyarcya yathānyāyaṃ puṣpādibhiranukramāt ..
udaṅmukhīṃ prāṅmukhīṃ vā gṛṣṭiṃ kṛtvā payasvinīm .. 26 ..
4.151.d:
समभ्यर्च्य यथान्यायं पुष्पादिभिरनुक्रमात् ॥
उदङ्मुखीं प्राङ्मुखीं वा गृष्टिं कृत्वा पयस्विनीम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.151.m: having worshipped them properly in succession with flowers and other offerings, / having placed facing north or facing east a cow that has calved once and yields abundant milk,

4.151.s:
savatsāṃ vastrasaṃvītāṃ sitayajñopavītinīm ..
svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ kāṃsyadohanakānvitām .. 27 ..
4.151.d:
सवत्सां वस्त्रसंवीतां सितयज्ञोपवीतिनीम् ॥
स्वर्णशृङ्गीं रौप्यखुरां कांस्यदोहनकान्विताम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.151.m: accompanied by her calf, draped in cloth, wearing a white sacred thread, / with golden horns, silver hooves, and accompanied by a bronze milking pail,

4.151.s:
śaktito dakṣiṇāyuktāṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ..
pucche kṛṣṇājinaṃ deyaṃ gāṃ pucche kariṇaṃ kare .. 28 ..
4.151.d:
शक्तितो दक्षिणायुक्तां ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥
पुच्छे कृष्णाजिनं देयं गां पुच्छे करिणं करे ॥ 28 ॥
4.151.m: endowed with a sacrificial fee according to one's means, he should present her to the brāhmaṇa. / A black antelope skin should be placed on the tail—the cow by the tail, an elephant by the trunk,

4.151.s:
aśvaṃ sadā sukarṇe vā dāsīṃ śirasi dāpayet ..
gāvo mamāgrataḥ saṃtu gāvo me saṃtu pṛṣṭhataḥ .. 29 ..
4.151.d:
अश्वं सदा सुकर्णे वा दासीं शिरसि दापयेत् ॥
गावो ममाग्रतः संतु गावो मे संतु पृष्ठतः ॥ 29 ॥
4.151.m: a horse always by the ears, or a female slave should be given by the head. / 'May cows be before me; may cows be behind me;

4.151.s:
gāvo me hṛdaye saṃtu gavāṃ madhye vasāmyaham ..
pradakṣiṇāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dhenuṃ dvijavarāya tām .. 4.151.30 ..
4.151.d:
गावो मे हृदये संतु गवां मध्ये वसाम्यहम् ॥
प्रदक्षिणां ततः कृत्वा धेनुं द्विजवराय ताम् ॥ 4.151.30 ॥
4.151.m: may cows be in my heart; may I dwell in the midst of cows.' / Then, having circumambulated that cow, to the foremost of the twice-born [he says]:

4.151.s:
imāṃ ca pratigṛhṇīṣva dhenurdattā mayā tava ..
evamuccārya taṃ vipraṃ deveśaṃ parikalpayet .. 31 ..
4.151.d:
इमां च प्रतिगृह्णीष्व धेनुर्दत्ता मया तव ॥
एवमुच्चार्य तं विप्रं देवेशं परिकल्पयेत् ॥ 31 ॥
4.151.m: 'Receive this cow given by me to you.' / Having uttered this, he should regard that brāhmaṇa as the Lord of gods.

4.151.s:
anuvrajecca gacchaṃtaṃ padānyaṣṭau narādhipa ..
anena vidhinā dhenuṃ yo viprāya prayacchati .. 32 ..
4.151.d:
अनुव्रजेच्च गच्छंतं पदान्यष्टौ नराधिप ॥
अनेन विधिना धेनुं यो विप्राय प्रयच्छति ॥ 32 ॥
4.151.m: And he should accompany him as he walks away for eight steps, O ruler of men. / Whoever gives a cow to a brāhmaṇa according to this rite,

4.151.s:
sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā svargalokaṃ sa gacchati ..
sapta pūrvānsapta parānātmānaṃ caiva mānavaḥ ..33..
4.151.d:
सर्वकामसमृद्धात्मा स्वर्गलोकं स गच्छति ॥
सप्त पूर्वान्सप्त परानात्मानं चैव मानवः ॥33॥
4.151.m: his desires completely fulfilled, goes to the heavenly realm. / A mortal liberates seven ancestors, seven descendants, and himself,

4.151.s:
sapta janmakṛtātpāpānmocayatyavanīpate..
pade pade'śvamedhasya gośatasya ca mānavaḥ ..34..
4.151.d:
सप्त जन्मकृतात्पापान्मोचयत्यवनीपते॥
पदे पदेऽश्वमेधस्य गोशतस्य च मानवः ॥34॥
4.151.m: from sin committed in seven births, O lord of the earth. / At every step a mortal obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice

4.151.s:
phalamāpnoti rājendra dakṣāyaivaṃ jagau hariḥ ..
sarvakāmapradā sā syātsarvakāleṣu pārthiva ..35..
4.151.d:
फलमाप्नोति राजेन्द्र दक्षायैवं जगौ हरिः ॥
सर्वकामप्रदा सा स्यात्सर्वकालेषु पार्थिव ॥35॥
4.151.m: and of a hundred cows, O king of kings; thus Hari proclaimed to Dakṣa. / She grants all desires at all times, O king;

4.151.s:
bhavatyasau pāpaharā yāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa ..
sarveṣāmeva pāpānāṃ kṛtānāmapi jānatā ..36..
4.151.d:
भवत्यसौ पापहरा यावदिंद्राश्चतुर्दश ॥
सर्वेषामेव पापानां कृतानामपि जानता ॥36॥
4.151.m: she removes sin as long as the fourteen Indras endure. / Even for all sins committed knowingly,

4.151.s:
prāyaścittamidaṃ proktamanutāpopabṛṃhitam ..
sarveṣāmeva dānānāmekajanmānugaṃ phalam .. 37 ..
4.151.d:
प्रायश्चित्तमिदं प्रोक्तमनुतापोपबृंहितम् ॥
सर्वेषामेव दानानामेकजन्मानुगं फलम् ॥ 37 ॥
4.151.m: this expiation is proclaimed, accompanied by remorse. / The fruit of all other gifts lasts for a single birth;

4.151.s:
brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdraiścānyaiśca mānavaiḥ ..
lokāḥ kāmagamā prāptā dattvaitadvidhinā nṛpa .. 38 ..
4.151.d:
ब्राह्मणैः क्षत्रियैर्वैश्यैः शूद्रैश्चान्यैश्च मानवैः ॥
लोकाः कामगमा प्राप्ता दत्त्वैतद्विधिना नृप ॥ 38 ॥
4.151.m: by brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, śūdras, and other men, / realms conforming to every wish are attained by giving it according to this rite, O king.

4.151.s:
gobhyodhikaṃ jagati nāparamastikiñciddānaṃ pavitramiti śāstravido vadaṃti ..
tatsaṃpadaḥ surasadaśca samīhamānairdeyāḥ sadaiva vidhinā dvijapuṃgavāya .. 39 ..
dhenudānavratavidhivarṇanam
4.151.d:
गोभ्योधिकं जगति नापरमस्तिकिञ्चिद्दानं पवित्रमिति शास्त्रविदो वदंति ॥
तत्संपदः सुरसदश्च समीहमानैर्देयाः सदैव विधिना द्विजपुंगवाय ॥ 39 ॥
धेनुदानव्रतविधिवर्णनम्
4.151.m:
Those who know the scriptures declare that there is no other sacred gift in the world greater than cows; / therefore, by those desiring prosperity and the realm of the gods, [a cow] should always be given by this rite to an eminent twice-born.
Description of the ritual procedure for the votive gift of cows

4.152.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dhenūnāṃ kalpanā nṛpa ..
viśeṣavidhinā yāśca deyāḥ kāmānabhīpsubhiḥ .. 1 ..
4.152.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि धेनूनां कल्पना नृप ॥
विशेषविधिना याश्च देयाः कामानभीप्सुभिः ॥ 1 ॥
4.152.m: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / Now I shall fully explain the fashioned models of cows, O king, / which should be given by special rite by those desiring the objects of their wishes.

4.152.s:
kāmaṃ yaddīyate dānaṃ samagraṃ tatsukhāvaham ..
asamagraṃ tu doṣāya bhavatīha paratra ca .. 2 ..
4.152.d:
कामं यद्दीयते दानं समग्रं तत्सुखावहम् ॥
असमग्रं तु दोषाय भवतीह परत्र च ॥ 2 ॥
4.152.m: Any gift given willingly in its entirety brings happiness; / but an incomplete one leads to misfortune here and in the hereafter.

4.152.s:
tasmānna dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ vidhānavikalaṃ tathā ..
deyaṃ dānaṃ mahārāja samagraphalakāmyayā .. 3 ..
4.152.d:
तस्मान्न दक्षिणाहीनं विधानविकलं तथा ॥
देयं दानं महाराज समग्रफलकाम्यया ॥ 3 ॥
4.152.m: Therefore, a gift should not be given lacking a sacrificial fee or defective in ritual procedure, O great king, / if one desires the complete fruit.

4.152.s:
anyathā dīyamānaṃ tadahaṃkārāya kevalam ..
pratyakṣaṃ cārthahāniḥ syānna vā tatphaladaṃ bhavet .. 4 ..
4.152.d:
अन्यथा दीयमानं तदहंकाराय केवलम् ॥
प्रत्यक्षं चार्थहानिः स्यान्न वा तत्फलदं भवेत् ॥ 4 ॥
4.152.m: Given otherwise, it serves merely for egoism; / there is a perceptible loss of wealth, and it would bear no fruit.

4.152.s:
tiladhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu pārthivasattama ..
vārāheṇa purā proktāṃ mahāpātakanāśinīm .. 5 ..
4.152.d:
तिलधेनुं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु पार्थिवसत्तम ॥
वाराहेण पुरा प्रोक्तां महापातकनाशिनीम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.152.m: I shall explain the sesame cow, listen, O best of kings, / as previously proclaimed by the Boar Incarnation, which destroys major sins.

4.152.s:
yāṃ dattvā brahmahā goghnaḥ pitṛhā gurutalpagaḥ ..
agāradāhī garadaḥ sarvapāparatopi vā .. 6 ..
4.152.d:
यां दत्त्वा ब्रह्महा गोघ्नः पितृहा गुरुतल्पगः ॥
अगारदाही गरदः सर्वपापरतोपि वा ॥ 6 ॥
4.152.m: By giving which, the killer of a brāhmaṇa, the killer of a cow, the killer of a father, one who violates the teacher's bed, / an arsonist, a poisoner, or even one devoted to all sins,

4.152.s:
mahāpātakayuktaśca saṃyuktaścopapātakaiḥ ..
mucyate hyakhilaiḥ pāpaiḥ svargalokaṃ ca gacchati .. 7 ..
4.152.d:
महापातकयुक्तश्च संयुक्तश्चोपपातकैः ॥
मुच्यते ह्यखिलैः पापैः स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति ॥ 7 ॥
4.152.m: one burdened with major sins and joined with minor sins, / is freed from all sins and goes to the heavenly realm.

4.152.s:
anulipte mahīpṛṣṭhe kṛṣṇājinasamāvṛte ..
dhenuṃ tilamayīṃ kṛtvā darbhānāstīrya sarvataḥ .. 8 ..
4.152.d:
अनुलिप्ते महीपृष्ठे कृष्णाजिनसमावृते ॥
धेनुं तिलमयीं कृत्वा दर्भानास्तीर्य सर्वतः ॥ 8 ॥
4.152.m: On ground that has been smeared [with cow dung] and covered with a black antelope skin, / having fashioned a cow made of sesame seeds, after strewing darbha grass all around,

4.152.s:
tilāḥ śvetāstilāḥ kṛṣṇāstilā gomūtravarṇakāḥ ..
tilānāṃ ca vicitrāṇāṃ dhenuṃ sarvāṃ ca kārayet ..9 ..
4.152.d:
तिलाः श्वेतास्तिलाः कृष्णास्तिला गोमूत्रवर्णकाः ॥
तिलानां च विचित्राणां धेनुं सर्वां च कारयेत् ॥9 ॥
4.152.m: with white sesame seeds, black sesame seeds, and sesame seeds of the colour of cow's urine, / he should have the entire cow made of variegated sesame seeds.

4.152.s:
droṇasya vatsakaṃ kuryāccaturāḍhakikāṃ ca gām ..
svarṇaśṛṃgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ gandhavarṇavatīṃ tathā .. 4.152.10 ..
4.152.d:
द्रोणस्य वत्सकं कुर्याच्चतुराढकिकां च गाम् ॥
स्वर्णशृंगीं रौप्यखुरां गन्धवर्णवतीं तथा ॥ 4.152.10 ॥
4.152.m: He should make the calf from a droṇa [of sesame] and the cow from four āḍhakas, / with golden horns, silver hooves, and endowed with fragrance and colour.

4.152.s:
kāryā śarkarayā jihvā guḍenāsyaṃ ca kambalaḥ ..
ikṣupādāṃ tāmrapṛṣṭhīṃ śuktimuktāphalekṣaṇām .. 11 ..
4.152.d:
कार्या शर्करया जिह्वा गुडेनास्यं च कम्बलः ॥
इक्षुपादां ताम्रपृष्ठीं शुक्तिमुक्ताफलेक्षणाम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.152.m: Her tongue should be made of sugar, her mouth and dewlap of jaggery, / her legs of sugarcane, her back of copper, and her eyes of pearls from mother-of-pearl.

4.152.s:
praśastapatraśravaṇāṃ phaladaṃtavatīṃ śubhām ..
sragdāmapucchāṃ kurvīta nava nītastanānvitām .. 12 ..
4.152.d:
प्रशस्तपत्रश्रवणां फलदंतवतीं शुभाम् ॥
स्रग्दामपुच्छां कुर्वीत नव नीतस्तनान्विताम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.152.m: Her ears should be made of auspicious leaves, her teeth of fruit, auspicious; / he should make her tail of a garland and cord, and her udder endowed with fresh butter.

4.152.s:
sitavastraśirālambāṃ sitasarṣaparomikām ..
phalairmanoharairannairmaṇimuktāphalānvitām .. 13 ..
4.152.d:
सितवस्त्रशिरालम्बां सितसर्षपरोमिकाम् ॥
फलैर्मनोहरैरन्नैर्मणिमुक्ताफलान्विताम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.152.m: Covered on her head with a white cloth, with body hair of white mustard seeds, / endowed with charming fruits, grains, jewels, and pearls,

4.152.s:
īdṛksaṃsthānasampannāṃ kṛtvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
kāṃsyopadohanāṃ dadyātparvakāle samāgate .. 14 ..
4.152.d:
ईदृक्संस्थानसम्पन्नां कृत्वा श्रद्धासमन्वितः ॥
कांस्योपदोहनां दद्यात्पर्वकाले समागते ॥ 14 ॥
4.152.m: having fashioned her endowed with such a form, full of faith, / he should give her with a bronze milking pail when an auspicious occasion has arrived.

4.152.s:
yā lakṣmīḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yā vai deveṣvavasthitā ..
dhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu .. 15 ..
4.152.d:
या लक्ष्मीः सर्वभूतानां या वै देवेष्ववस्थिता ॥
धेनुरूपेण सा देवी मम पापं व्यपोहतु ॥ 15 ॥
4.152.m: 'May that goddess Lakṣmī, who belongs to all beings and who resides among the gods, / remove my sin in the form of a cow.'

4.152.s:
tataḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā praṇamya ca ..
sadakṣiṇā mayā tubhyaṃ dattetyuktvā visarjayet .. 16 ..
4.152.d:
ततः प्रदक्षिणां कृत्वा पूजयित्वा प्रणम्य च ॥
सदक्षिणा मया तुभ्यं दत्तेत्युक्त्वा विसर्जयेत् ॥ 16 ॥
4.152.m: Then, having circumambulated, worshipped, and bowed to her, / he should dismiss her, saying: 'Accompanied by a sacrificial fee, she is given by me to you.'

4.152.s:
anena vidhinā dattvā tiladhenuṃ narādhipa ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto paraṃ brahmādhigacchati .. 17 ..
4.152.d:
अनेन विधिना दत्त्वा तिलधेनुं नराधिप ॥
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति ॥ 17 ॥
4.152.m: Having given the sesame cow according to this procedure, O ruler of men, / freed from all sins, he attains the supreme Brahman.

4.152.s:
yaśca gṛhṇāti vidhivaddīyamānāṃ pramodate ..
dīyamānāṃ praśaṃsaṃti ye ca saṃhṛṣṭamānasāḥ .. 18 ..
4.152.d:
यश्च गृह्णाति विधिवद्दीयमानां प्रमोदते ॥
दीयमानां प्रशंसंति ये च संहृष्टमानसाः ॥ 18 ॥
4.152.m: And he who receives it according to the rule as it is being given rejoices; / and those who, with delighted minds, praise it as it is being given [also attain merit].

4.152.s:
tepi doṣavinirmuktā brahmalokaṃ vrajaṃti te ..
praśāṃtāya suśīlāya vedavrataratāya ca .. 19 ..
4.152.d:
तेपि दोषविनिर्मुक्ता ब्रह्मलोकं व्रजंति ते ॥
प्रशांताय सुशीलाय वेदव्रतरताय च ॥ 19 ॥
4.152.m: they too are freed from fault and go to the world of Brahmā. / Having given a cow made of sesame to [a brāhmaṇa who is] tranquil, of good character, and devoted to the vows of the Veda,

4.152.s:
dhenuṃ tilamayīṃ dattvā na śocati kṛtākṛte ..
trirātraṃ yastilāhārastiladhenuprado bhavet .. 4.152.20 ..
4.152.d:
धेनुं तिलमयीं दत्त्वा न शोचति कृताकृते ॥
त्रिरात्रं यस्तिलाहारस्तिलधेनुप्रदो भवेत् ॥ 4.152.20 ॥
4.152.m: he does not grieve over what was done or undone. / Whoever subsists on sesame for three nights and gives a sesame cow,

4.152.s:
ekāhamatha vā rājanna yucchedantarātmanā ..
dānādviśuddhiḥ pāpasya tasya puṇyavato nṛpa .. 21 ..
4.152.d:
एकाहमथ वा राजन्न युच्छेदन्तरात्मना ॥
दानाद्विशुद्धिः पापस्य तस्य पुण्यवतो नृप ॥ 21 ॥
4.152.m: or for even one day, O king, with an attentive inner self, / from that gift, O ruler of men, comes purification from sin for that meritorious person.

4.152.s:
cāndrāyaṇādabhyadhikaṃ kathitaṃ tilabhakṣaṇam ..
bālatve caiva yatpāpaṃ yauvane vārddhake tathā .. 22 ..
4.152.d:
चान्द्रायणादभ्यधिकं कथितं तिलभक्षणम् ॥
बालत्वे चैव यत्पापं यौवने वार्द्धके तथा ॥ 22 ॥
4.152.m: Eating sesame is declared to be superior to the cāndrāyaṇa penance. / Whatever sin was committed in childhood, in youth, or in old age,

4.152.s:
vācā kṛtaṃ tu manasā karmaṇā yacca saṃcitam ..
udakaṣṭhīvane caiva nagnasnānena yadbhavet .. 23 ..
4.152.d:
वाचा कृतं तु मनसा कर्मणा यच्च संचितम् ॥
उदकष्ठीवने चैव नग्नस्नानेन यद्भवेत् ॥ 23 ॥
4.152.m: committed by speech, by mind, or accumulated through bodily action, / whatever arises from spitting into water or bathing naked,

4.152.s:
muśalenodyate nāpi laṃbite brāhmaṇe tathā ..
vṛṣalīgamane caiva gurudārābhigāmini .. 24 ..
4.152.d:
मुशलेनोद्यते नापि लंबिते ब्राह्मणे तथा ॥
वृषलीगमने चैव गुरुदाराभिगामिनि ॥ 24 ॥
4.152.m: by raising a pestle [against another], or by humiliating a brāhmaṇa, / in approaching a śūdra woman, or in violating the wife of a guru,

4.152.s:
surāpānena yatpāpamabhakṣyasya ca bhakṣaṇāt ..
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti tiladhenupradāyinām .. 25 ..
4.152.d:
सुरापानेन यत्पापमभक्ष्यस्य च भक्षणात् ॥
तत्सर्वं विलयं याति तिलधेनुप्रदायिनाम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.152.m: whatever sin comes from drinking spirituous liquor or eating what is inedible, / all of that dissolves for those who bestow a sesame cow.

4.152.s:
yamamārge mahāghore nadī vaitaraṇī smṛtā ..
vālukāyāḥ sthalaṃ caiva pacyate yatra pāpinaḥ .. 26 ..
4.152.d:
यममार्गे महाघोरे नदी वैतरणी स्मृता ॥
वालुकायाः स्थलं चैव पच्यते यत्र पापिनः ॥ 26 ॥
4.152.m: On the terrifying path of Yama, the river Vaitaraṇī is traditionally known, / as well as the stretch of hot sand where sinners are cooked,

4.152.s:
yatra lohamukhāḥ kākā yatra śvāno bhayāvahāḥ ..
nikṛtya pāpināṃ māṃsaṃ bhakṣayaṃti bubhukṣitāḥ .. 27 ..
4.152.d:
यत्र लोहमुखाः काका यत्र श्वानो भयावहाः ॥
निकृत्य पापिनां मांसं भक्षयंति बुभुक्षिताः ॥ 27 ॥
4.152.m: where there are iron-beaked crows and terrifying dogs / that, ravenous, tear off and eat the flesh of sinners,

4.152.s:
asipatravanaṃ caiva lohakaṃṭakaśālmalīm ..
etānsarvānatikramya tato yamapuraṃ vrajet .. 28 ..
4.152.d:
असिपत्रवनं चैव लोहकंटकशाल्मलीम् ॥
एतान्सर्वानतिक्रम्य ततो यमपुरं व्रजेत् ॥ 28 ॥
4.152.m: and the forest of sword-like leaves, and the silk-cotton tree with iron thorns. / Transcending all these, he then goes to Yama’s city.

4.152.s:
vimāne kāṃcane divye maṇiratnavibhūṣite ..
tatrāruhya naraśreṣṭho gacchate paramāṅgatim .. 29 ..
4.152.d:
विमाने कांचने दिव्ये मणिरत्नविभूषिते ॥
तत्रारुह्य नरश्रेष्ठो गच्छते परमाङ्गतिम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.152.m: Mounting a divine, golden celestial chariot / adorned with gems and jewels, that best of men attains the supreme state.

4.152.s:
guṇahīne na dātavyā na dātavyā dhaneśvare ..
kuṇḍe gole ca lubdhe ca na ca deyā kadāpi sā .. 4.152.30 ..
4.152.d:
गुणहीने न दातव्या न दातव्या धनेश्वरे ॥
कुण्डे गोले च लुब्धे च न च देया कदापि सा ॥ 4.152.30 ॥
4.152.m: It must not be given to one devoid of virtues, nor to a lord of wealth; / it must never be given to an adulterine son, an incestuous son, or a greedy man.

4.152.s:
ekā ekasya dātavyā munibhiḥ kathitaṃ purā ..
araṇye naimiṣe pārtha nāradena niveditam .. 31 ..
4.152.d:
एका एकस्य दातव्या मुनिभिः कथितं पुरा ॥
अरण्ये नैमिषे पार्थ नारदेन निवेदितम् ॥ 31 ॥
4.152.m: One [cow] must be given to one [recipient]; this was stated by sages of old. / It was related by Nārada in the Naimiṣa forest, O Pārtha.

4.152.s:
tattehaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi samyakphalasahasradam ..
idaṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ ca māṅgalyaṃ kīrtivardhanam .. 32 ..
4.152.d:
तत्तेहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि सम्यक्फलसहस्रदम् ॥
इदं पुण्यं पवित्रं च माङ्गल्यं कीर्तिवर्धनम् ॥ 32 ॥
4.152.m: I shall proclaim that to you, which properly bestows a thousandfold fruit. / This [account] is meritorious, purifying, auspicious, and increases fame.

4.152.s:
viprāṇāṃ śrāvayecchrāddhe anantaphalamaśnute ..
bahubhyo na pradeyāni gaurgṛhaṃ śayanaṃ striyaḥ .. 33 ..
4.152.d:
विप्राणां श्रावयेच्छ्राद्धे अनन्तफलमश्नुते ॥
बहुभ्यो न प्रदेयानि गौर्गृहं शयनं स्त्रियः ॥ 33 ॥
4.152.m: If one recites it to brāhmaṇas at a śrāddha, one attains endless fruit. / A cow, a house, a bed, and women must not be given to many [recipients].

4.152.s:
vibhajyamānānyetāni dātāraṃ pātayaṃtyadhaḥ ..
sā tu vikrayamāpannā dahatyāsaptamaṃ kulam .. 34 ..
4.152.d:
विभज्यमानान्येतानि दातारं पातयंत्यधः ॥
सा तु विक्रयमापन्ना दहत्यासप्तमं कुलम् ॥ 34 ॥
4.152.m: These, when divided, bring down the giver into hell. / But if it is sold, it burns his lineage up to the seventh generation.

4.152.s:
asyā dānaprabhāvena vimānaṃ sarvakāmikam ..
samāruhya naro yāti yatra devo hariḥ svayam .. 39 ..
4.152.d:
अस्या दानप्रभावेन विमानं सर्वकामिकम् ॥
समारुह्य नरो याति यत्र देवो हरिः स्वयम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.152.m: By the power of giving it, a man mounts / a celestial chariot yielding all desires and goes to where Lord Hari himself dwells.

4.152.s:
eṣā caiva pradātavyā prayatenāntarātmanā ..
paurṇamāsyāṃ ca māghasya kārtikyāṃ caiva bhārata .. 36 ..
4.152.d:
एषा चैव प्रदातव्या प्रयतेनान्तरात्मना ॥
पौर्णमास्यां च माघस्य कार्तिक्यां चैव भारत ॥ 36 ॥
4.152.m: And this must be given with a restrained inner self / on the full moon of Māgha and on the Kārtikī full moon, O descendant of Bharata,

4.152.s:
candrasūryoparāge tu viṣuve ayane tathā ..
ṣaḍaśītimukhe caiva vyatīpāte tu sarvadā .. 37 ..
4.152.d:
चन्द्रसूर्योपरागे तु विषुवे अयने तथा ॥
षडशीतिमुखे चैव व्यतीपाते तु सर्वदा ॥ 37 ॥
4.152.m: at an eclipse of the moon or sun, at the equinox, at a solstice, / at a ṣaḍaśītimukha transition, and always on a vyatīpāta,

4.152.s:
vaiśākhyāṃ mārgaśīrṣyāṃ vā gajacchāyāsu caiva hi ..
eṣā te kathitā pārtha tiladhenurmayānagha .. 38 ..
4.152.d:
वैशाख्यां मार्गशीर्ष्यां वा गजच्छायासु चैव हि ॥
एषा ते कथिता पार्थ तिलधेनुर्मयानघ ॥ 38 ॥
4.152.m: on the full moon of Vaiśākha or of Mārgaśīrṣa, or during gajacchāyā conjunctions. / Thus, O sinless Pārtha, this sesame cow has been described by me to you.

4.152.s:
yāvaṃti dheno romaṇi gātreṣu nṛpapuṅgava ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi tadā svarge mahīyate .. 39 ..
4.152.d:
यावंति धेनो रोमणि गात्रेषु नृपपुङ्गव ॥
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि तदा स्वर्गे महीयते ॥ 39 ॥
4.152.m: As many hairs as there are on the limbs of the cow, O bull among kings, / for that many thousands of years he is glorified in heaven.

4.152.s:
yaśca gṛhṇāti vidhivaddīyamānāṃ ca paśyati ..
anumodayate caiva te sarve svargagāminaḥ .. 4.152.40 ..
4.152.d:
यश्च गृह्णाति विधिवद्दीयमानां च पश्यति ॥
अनुमोदयते चैव ते सर्वे स्वर्गगामिनः ॥ 4.152.40 ॥
4.152.m: And he who receives it according to rule, or sees it being given, / or approves of it—all of them go to heaven.

4.152.s:
dhenuṃ dhanādhipatayo magadhodbhavena mānena ye tilamayīṃ caturāḍhakena ..
kṛtvā yathoktaracanāṃ kṛtacāruvatsāṃ yacchaṃti te bhuvi bhavaṃti vimuktapāpāḥ ..41..
4.152.d:
धेनुं धनाधिपतयो मगधोद्भवेन मानेन ये तिलमयीं चतुराढकेन ॥
कृत्वा यथोक्तरचनां कृतचारुवत्सां यच्छंति ते भुवि भवंति विमुक्तपापाः ॥41॥
4.152.m: Wealthy lords who, having fashioned a sesame cow with four āḍhakas by the Magadha measure / according to the prescribed design, provided with a beautiful calf, bestow it, become freed from sin on earth.

4.152.s:
pratigṛhṇāmi devi tvāṃ kuṭuṃbabharaṇāya ca ..
kāmaṃ deyā dayāsmabhyaṃ dheno tvaṃ sarvadā hyasi .. 42 .. ..
jaladhenudānavratavidhivarṇanam
4.152.d:
प्रतिगृह्णामि देवि त्वां कुटुंबभरणाय च ॥
कामं देया दयास्मभ्यं धेनो त्वं सर्वदा ह्यसि ॥ 42 ॥ ॥
जलधेनुदानव्रतविधिवर्णनम्
4.152.m:
"I accept you, O goddess, for the maintenance of my family. / Compassion must be granted to us according to your will, for you are ever a cow to us!"
Description of the Procedure for the Votive Observance of Bestowing a Water Cow

4.153.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
jaladhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi prīyate dattayā yayā ..
devadevo hṛṣīkeśaḥ pūjitaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ .. 1 ..
4.153.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
जलधेनुं प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रीयते दत्तया यया ॥
देवदेवो हृषीकेशः पूजितः सर्वभावनः ॥ 1 ॥
4.153.m: The Blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / I shall describe the water cow, through the gift of which / Hṛṣīkeśa, the god of gods, the source of all beings, is pleased and worshipped.

4.153.s:
jalakuṃbhaṃ naravyāghra sthāpayitvā supūjitam ..
ratnagarbhaṃ tu taṃ kṛtvā grāmyairdhānyai samanvitam .. 2 ..
4.153.d:
जलकुंभं नरव्याघ्र स्थापयित्वा सुपूजितम् ॥
रत्नगर्भं तु तं कृत्वा ग्राम्यैर्धान्यै समन्वितम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.153.m: Having set up a well-worshipped water jar, O tiger among men, / filled with jewels, and provided with cultivated grains,

4.153.s:
sitavastrayugacchannaṃ dūrvāpallavaśobhitam ..
kuṣṭhamāṃsīpurośīravālakāmalakīyutam .. 3 ..
4.153.d:
सितवस्त्रयुगच्छन्नं दूर्वापल्लवशोभितम् ॥
कुष्ठमांसीपुरोशीरवालकामलकीयुतम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.153.m: covered with a pair of white garments, adorned with sprouts of dūrvā grass, / furnished with costus, spikenard, bdellium, vetiver, vālaka, and myrobalan,

4.153.s:
priyaṅgupatrasahitaṃ sitayajñopavītinam ..
sopānaktaṃ ca sacchatraṃ darbhaviṣṭarasaṃsthitam .. 4 ..
4.153.d:
प्रियङ्गुपत्रसहितं सितयज्ञोपवीतिनम् ॥
सोपानक्तं च सच्छत्रं दर्भविष्टरसंस्थितम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.153.m: accompanied by priyaṅgu leaves, having a white sacred thread, / with sandals and a royal parasol, placed upon a seat of darbha grass,

4.153.s:
caturbhiḥ saṃyutaṃ raupyaṃ tilapātraiścaturdiśam ..
sthagitaṃ dadhipātreṇa ghṛtakṣaudravatā mukhama. .. 5 ..
4.153.d:
चतुर्भिः संयुतं रौप्यं तिलपात्रैश्चतुर्दिशम् ॥
स्थगितं दधिपात्रेण घृतक्षौद्रवता मुखम॥। 5 ॥
4.153.m: furnished with four silver vessels of sesame in the four directions, / its mouth covered with a vessel of curd containing clarified butter and honey,

4.153.s:
savatsāṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpya gomayenopaśobhitām ..
sragdāmapucchīṃ kurvīta tāmradohanakānvitām .. 6 ..
4.153.d:
सवत्सां च प्रतिष्ठाप्य गोमयेनोपशोभिताम् ॥
स्रग्दामपुच्छीं कुर्वीत ताम्रदोहनकान्विताम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.153.m: having installed it with a calf and adorned it with cow dung, / one should make its tail of flower-garlands and provide it with a copper milking vessel.

4.153.s:
tataḥ samabhyarcya vibhuṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam ..
puṣpadhūpopahāraiśca yathāvibhavamātmanaḥ .. 7 ..
4.153.d:
ततः समभ्यर्च्य विभुं वासुदेवं सनातनम् ॥
पुष्पधूपोपहारैश्च यथाविभवमात्मनः ॥ 7 ॥
4.153.m: Then, having worshipped the all-pervading, eternal Vāsudeva / with flowers, incense, and food offerings according to one’s means,

4.153.s:
saṃkalpya jaladhenuṃ ca kuṃbhaṃ tamabhimaṃtrya ca ..
viṣṇorvakṣasi yā lakṣmīḥ svāhā yā ca vibhāvasoḥ ..
somaśakrārkaśaktiryā dhenurūpeṇa sāstu me .. 8 ..
4.153.d:
संकल्प्य जलधेनुं च कुंभं तमभिमंत्र्य च ॥
विष्णोर्वक्षसि या लक्ष्मीः स्वाहा या च विभावसोः ॥
सोमशक्रार्कशक्तिर्या धेनुरूपेण सास्तु मे ॥ 8 ॥
4.153.m: having resolved it as a water cow and consecrated that jar with the mantra: / "May Lakṣmī who is on Viṣṇu’s chest, Svāhā who belongs to the Fire-god, / and the power belonging to Soma, Indra, and the Sun, be mine in the form of a cow!"

4.153.s:
evamāmaṃtrya vidhivatsaphalāṃ vatsakānvitām ..
bhaktyā saṃpūjya goviṃdaṃ jalaśāyinamacyutam .. 9 ..
4.153.d:
एवमामंत्र्य विधिवत्सफलां वत्सकान्विताम् ॥
भक्त्या संपूज्य गोविंदं जलशायिनमच्युतम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.153.m: Having thus invited it according to rule, furnished with fruits and a calf, / having worshipped with devotion Govinda who reclines upon the waters, the infallible,

4.153.s:
sitavastradharaḥ śāṃto vītarāgo vimatsaraḥ ..
dadyādviprāya rājendra prītyarthaṃ jalaśāyinaḥ .. 4.153.10 ..
4.153.d:
सितवस्त्रधरः शांतो वीतरागो विमत्सरः ॥
दद्याद्विप्राय राजेन्द्र प्रीत्यर्थं जलशायिनः ॥ 4.153.10 ॥
4.153.m: wearing white garments, tranquil, free from passion and envy, / one should give it to a brāhmaṇa, O best of kings, for the pleasure of the one who reclines upon the waters:

4.153.s:
śeṣaparyaṃkaśayanaḥ śrīmāñchārṅgavibhūṣitaḥ ..
jalaśāyī jagadyoniḥ prīyatāṃ mama keśavaḥ .. 11 ..
4.153.d:
शेषपर्यंकशयनः श्रीमाञ्छार्ङ्गविभूषितः ॥
जलशायी जगद्योनिः प्रीयतां मम केशवः ॥ 11 ॥
4.153.m: "May Keśava be pleased with me—he who sleeps upon the couch of Śeṣa, the glorious one, adorned with the Śārṅga bow, / who reclines upon the waters, the womb of the universe!"

4.153.s:
ityuccārya jagannāthaṃ viprāya prati pādya tām ..
taddinaṃ govratastiṣṭhecchraddhayā parayā yutaḥ .. 12 ..
4.153.d:
इत्युच्चार्य जगन्नाथं विप्राय प्रति पाद्य ताम् ॥
तद्दिनं गोव्रतस्तिष्ठेच्छ्रद्धया परया युतः ॥ 12 ॥
4.153.m: Having spoken thus to the Lord of the World and delivered it to a brāhmaṇa, / he should observe the vow of the cow on that day, endowed with supreme faith.

4.153.s:
anena vidhinā dattvā jaladhenuṃ janādhipa ..
sarvabhogānavāpnoti ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ .. 13 ..
4.153.d:
अनेन विधिना दत्त्वा जलधेनुं जनाधिप ॥
सर्वभोगानवाप्नोति ये दिव्या ये च मानुषाः ॥ 13 ॥
4.153.m: Having given a water cow according to this procedure, O ruler of people, / he attains all enjoyments, both celestial and human.

4.153.s:
śarīrārogyamatulaṃ praśamaḥ sarvakālikaḥ ..
nṛṇāṃ bhavaṃti dattāyāṃ sarve kāmā na saṃśayaḥ .. 14 ..
4.153.d:
शरीरारोग्यमतुलं प्रशमः सर्वकालिकः ॥
नृणां भवंति दत्तायां सर्वे कामा न संशयः ॥ 14 ॥
4.153.m: Incomparable bodily health and perpetual tranquility / and all desires come to men when it is given; of this there is no doubt.

4.153.s:
atrāpi śrūyate bhūpa mudgale na mahātmanā ..
jātismareṇa yadgītamihābhyetya purā kila .. 15 ..
4.153.d:
अत्रापि श्रूयते भूप मुद्गले न महात्मना ॥
जातिस्मरेण यद्गीतमिहाभ्येत्य पुरा किल ॥ 15 ॥
4.153.m: In this matter also is heard, O king, what was sung of old / by the great-souled Mudgala who remembered his former births, when he came here.

4.153.s:
sa mudgalaḥ purā vipro yamalokagato muniḥ ..
dadarśa yātanānekāḥ pāpakarmakṛtāṃ nṛṇām .. 16 ..
4.153.d:
स मुद्गलः पुरा विप्रो यमलोकगतो मुनिः ॥
ददर्श यातनानेकाः पापकर्मकृतां नृणाम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.153.m: That Mudgala, a brāhmaṇa sage of old, having gone to Yama’s realm, / beheld the numerous torments of men who had performed sinful acts:

4.153.s:
dīptāgnitīkṣṇayantrasthāḥ kvāthatailamayāstathā ..
uṣṇakṣāranadīpātā bhairavāḥ puruṣarṣabha .. 17 ..
4.153.d:
दीप्ताग्नितीक्ष्णयन्त्रस्थाः क्वाथतैलमयास्तथा ॥
उष्णक्षारनदीपाता भैरवाः पुरुषर्षभ ॥ 17 ॥
4.153.m: those placed in blazes of fire and sharp torture-engines, immersed in boiling oil, / thrown into rivers of boiling caustic, [all] terrifying, O bull among men,

4.153.s:
vraṇakṣāranipātotha kumbhīpākamahālayāḥ ..
tā dṛṣṭvā yātanā vipraścakāra paramāṃ kṛpām .. 18 ..
4.153.d:
व्रणक्षारनिपातोथ कुम्भीपाकमहालयाः ॥
ता दृष्ट्वा यातना विप्रश्चकार परमां कृपाम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.153.m: and the application of caustic to wounds, and the vast hell of Kumbhīpāka. / Having seen those torments, the brāhmaṇa was filled with supreme compassion.

4.153.s:
āhlādaṃ te tadā jagmuḥ pāpāstadanukaṃpayā ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nārakāḥ kecitsthitvā tadavalokinaḥ .. 19 ..
4.153.d:
आह्लादं ते तदा जग्मुः पापास्तदनुकंपया ॥
तं दृष्ट्वा नारकाः केचित्स्थित्वा तदवलोकिनः ॥ 19 ॥
4.153.m: Those sinners then experienced delight through his compassion; / seeing him, some denizens of hell stood gazing at him.

4.153.s:
tadavasthaṃ vilokyātha munirnārakamaṇḍalam ..
dharmarājaṃ sa papraccha teṣāṃ praśamakāraṇam .. 4.153.20 ..
4.153.d:
तदवस्थं विलोक्याथ मुनिर्नारकमण्डलम् ॥
धर्मराजं स पप्रच्छ तेषां प्रशमकारणम् ॥ 4.153.20 ॥
4.153.m: Beholding the assembly of hell-dwellers in that state, the sage / asked the King of Dharma the cause of their relief.

4.153.s:
tasmai cācaṣṭa rājendra tadā vaivasvato yamaḥ ..
āhlādahetumadhikaṃ nārakāṇāṃ narottama .. 21 ..
4.153.d:
तस्मै चाचष्ट राजेन्द्र तदा वैवस्वतो यमः ॥
आह्लादहेतुमधिकं नारकाणां नरोत्तम ॥ 21 ॥
4.153.m: Then Yama, son of Vivasvat, told him, O king of kings, / O best of men, the supreme cause of the hell-dwellers' delight:

4.153.s:
dānānubhāvātsarveṣāṃ nārakāṇāṃ dvijottama ..
saṃpravṛto'yamāhlādaḥ kāraṇaṃ tacchṛṇu ṣva me .. 22 ..
4.153.d:
दानानुभावात्सर्वेषां नारकाणां द्विजोत्तम ॥
संप्रवृतोऽयमाह्लादः कारणं तच्छृणु ष्व मे ॥ 22 ॥
4.153.m: “Through the power of a gift, O best of the twice-born, for all the hell-dwellers / this delight has begun; hear from me the reason for that.

4.153.s:
tvayābhyarcya jagannāthaṃ sarveśaṃ jalaśāyinam ..
jaladhenuḥ purā dattā vidhivadvijapuṅgava .. 23 ..
4.153.d:
त्वयाभ्यर्च्य जगन्नाथं सर्वेशं जलशायिनम् ॥
जलधेनुः पुरा दत्ता विधिवद्विजपुङ्गव ॥ 23 ॥
4.153.m: Having worshipped the Lord of the World, the Lord of All who reclines on the waters, / a water-cow was formerly given by you according to the rules, O bull among the twice-born.

4.153.s:
tasmātvajjanmano'tīte tṛtīye dvija janmani ..
tasya dānasya te vyuṣṭiriyamāhlādadāyinī .. 24 ..
4.153.d:
तस्मात्वज्जन्मनोऽतीते तृतीये द्विज जन्मनि ॥
तस्य दानस्य ते व्युष्टिरियमाह्लाददायिनी ॥ 24 ॥
4.153.m: Now that three births have passed since that birth of yours, O twice-born, / this is the reward of that gift of yours, bestowing delight.

4.153.s:
ye tvāṃ paśyaṃti śṛṇvaṃti ye ca dhyāyaṃti mānavāḥ ..
śṛṇoṣi yāṃśca viprendra yāṃśca dhyāyasi paśyasi ..25..
4.153.d:
ये त्वां पश्यंति शृण्वंति ये च ध्यायंति मानवाः ॥
शृणोषि यांश्च विप्रेन्द्र यांश्च ध्यायसि पश्यसि ॥25॥
4.153.m: Those men who see you, who hear [you], and who meditate upon you, / and those whom you hear, O chief of brahmins, and whom you meditate upon and see—

4.153.s:
nivṛttiḥ paramā teṣāṃ sarvāhlādapradāyinī ..
sadyo bhavati mā'tra tvaṃ dvijāte kuru vismayam .. 26 ..
4.153.d:
निवृत्तिः परमा तेषां सर्वाह्लादप्रदायिनी ॥
सद्यो भवति माऽत्र त्वं द्विजाते कुरु विस्मयम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.153.m: for them supreme relief immediately arises, granting all delight. / Do not feel astonishment at this, O twice-born.

4.153.s:
āhlādahetujananaṃ nāsti viprendra tādṛśam ..
jaladhenuryathā nṛṇāṃ janmānyekonaviṃśatim ..27..
4.153.d:
आह्लादहेतुजननं नास्ति विप्रेन्द्र तादृशम् ॥
जलधेनुर्यथा नृणां जन्मान्येकोनविंशतिम् ॥27॥
4.153.m: There is nothing that produces a cause of delight like that, O chief of brahmins, / as a water-cow [does] for men for nineteen births.

4.153.s:
na doṣo na jvaro nārtirna klamo dvija jāyate ..
api janmasahasre'pi jaladhenupradāyinām .. 28 ..
4.153.d:
न दोषो न ज्वरो नार्तिर्न क्लमो द्विज जायते ॥
अपि जन्मसहस्रेऽपि जलधेनुप्रदायिनाम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.153.m: Neither affliction, nor fever, nor distress, nor exhaustion arises, O twice-born, / even across a thousand births, for givers of a water-cow.

4.153.s:
sa tvaṃ gaccha gṛhītvārdhamasmato dvijasattama ..
yeṣāṃ samāśrayaḥ kṛṣṇe na niyamyā hi te mayā .. 29 ..
4.153.d:
स त्वं गच्छ गृहीत्वार्धमस्मतो द्विजसत्तम ॥
येषां समाश्रयः कृष्णे न नियम्या हि ते मया ॥ 29 ॥
4.153.m: Therefore, depart, having received half from us, O best of the twice-born; / for those who have taken refuge in Kṛṣṇa are not to be punished by me.

4.153.s:
kṛṣṇastu pūjito yaistu ye kṛṣṇārthamupoṣitāḥ ..
yaiśca nityaṃ smṛtaḥ kṛṣṇo na te madviṣayopagāḥ .. 4.153.30 ..
4.153.d:
कृष्णस्तु पूजितो यैस्तु ये कृष्णार्थमुपोषिताः ॥
यैश्च नित्यं स्मृतः कृष्णो न ते मद्विषयोपगाः ॥ 4.153.30 ॥
4.153.m: Those by whom Kṛṣṇa has been worshipped, who have fasted for the sake of Kṛṣṇa, / and by whom Kṛṣṇa is constantly remembered, do not come into my realm.

4.153.s:
namaḥ kṛṣṇācyutānaṃta vāsudevetyudīritam ..
yairbhā vabhāvitairvipra na te madviṣayopagāḥ ..31..
4.153.d:
नमः कृष्णाच्युतानंत वासुदेवेत्युदीरितम् ॥
यैर्भा वभावितैर्विप्र न ते मद्विषयोपगाः ॥31॥
4.153.m: Those by whom, filled with devotion, O brahmin, it is uttered: / ‘Homage to Kṛṣṇa, Acyuta, Ananta, Vāsudeva!’, do not come into my realm.

4.153.s:
dānaṃ dadadbhiryairuktamacyutaḥ prīyatāmiti ..
śraddhāpuraḥsarairvipra na te madviṣayopagāḥ .. 32 ..
4.153.d:
दानं ददद्भिर्यैरुक्तमच्युतः प्रीयतामिति ॥
श्रद्धापुरःसरैर्विप्र न ते मद्विषयोपगाः ॥ 32 ॥
4.153.m: Those who, accompanied by faith, say while giving a gift: / ‘May Acyuta be pleased!’, O brahmin, do not come into my realm.

4.153.s:
sa eva nāthaḥ sarvasya tanniyogakarā vayam ..
janasaṃyamanaścāhamasmatsaṃyamano hariḥ .. 33 ..
4.153.d:
स एव नाथः सर्वस्य तन्नियोगकरा वयम् ॥
जनसंयमनश्चाहमस्मत्संयमनो हरिः ॥ 33 ॥
4.153.m: He alone is the lord of all; we are the executors of his commands. / I am the restrainer of people, but Hari is our restrainer.”

4.153.s:
itthaṃ niśamya vacanaṃ yamasya vadato'khilam ..
ūcuste nārakāḥ sarve vahniśastrārkabhīravaḥ ..34..
4.153.d:
इत्थं निशम्य वचनं यमस्य वदतोऽखिलम् ॥
ऊचुस्ते नारकाः सर्वे वह्निशस्त्रार्कभीरवः ॥34॥
4.153.m: Hearing this entire speech uttered by Yama, / all those hell-dwellers, terrified of fire, weapons, and the sun, said:

4.153.s:
namaḥ kṛṣṇāya haraye viṣṇave jiṣṇave namaḥ ..
hṛṣīkeśāya keśāya jagaddhātre'cyutāya ca .. 35 ..
4.153.d:
नमः कृष्णाय हरये विष्णवे जिष्णवे नमः ॥
हृषीकेशाय केशाय जगद्धात्रेऽच्युताय च ॥ 35 ॥
4.153.m: “Homage to Kṛṣṇa, to Hari, to Viṣṇu, homage to the victorious one! / To Hṛṣīkeśa, to Keśa, to the Supporter of the World, and to Acyuta!

4.153.s:
namaḥ paṅkajanetrāya namaḥ paṅkajanābhaye ..
janārdanāya śrīśāya śrībhartre pītavāsase .. 36 ..
4.153.d:
नमः पङ्कजनेत्राय नमः पङ्कजनाभये ॥
जनार्दनाय श्रीशाय श्रीभर्त्रे पीतवाससे ॥ 36 ॥
4.153.m: Homage to the lotus-eyed one! Homage to the lotus-naveled one! / To Janārdana, the Lord of Śrī, the Consort of Śrī, the yellow-robed one!

4.153.s:
goviṃdāya namo nityaṃ namaścodadhiśāyine ..
namaḥ kamalanetrāya nṛsiṃhāya ninādine .. 37 ..
4.153.d:
गोविंदाय नमो नित्यं नमश्चोदधिशायिने ॥
नमः कमलनेत्राय नृसिंहाय निनादिने ॥ 37 ॥
4.153.m: Perpetual homage to Govinda! And homage to the one who reclines upon the ocean! / Homage to the lotus-eyed one, to the roaring Nṛsiṃha!

4.153.s:
śārṅgiṇe śitakhaḍgāya śaṃkhacakragadābhṛte ..
namo vāmanarūpāya krāṃtalokatrayāya ca .. 38 ..
4.153.d:
शार्ङ्गिणे शितखड्गाय शंखचक्रगदाभृते ॥
नमो वामनरूपाय क्रांतलोकत्रयाय च ॥ 38 ॥
4.153.m: To the bearer of the Śārṅga bow, the sharp sword, the conch, discus, and mace! / Homage to the one whose form is the Dwarf, who strode through the three worlds!

4.153.s:
varāharūpāya tathā namo yajñāṅgadhāriṇe ..
vyāptāśeṣadigaṃtāyānaṃtāya paramātmane ..39..
4.153.d:
वराहरूपाय तथा नमो यज्ञाङ्गधारिणे ॥
व्याप्ताशेषदिगंतायानंताय परमात्मने ॥39॥
4.153.m: Likewise, homage to the one whose form is the Boar, who embodies the limbs of the sacrifice! / To the Infinite One, the Supreme Self, who pervades all ends of the directions!

4.153.s:
vāsudeva namastubhyaṃ namaḥ kaiṭabhasūdine ..
keśavāya namo rāma namastestu mahīdhara ..4.153.40..
4.153.d:
वासुदेव नमस्तुभ्यं नमः कैटभसूदिने ॥
केशवाय नमो राम नमस्तेस्तु महीधर ॥4.153.40॥
4.153.m: O Vāsudeva, homage to you! Homage to the slayer of Kaiṭabha! / Homage to Keśava! O Rāma, homage be to you, O Upholder of the Earth!”

4.153.s:
namo'stu vāsudevāya hyevamuccārite ca taiḥ ..
śastrāṇi kuṃṭhatāṃ jagmuranalaścāpi śītatām .. 41 ..
4.153.d:
नमोऽस्तु वासुदेवाय ह्येवमुच्चारिते च तैः ॥
शस्त्राणि कुंठतां जग्मुरनलश्चापि शीतताम् ॥ 41 ॥
4.153.m: When ‘Homage be to Vāsudeva!’ was thus uttered by them, / the weapons became blunt, and the fire turned cool.

4.153.s:
samabhajyaṃta vastrāṇi samutpeturayomukhāḥ ..
saṃśuṣkā kṣārasaritaḥ patitaḥ śālmalidrumaḥ .. 42 ..
4.153.d:
समभज्यंत वस्त्राणि समुत्पेतुरयोमुखाः ॥
संशुष्का क्षारसरितः पतितः शाल्मलिद्रुमः ॥ 42 ॥
4.153.m: The bonds shattered; the iron-beaked birds flew away; / the rivers of alkali dried up; the silk-cotton tree fell.

4.153.s:
prakāśastamaso jajñe narakādbhānubhiḥ saha ..
vavau ca yuṃjanpavano'pyasipatravane tataḥ .. 43 ..
4.153.d:
प्रकाशस्तमसो जज्ञे नरकाद्भानुभिः सह ॥
ववौ च युंजन्पवनोऽप्यसिपत्रवने ततः ॥ 43 ॥
4.153.m: Light arose from the darkness of hell together with rays of the sun, / and a gentle wind blew across the grove of sword-leaved trees.

4.153.s:
nirutsāhā jaḍadhiyo babhūvuryamakiṃkarāḥ ..
jātā gaṅgāmbuvāhinyaḥ pūyaśauṇitanimnagāḥ ..44..
4.153.d:
निरुत्साहा जडधियो बभूवुर्यमकिंकराः ॥
जाता गङ्गाम्बुवाहिन्यः पूयशौणितनिम्नगाः ॥44॥
4.153.m: Yama's servants became powerless and paralyzed in mind; / the rivers of pus and blood became streams flowing with Gaṅgā water.

4.153.s:
divyaḥ sugaṃdhi pavano manaḥprītikarastathā ..
veṇuvīṇāsvanayutāḥ śabdāścāsanmanoramāḥ .. 45 ..
4.153.d:
दिव्यः सुगंधि पवनो मनःप्रीतिकरस्तथा ॥
वेणुवीणास्वनयुताः शब्दाश्चासन्मनोरमाः ॥ 45 ॥
4.153.m: A divine, fragrant wind blew, bringing delight to the mind, / and delightful sounds mingled with the music of flutes and lutes arose.

4.153.s:
taṃ tādṛśamathālakṣya tadā vaivasvato yamaḥ ..
kṣīṇapāpatrayāṃstāṃstu pādyārghyaiḥ samapūjayat .. 46 ..
4.153.d:
तं तादृशमथालक्ष्य तदा वैवस्वतो यमः ॥
क्षीणपापत्रयांस्तांस्तु पाद्यार्घ्यैः समपूजयत् ॥ 46 ॥
4.153.m: Then, observing it to be so, Yama, the son of Vivasvat, / honoured those whose three kinds of sins were eradicated with water for the feet and guest-offerings.

4.153.s:
pūjayitvā ca tānāha kṛṣṇāya sa kṛtāṃjaliḥ ..
samāhitamatirbhūtvā dharmarājo nareśvara .. 47 ..
4.153.d:
पूजयित्वा च तानाह कृष्णाय स कृतांजलिः ॥
समाहितमतिर्भूत्वा धर्मराजो नरेश्वर ॥ 47 ॥
4.153.m: And having honoured them, the King of Dharma, with folded hands / and a concentrated mind, addressed Kṛṣṇa, O lord of men:

4.153.s:
viṣṇo deva jagaddhātarjanārdana jagatpate ..
praṇāmaṃ ye'pi kurvanti teṣāmapi namonamaḥ .. 48 ..
4.153.d:
विष्णो देव जगद्धातर्जनार्दन जगत्पते ॥
प्रणामं येऽपि कुर्वन्ति तेषामपि नमोनमः ॥ 48 ॥
4.153.m: “O Viṣṇu, O God, O Supporter of the World, O Janārdana, O Lord of the Universe! / Homage, homage even to those who make obeisance [to you]!

4.153.s:
acyutāyāprameyāya māyāvāmanarūpiṇe ..
praṇāmaṃ ye'pi kurvanti teṣāmapi namo namaḥ .. 49 ..
4.153.d:
अच्युतायाप्रमेयाय मायावामनरूपिणे ॥
प्रणामं येऽपि कुर्वन्ति तेषामपि नमो नमः ॥ 49 ॥
4.153.m: To Acyuta, the immeasurable, whose form is the illusory Dwarf! / Homage, homage even to those who make obeisance [to you]!

4.153.s:
namaste vāsudevāya dhīmate puṇyakīrtaye ..
praṇāmaṃ ye ca kurvaṃti teṣāmapi namo namaḥ .. 4.153.50 ..
4.153.d:
नमस्ते वासुदेवाय धीमते पुण्यकीर्तये ॥
प्रणामं ये च कुर्वंति तेषामपि नमो नमः ॥ 4.153.50 ॥
4.153.m: Homage to you, O Vāsudeva, wise one of sacred renown! / And homage, homage even to those who make obeisance [to you]!”

4.153.s: tasya yajñavarāhasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ .. 51 ..
4.153.d: तस्य यज्ञवराहस्य विष्णोरमिततेजसः ॥ 51 ॥
4.153.m: […] of that Viṣṇu of boundless splendour, the sacrificial Boar.

4.153.s:
evaṃ stutvā hṛṣīkeśaṃ dharmarājasya paśyataḥ ..
vimānavaramāruhya nārakāstridivaṃ yayuḥ .. 52 ..
4.153.d:
एवं स्तुत्वा हृषीकेशं धर्मराजस्य पश्यतः ॥
विमानवरमारुह्य नारकास्त्रिदिवं ययुः ॥ 52 ॥
4.153.m: Having thus praised Hṛṣīkeśa, while the King of Dharma looked on, / the hell-dwellers mounted an excellent celestial chariot and went to heaven.

4.153.s:
mudgalo'pi mahābuddhirdṛṣṭvaitadakhilaṃ nṛpa ..
jātismaro bhavadvipraḥ kaṇvagotre mahāmuniḥ ..53..
4.153.d:
मुद्गलोऽपि महाबुद्धिर्दृष्ट्वैतदखिलं नृप ॥
जातिस्मरो भवद्विप्रः कण्वगोत्रे महामुनिः ॥53॥
4.153.m: Mudgala too, of great intelligence, having seen all this, O king, / remembered his past lives—the brahmin, a great sage in the lineage of Kaṇva.

4.153.s:
saṃsmṛtya yamavākyāni viṣṇormāhātmyameva ca..
jaladhenostu māhātmyaṃ saṃsmṛtyedamagāyata..54..
4.153.d:
संस्मृत्य यमवाक्यानि विष्णोर्माहात्म्यमेव च॥
जलधेनोस्तु माहात्म्यं संस्मृत्येदमगायत॥54॥
4.153.m: Remembering the words of Yama and the greatness of Viṣṇu, / and remembering the greatness of the water-cow, he sang this:

4.153.s:
aho sudustarā viṣṇormāyeyamatigahvarī ..
yayā mohitacittastu na vetti parameśvaram ..55..
4.153.d:
अहो सुदुस्तरा विष्णोर्मायेयमतिगह्वरी ॥
यया मोहितचित्तस्तु न वेत्ति परमेश्वरम् ॥55॥
4.153.m: “Ah, this Māyā of Viṣṇu is hard to cross, exceedingly deep, / bewildered by which the mind does not know the Supreme Lord.

4.153.s:
jīvo gacchati kīṭatvaṃ yūkāmatkuṇayonitām..
tasmāddrumalatādīnāṃ yoniṃ tasmācca pakṣiṇām .. 56 ..
4.153.d:
जीवो गच्छति कीटत्वं यूकामत्कुणयोनिताम्॥
तस्माद्द्रुमलतादीनां योनिं तस्माच्च पक्षिणाम् ॥ 56 ॥
4.153.m: The soul enters the state of an insect, the womb of a louse or a bug; / from that, the womb of trees, creepers, and the like; from that, of birds;

4.153.s:
tataśca paśutāṃ prāpya naratvamabhivāṃchati ..
tato manuṣyatāṃ prāpya naro yoniṃ kṛtātmanām ..
tāṃ prāpya ca śriyaṃ parāṃ naro māyāvimohitaḥ ..57..
4.153.d:
ततश्च पशुतां प्राप्य नरत्वमभिवांछति ॥
ततो मनुष्यतां प्राप्य नरो योनिं कृतात्मनाम् ॥
तां प्राप्य च श्रियं परां नरो मायाविमोहितः ॥57॥
4.153.m: and then, having attained the state of a beast, it longs for the state of a human; / having attained humanity, a person enters the womb of the perfected; / and having attained that and supreme glory, a man is bewildered by Māyā.

4.153.s:
dustarāpi susādhyā sā māyā kṛṣṇasya mohinī ..
vidyate sā manonyastā mudhaiva madhusūdane ..58..
4.153.d:
दुस्तरापि सुसाध्या सा माया कृष्णस्य मोहिनी ॥
विद्यते सा मनोन्यस्ता मुधैव मधुसूदने ॥58॥
4.153.m: Though hard to cross, that bewitching Māyā of Kṛṣṇa is easily mastered; / it is found [vanquished] in Madhusūdana with the mind effortlessly fixed on him.

4.153.s:
avāpyaivaṃ ca gārhasthyamavāpyaivaṃ ca tatparam ..
chinatti vaiṣṇavīṃ māyāṃ keśavārpitamānasaḥ .. 59 ..
4.153.d:
अवाप्यैवं च गार्हस्थ्यमवाप्यैवं च तत्परम् ॥
छिनत्ति वैष्णवीं मायां केशवार्पितमानसः ॥ 59 ॥
4.153.m: Having attained householdership in this way, and having attained that supreme [state] in this way, / one whose mind is surrendered to Keśava cuts through the Vaiṣṇava Māyā.

4.153.s:
avirodhena viṣayānbhuñjanviṣṇuṃ samāśrayet ...
bhuktvā narastaratyenāṃ viṣṇormāyāṃ sudustarām .. 4.153.60 ..
4.153.d:
अविरोधेन विषयान्भुञ्जन्विष्णुं समाश्रयेत् ॥।
भुक्त्वा नरस्तरत्येनां विष्णोर्मायां सुदुस्तराम् ॥ 4.153.60 ॥
4.153.m: Enjoying sense-objects without contradiction [to dharma], one should take refuge in Viṣṇu; / having enjoyed them, a man crosses over this Māyā of Viṣṇu, which is very hard to cross.

4.153.s:
īdṛgbahuphalā bhaktiḥ sarvadhātari keśave ..
māyayā tasya devasya tāṃ na kurvaṃti mohitāḥ .. .. 61 ..
4.153.d:
ईदृग्बहुफला भक्तिः सर्वधातरि केशवे ॥
मायया तस्य देवस्य तां न कुर्वंति मोहिताः ॥ ॥ 61 ॥
4.153.m: Such is devotion yielding manifold fruits toward Keśava, the creator of all; / deluded by that god’s Māyā, they do not practice it.

4.153.s:
mudhaivoktaṃ sudhāpānaṃ mudhā taddhi viceṣṭitam ..
mudhaiva janma tannaṣṭaṃ yatra nārādhito hariḥ .. 62 ..
4.153.d:
मुधैवोक्तं सुधापानं मुधा तद्धि विचेष्टितम् ॥
मुधैव जन्म तन्नष्टं यत्र नाराधितो हरिः ॥ 62 ॥
4.153.m: In vain is the drinking of nectar spoken of; in vain indeed is that effort; / in vain indeed is that birth lost in which Hari is not worshipped.

4.153.s:
ārādhito hi yaḥ puṃsāmaihikāmuṣmikaṃ phalam ..
dadāti bhagavāndevaḥ kastaṃ na pratipūjayet .. 63 ..
4.153.d:
आराधितो हि यः पुंसामैहिकामुष्मिकं फलम् ॥
ददाति भगवान्देवः कस्तं न प्रतिपूजयेत् ॥ 63 ॥
4.153.m: For when worshipped, the Lord God bestows the fruit / of this world and the next—who would not worship him?

4.153.s:
saṃvatsarāstathā māsā viphalā divasāśca te ..
narāṇāṃ viṣayāṃdhānāṃ yaistu nārādhito hariḥ .. 64 ..
4.153.d:
संवत्सरास्तथा मासा विफला दिवसाश्च ते ॥
नराणां विषयांधानां यैस्तु नाराधितो हरिः ॥ 64 ॥
4.153.m: The years, the months, and the days are completely wasted / for men blinded by sense-objects, by whom Hari is not worshipped.”

4.153.s:
yo na vittarddhivibhavairna vāsobhirna bhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
tuṣyate hṛdayenaiva kastamīśaṃ na pūjayet .. 65 ..
4.153.d:
यो न वित्तर्द्धिविभवैर्न वासोभिर्न भूषणैः ॥
तुष्यते हृदयेनैव कस्तमीशं न पूजयेत् ॥ 65 ॥
4.153.m: He who is pleased not by the abundance of wealth and power, not by garments, not by ornaments, / but by the heart alone—who would not worship that Lord?

4.153.s:
jaladhenostu māhātmyaṃ niśamyedṛgvidhaṃ narāḥ..
nātra yacchaṃti teṣāṃ vai vivekaḥ kutra tiṣṭhati .. 66 ..
4.153.d:
जलधेनोस्तु माहात्म्यं निशम्येदृग्विधं नराः॥
नात्र यच्छंति तेषां वै विवेकः कुत्र तिष्ठति ॥ 66 ॥
4.153.m: Having heard of such greatness of the water-cow, / if men do not offer it here, where indeed does their discernment abide?

4.153.s:
karmabhūmau hi mānuṣyaṃ janmanāmayutairapi ..
svargāpavargaphaladaṃ kadācitprāpyate naraiḥ .. 67 ..
4.153.d:
कर्मभूमौ हि मानुष्यं जन्मनामयुतैरपि ॥
स्वर्गापवर्गफलदं कदाचित्प्राप्यते नरैः ॥ 67 ॥
4.153.m: For human birth in this realm of action, which yields the fruits of heaven and liberation, / is obtained by men only occasionally, even after ten thousand births.

4.153.s:
saṃprāpya ca na yairviṣṇustoṣito jaladhenunā ..
te janā bhraṣṭajanmāno vaṃcitāstasya māyayā .. 68 ..
4.153.d:
संप्राप्य च न यैर्विष्णुस्तोषितो जलधेनुना ॥
ते जना भ्रष्टजन्मानो वंचितास्तस्य मायया ॥ 68 ॥
4.153.m: And having attained it, those by whom Viṣṇu is not gratified with a water-cow— / those people have wasted their lives, deceived by his Māyā.

4.153.s:
ūrdhvabāhurviraumyeṣa dṛṣṭalokadvayo'smi bhoḥ ..
ārādhayadhvaṃ govindaṃ jaladhenuṃ prayacchata .. 69 ..
4.153.d:
ऊर्ध्वबाहुर्विरौम्येष दृष्टलोकद्वयोऽस्मि भोः ॥
आराधयध्वं गोविन्दं जलधेनुं प्रयच्छत ॥ 69 ॥
4.153.m: With upraised arms I cry aloud, O men, having witnessed both worlds: / Worship Govinda! Give a water-cow!

4.153.s:
duḥsaho nārako vahniraviṣahyā ca yātanā ..
jñātaṃ mayaitadālaṃbya kṛṣṇaṃ bhavati niścalaḥ .. 4.153.70 ..
4.153.d:
