दुःसहो नारको वह्निरविषह्या च यातना ॥
ज्ञातं मयैतदालंब्य कृष्णं भवति निश्चलः ॥ 4.153.70 ॥
4.153.m: Unbearable is the fire of hell, and insufferable is its torment. / I have known this: relying upon Kṛṣṇa, one becomes unshaken.

4.153.s:
ādeśiko deśiko hi yamamārge sudustare ..
vicintya tatsatyametanmanaḥ kṛṣṇe niveśyatām .. 71 ..
4.153.d:
आदेशिको देशिको हि यममार्गे सुदुस्तरे ॥
विचिन्त्य तत्सत्यमेतन्मनः कृष्णे निवेश्यताम् ॥ 71 ॥
4.153.m: He is indeed the teacher and guide on the path of Yama, so hard to traverse. / Reflecting on this truth, let the mind be fixed on Kṛṣṇa.

4.153.s:
iṣṭena kiṃ kratuśatena suduṣkareṇa kleśādhikena sukṛtairniyamairvrataiśca ..
dattā dvijāya pitṛrājagṛhaṃ gatasya hyekā'pi gaurjalamayī sukhamātanoti ..72... ..
ghṛtadhenudānavratavarṇanam
4.153.d:
इष्टेन किं क्रतुशतेन सुदुष्करेण क्लेशाधिकेन सुकृतैर्नियमैर्व्रतैश्च ॥
दत्ता द्विजाय पितृराजगृहं गतस्य ह्येकाऽपि गौर्जलमयी सुखमातनोति ॥72॥॥।
घृतधेनुदानव्रतवर्णनम्
4.153.m:
What is the use of a hundred sacrifices, so hard to perform, accompanied by much hardship, or of well-done restraints and votive observances? / Even a single cow made of water, given to a twice-born, extends happiness to one who has gone to the abode of the King of the Ancestors.
Description of the Votive Observance of the Gift of a Ghee-Cow

4.154.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ghṛtadhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi tāṃ śṛṇuṣva narottama ..
dīyate yena vidhinā yādṛgrūpāṃ ca kārayet .. 1 ..
4.154.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
घृतधेनुं प्रवक्ष्यामि तां शृणुष्व नरोत्तम ॥
दीयते येन विधिना यादृग्रूपां च कारयेत् ॥ 1 ॥
4.154.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / I shall describe the ghee-cow; listen to it, best of men, / according to which rite it is given and in what form one should fashion it.
Pots of cow's ghee, adorned with fragrant scents and garlands, / provided with bronze milking vessels, veiled with white cloth,

4.154.s:
ikṣuyaṣṭimayāḥ pādāḥ khurā raupyamayāstathā ..
sauvarṇe cākṣiṇī kārye śṛṃge cāgurukāṣṭhake .. 3 ..
4.154.d:
इक्षुयष्टिमयाः पादाः खुरा रौप्यमयास्तथा ॥
सौवर्णे चाक्षिणी कार्ये शृंगे चागुरुकाष्ठके ॥ 3 ॥
4.154.m: the legs made of sugar-cane stalks, and the hooves made of silver; / the eyes should be made of gold, and the horns of agallochum wood;

4.154.s:
saptadhānyamaye pārśve paṭorṇena ca kambalam ..
kuryātturuṣkakarpūrairghrāṇaṃ phalamayānstanān .. 4 ..
4.154.d:
सप्तधान्यमये पार्श्वे पटोर्णेन च कम्बलम् ॥
कुर्यात्तुरुष्ककर्पूरैर्घ्राणं फलमयान्स्तनान् ॥ 4 ॥
4.154.m: the flanks made of seven grains, and the dewlap of silk; / one should fashion the snout of Turkish incense and camphor, and the udders made of fruits;

4.154.s:
tadvaccharkarayā jihvāṃ guḍakṣīramayaṃ mukham ..
kṣaumasūtreṇa lāṃgūlaṃ romāṇi sitasarṣapaiḥ .. 5 ..
4.154.d:
तद्वच्छर्करया जिह्वां गुडक्षीरमयं मुखम् ॥
क्षौमसूत्रेण लांगूलं रोमाणि सितसर्षपैः ॥ 5 ॥
4.154.m: likewise the tongue of sugar, the face made of molasses and milk, / the tail of flaxen thread, and the hair of white mustard seeds.

4.154.s:
tāmrapātramayaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ kuryācchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
īdṛgrūpāṃ tu saṃkalpya ghṛtadhenuṃ narādhipa .. 6 ..
4.154.d:
ताम्रपात्रमयं पृष्ठं कुर्याच्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः ॥
ईदृग्रूपां तु संकल्प्य घृतधेनुं नराधिप ॥ 6 ॥
4.154.m: One endowed with faith should make the back of a copper vessel. / Having thus fashioned the ghee-cow, O king of men,

4.154.s:
tadvatkalpanayā dhenorvatsaṃ ca parikalpayet ..
maṃtreṇānena rājendra tāṃ samabhyarcya buddhimān .. 7 ..
4.154.d:
तद्वत्कल्पनया धेनोर्वत्सं च परिकल्पयेत् ॥
मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र तां समभ्यर्च्य बुद्धिमान् ॥ 7 ॥
4.154.m: by a similar design, one should also fashion the cow's calf. / Having worshipped her with this mantra, O king of kings, the wise man [recites]:

4.154.s:
ājyaṃ tejaḥ samuddiṣṭamājyaṃ pāpaharaṃ param ..
ājyaṃ surāṇāmāhāraḥ sarvamājye pratiṣṭhitam.. 8 ..
4.154.d:
आज्यं तेजः समुद्दिष्टमाज्यं पापहरं परम् ॥
आज्यं सुराणामाहारः सर्वमाज्ये प्रतिष्ठितम्॥ 8 ॥
4.154.m: "Clarified butter is declared to be fiery energy; clarified butter is the supreme destroyer of sin; / clarified butter is the food of the gods; everything is established in clarified butter.

4.154.s:
tvaṃ caivājyamayī devi kalpitāsi mayā kila ..
sarvapāpāpanodāya sukhāya bhava bhāmini .. 9 ..
4.154.d:
त्वं चैवाज्यमयी देवि कल्पितासि मया किल ॥
सर्वपापापनोदाय सुखाय भव भामिनि ॥ 9 ॥
4.154.m: And you, O goddess, are indeed fashioned by me out of clarified butter. / For the removal of all sins, bring happiness, O radiant one!"

4.154.s:
taṃ ca vipraṃ mahābhāga manaseva ghṛtārciṣā ..
kalpayitvā tatastasmai prayataḥ pratipādayet .. 4.154.10 ..
4.154.d:
तं च विप्रं महाभाग मनसेव घृतार्चिषा ॥
कल्पयित्वा ततस्तस्मै प्रयतः प्रतिपादयेत् ॥ 4.154.10 ॥
4.154.m: And conceiving that Brahmin in one's mind as the deity of fire, O fortunate one, / one who is purified should then present it to him:

4.154.s:
dakṣiṇāsahitā dhenuḥ kalpitājyamayī śubhā ..
etāṃ mamopakārāya gṛhāṇa tvaṃ dvijottama ..11..
4.154.d:
दक्षिणासहिता धेनुः कल्पिताज्यमयी शुभा ॥
एतां ममोपकाराय गृहाण त्वं द्विजोत्तम ॥11॥
4.154.m: "This auspicious cow fashioned of clarified butter, accompanied by a priestly gift— / accept this, O best of the twice-born, for my spiritual benefit."

4.154.s:
ityudāhṛtya viprāya tāṃ gāṃ tu pratipādayet ..
dattvaikarātraṃ sthitvā ca ghṛtāhāro yatavrataḥ .. 12 ..
4.154.d:
इत्युदाहृत्य विप्राय तां गां तु प्रतिपादयेत् ॥
दत्त्वैकरात्रं स्थित्वा च घृताहारो यतव्रतः ॥ 12 ॥
4.154.m: Having said this, he should present that cow to the Brahmin. / Having given it, he should remain for one night eating only ghee, restraining his vows.

4.154.s:
anena ca vidhānena navanītamayī śubhā ..
dātavyā nṛpate dhenurnyūnādhikavivarjitā .. 13 ..
4.154.d:
अनेन च विधानेन नवनीतमयी शुभा ॥
दातव्या नृपते धेनुर्न्यूनाधिकविवर्जिता ॥ 13 ॥
4.154.m: And by this same procedure, O king, an auspicious cow / made of fresh butter should be given, without omitting or adding [anything].

4.154.s:
śṛṇu pārtha mahābāho pradānaphalamuttamam..
ghṛtakṣīramahānadyo yatra pāyasakardamāḥ .. 14 ..
4.154.d:
शृणु पार्थ महाबाहो प्रदानफलमुत्तमम्॥
घृतक्षीरमहानद्यो यत्र पायसकर्दमाः ॥ 14 ॥
4.154.m: Hear, O long-armed son of Pṛthā, the supreme fruit of this gift: / Where there are great rivers of ghee and milk, with mud of milk-rice,

4.154.s:
ghṛtadhenupradā yāṃti tatra kāmaiḥ supūritāḥ ..
piturūrdhvaṃ ca ye sapta puruṣāstasya ye'pyadhaḥ .. 15 ..
4.154.d:
घृतधेनुप्रदा यांति तत्र कामैः सुपूरिताः ॥
पितुरूर्ध्वं च ये सप्त पुरुषास्तस्य येऽप्यधः ॥ 15 ॥
4.154.m: there the givers of a ghee-cow go, fully satisfied in their desires. / And whichever seven generations are above his father, and whichever are below,

4.154.s:
tāṃsteṣu nṛpa lokeṣu sa nayatyastakalmaṣān..
sakāmānāmiyaṃ vyuṣṭiḥ kathitā nṛpasattama .. 16 ..
4.154.d:
तांस्तेषु नृप लोकेषु स नयत्यस्तकल्मषान्॥
सकामानामियं व्युष्टिः कथिता नृपसत्तम ॥ 16 ॥
4.154.m: those he leads to those worlds, their sins removed, O king. / This reward has been declared for those who have desires, O best of kings;

4.154.s:
niṣkilviṣaṃ padaṃ yāṃti niṣkāmā ghṛtadhenudāḥ ..
ghṛtamagnirghṛtaṃ somastanmayāḥ sarvadevatāḥ .. 17 ..
4.154.d:
निष्किल्विषं पदं यांति निष्कामा घृतधेनुदाः ॥
घृतमग्निर्घृतं सोमस्तन्मयाः सर्वदेवताः ॥ 17 ॥
4.154.m: the desireless givers of a ghee-cow go to a stainless station. / Ghee is Agni, ghee is Soma; all the deities are made of it;
to those who offer ghee, all the gods become benevolent.

4.154.s:
māyājalaṃ sutakalatramahormimālaṃ lobhogranakraviṣamaṃ bahupuṇyabhājaḥ ..
lagnā nimagnavapuṣo ghṛtadhenupucche saṃsārasāgaramapāramaho taraṃti .. 19 .. ..
lavaṇadhenudānavratavarṇanam
4.154.d:
मायाजलं सुतकलत्रमहोर्मिमालं लोभोग्रनक्रविषमं बहुपुण्यभाजः ॥
लग्ना निमग्नवपुषो घृतधेनुपुच्छे संसारसागरमपारमहो तरंति ॥ 19 ॥ ॥
लवणधेनुदानव्रतवर्णनम्
4.154.m:
Having clinged to the tail of the ghee-cow when their bodies are submerged, those possessing great merit / cross over this boundless ocean of worldly existence, whose waters are Māyā, whose mass of great waves are sons and wives, and which is perilous with the fierce crocodiles of greed—ah!
Description of the Votive Observance of the Gift of a Salt-Cow

4.155.s:
.. .. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa mahābāho sarvaśāstraviśārada ..
kathayasveha dānānāmuttamaṃ yatprakīrtitam .. 1 ..
4.155.d:
॥ ॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
कृष्णकृष्ण महाबाहो सर्वशास्त्रविशारद ॥
कथयस्वेह दानानामुत्तमं यत्प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.155.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / O Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa, O mighty-armed one, skilled in all scriptures, / tell me here what is proclaimed as the best of gifts,

4.155.s:
yena dattena dānāni sarvāṇyeva bhavaṃtyuta ..
sarvakāmasamṛddhiśca sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet .. 2 ..
4.155.d:
येन दत्तेन दानानि सर्वाण्येव भवंत्युत ॥
सर्वकामसमृद्धिश्च सर्वपापक्षयो भवेत् ॥ 2 ॥
4.155.m: by the giving of which all gifts indeed become accomplished, / and there comes about the fulfillment of all desires and the destruction of all sins,

4.155.s:
prāyaścittaviśuddhiśca tanme kathaya suvrata ..
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi dānānāmuttamottamam .. 3 ..
4.155.d:
प्रायश्चित्तविशुद्धिश्च तन्मे कथय सुव्रत ॥
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
शृणु राजन्प्रवक्ष्यामि दानानामुत्तमोत्तमम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.155.m: and purification through expiation; tell me that, O you of noble vows! / Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Hear, O king, I shall declare the highest of gifts,

4.155.s:
khyātaṃ lavaṇadhenvākhyaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām ..
yāṃ dattvā brahmahā goghnaḥ pitṛhā gurutalpagaḥ .. .. 4 ..
4.155.d:
ख्यातं लवणधेन्वाख्यं सर्वकामप्रदं नृणाम् ॥
यां दत्त्वा ब्रह्महा गोघ्नः पितृहा गुरुतल्पगः ॥ ॥ 4 ॥
4.155.m: known as the salt-cow, which grants all desires to mortals. / Giving which, the slayer of a Brahmin, the slayer of a cow, the slayer of a father, one who violates his guru's bed,

4.155.s:
viśvāsaghātī krūrātmā sarvapāparato'pi vā..
mucyate nātra saṃdehaḥ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 5 ..
4.155.d:
विश्वासघाती क्रूरात्मा सर्वपापरतोऽपि वा॥
मुच्यते नात्र संदेहः शिवलोकं स गच्छति ॥ 5 ॥
4.155.m: a betrayer of trust, one of cruel nature, or even one devoted to all sins, / is freed—there is no doubt here—and goes to the world of Śiva.

4.155.s:
subhago dhanasaṃpanno dīrghāyuraparājitaḥ ..
jāyate puruṣo loke sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ .. 6 ..
4.155.d:
सुभगो धनसंपन्नो दीर्घायुरपराजितः ॥
जायते पुरुषो लोके सर्वकामसमन्वितः ॥ 6 ॥
4.155.m: He is born in the world fortunate, rich in wealth, long-lived, undefeated, / and endowed with all desired things.

4.155.s:
vidhiṃ vakṣyāmi rājendra lavaṇasyeha kalpanam ..
gomayenopaliptena darbhasaṃstarasaṃsthitam .. 7 ..
4.155.d:
विधिं वक्ष्यामि राजेन्द्र लवणस्येह कल्पनम् ॥
गोमयेनोपलिप्तेन दर्भसंस्तरसंस्थितम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.155.m: I shall state the procedure here, O king of kings, for the fashioning out of salt: / Upon [ground] smeared with cow-dung and spread with a layer of darbha grass,

4.155.s:
āvikaṃ carma vinyasya pūrvāśābhimukhaṃ sthitam ..
vastreṇācchāditaṃ kṛtvā dhenuṃ kurvīta buddhimān .. 8 ..
4.155.d:
आविकं चर्म विन्यस्य पूर्वाशाभिमुखं स्थितम् ॥
वस्त्रेणाच्छादितं कृत्वा धेनुं कुर्वीत बुद्धिमान् ॥ 8 ॥
4.155.m: having laid down a sheepskin facing the eastern quarter / and covered it with cloth, the wise man should fashion the cow.

4.155.s:
āḍhakenaiva kurvīta vahuvitto'lpavittavān ..
svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāmikṣupādāṃ phalastanīm .. 9 ..
4.155.d:
आढकेनैव कुर्वीत वहुवित्तोऽल्पवित्तवान् ॥
स्वर्णशृङ्गीं रौप्यखुरामिक्षुपादां फलस्तनीम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.155.m: One of great wealth or one of little wealth should fashion it with [four or fewer] āḍhakas; / with golden horns, silver hooves, sugarcane legs, and fruit udders,

4.155.s:
kāryā śarkarayā jihvā gandhaprāṇavatī tathā ..
samudrodaraje śuktī karṇau tasyāḥ prakalpayet.. 4.155.10 ..
4.155.d:
कार्या शर्करया जिह्वा गन्धप्राणवती तथा ॥
समुद्रोदरजे शुक्ती कर्णौ तस्याः प्रकल्पयेत्॥ 4.155.10 ॥
4.155.m: the tongue should be made of sugar, possessing a fragrant breath; / one should fashion its ears from two oyster shells produced in the belly of the sea;

4.155.s:
kaṃbalaṃ paṭṭasūtreṇa grīvāyāṃ ghaṇṭikāṃ tathā ..
śṛṃge candanakāṣṭhābhyāṃ mauktike cākṣiṇī ubhe .. 11 ..
4.155.d:
कंबलं पट्टसूत्रेण ग्रीवायां घण्टिकां तथा ॥
शृंगे चन्दनकाष्ठाभ्यां मौक्तिके चाक्षिणी उभे ॥ 11 ॥
4.155.m: the dewlap with silk thread, and a little bell on the neck; / the horns with two pieces of sandalwood, and both eyes with pearls;

4.155.s:
kapolau saktupiṇḍābhyāṃ yavānāsye pradāpayet ..
tilānpārśve prakurvīta godhūmāścaiva bhaktitaḥ ..12..
4.155.d:
कपोलौ सक्तुपिण्डाभ्यां यवानास्ये प्रदापयेत् ॥
तिलान्पार्श्वे प्रकुर्वीत गोधूमाश्चैव भक्तितः ॥12॥
4.155.m: the cheeks with two balls of roasted grain flour, and one should place barley in the mouth; / one should fashion the flanks with sesame seeds, and wheat also, with devotion.

4.155.s:
evaṃ vai saptadhānyāni yathālābhaṃ prakalpayet ..
pṛṣṭhe vai tāmrapātraṃ tu apāne guḍa piṃḍikām ..13..
4.155.d:
एवं वै सप्तधान्यानि यथालाभं प्रकल्पयेत् ॥
पृष्ठे वै ताम्रपात्रं तु अपाने गुड पिंडिकाम् ॥13॥
4.155.m: Thus indeed one should arrange the seven grains as they are obtained, / a copper vessel upon the back, and a lump of molasses at the anus.

4.155.s:
lāṃgūle kaṃbalaṃ dadyāddrākṣāṃ kṣīrapradeśataḥ ..
yonipradeśe ca madhu sarvavastuphalānvitam ..14..
4.155.d:
लांगूले कंबलं दद्याद्द्राक्षां क्षीरप्रदेशतः ॥
योनिप्रदेशे च मधु सर्ववस्तुफलान्वितम् ॥14॥
4.155.m: One should place a blanket on the tail, grapes at the region of the milk, / and honey at the vulva region, along with all kinds of substances and fruits.

4.155.s:
evaṃ samyakparisthāpya rasarasyamayīṃ ca gām ..
sthāpayedvatsamekaṃ ca caturbhāgena mānavaḥ .. 15 ..
4.155.d:
एवं सम्यक्परिस्थाप्य रसरस्यमयीं च गाम् ॥
स्थापयेद्वत्समेकं च चतुर्भागेन मानवः ॥ 15 ॥
4.155.m: Having thus completely set up the cow composed of the relish of saps, / a man should place a calf using one fourth [of the materials].

4.155.s:
evaṃ dhenuṃ samabhyarcya mālyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
snātvā devārcanaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇānabhipūjya ca ..
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇāṃ gāṃ tu putrabhāryāsamanvitaḥ .. 16 ..
4.155.d:
एवं धेनुं समभ्यर्च्य माल्यवस्त्रविभूषणैः ॥
स्नात्वा देवार्चनं कृत्वा ब्राह्मणानभिपूज्य च ॥
कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणां गां तु पुत्रभार्यासमन्वितः ॥ 16 ॥
4.155.m: Having worshipped the cow in this way with garlands, garments, and ornaments, / having bathed, performed the worship of the gods, and honoured the brāhmaṇas, / and having circumambulated the cow together with his son and wife,

4.155.s:
brāhmaṇāya suśīlāya vṛttayuktāya vai nṛpa ..
dadyātparvasu sarveṣu mantrapūrvaṃ subhaktitaḥ..17..
4.155.d:
ब्राह्मणाय सुशीलाय वृत्तयुक्ताय वै नृप ॥
दद्यात्पर्वसु सर्वेषु मन्त्रपूर्वं सुभक्तितः॥17॥
4.155.m: O king, one should give it to a well-behaved brāhmaṇa endowed with good conduct / on all festival days with devotion, preceded by the mantra:

4.155.s:
lavaṇe vai rasāḥ sarve lavaṇe sarvadevatāḥ ..
sarvadevamaye devi lavaṇākhye namo'stu te .. 18 ..
4.155.d:
लवणे वै रसाः सर्वे लवणे सर्वदेवताः ॥
सर्वदेवमये देवि लवणाख्ये नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 18 ॥
4.155.m: “All tastes indeed dwell in salt; all deities dwell in salt. / O goddess composed of all deities, named Salt, reverence be to you!”

4.155.s:
evamuccārya maṃtrāṃ te viprāya pratipādayet ..
samyakpradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇāsahitāṃ nṛpa .. 19 ..
4.155.d:
एवमुच्चार्य मंत्रां ते विप्राय प्रतिपादयेत् ॥
सम्यक्प्रदक्षिणां कृत्वा दक्षिणासहितां नृप ॥ 19 ॥
4.155.m: Having uttered these mantras, he should present it to the brāhmaṇa, / having duly circumambulated it together with a sacrificial fee, O king.

4.155.s:
pradakṣiṇā mahī tena kṛtā bhavati bhārata ..
sarvadānāni dattāni sarvakratuphalāni ca .. 4.155.20 ..
4.155.d:
प्रदक्षिणा मही तेन कृता भवति भारत ॥
सर्वदानानि दत्तानि सर्वक्रतुफलानि च ॥ 4.155.20 ॥
4.155.m: By him, O descendant of Bharata, the earth has been circumambulated; / all gifts have been given, and the fruits of all sacrifices attained.

4.155.s:
sarve rasāḥ sarvamannaṃ sarvaṃ ca sacarācaram ..
saubhāgyaṃ paramā buddhirārogyaṃ sarvasaṃpadaḥ .. 21 ..
4.155.d:
सर्वे रसाः सर्वमन्नं सर्वं च सचराचरम् ॥
सौभाग्यं परमा बुद्धिरारोग्यं सर्वसंपदः ॥ 21 ॥
4.155.m: All essences, all food, and all that moves and is still, / good fortune, supreme intellect, health, and all prosperities

4.155.s:
bhavati dattvā nṛṇāṃ tu rasadhenuṃ na saṃśayaḥ ..
svarge ca niyatā vāso yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 22 ..
4.155.d:
भवति दत्त्वा नृणां तु रसधेनुं न संशयः ॥
स्वर्गे च नियता वासो यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.155.m: are gained by men who give a sap-cow, without doubt; / and their dwelling in heaven is certain until the universal deluge.

4.155.s:
parṇaurṇakaṃbalagalāṃ lavaṇāḍhakena kṛtvā phalastanavatīmapi lāvaṇākhyām ..
dattvā dvijāya vidhivadrasadhenumenāṃ lokaṃ gavāṃ sakalasaukhyayuto viśetsaḥ .. 23 ..
suvarṇadhenudānavratavarṇanam
4.155.d:
पर्णौर्णकंबलगलां लवणाढकेन कृत्वा फलस्तनवतीमपि लावणाख्याम् ॥
दत्त्वा द्विजाय विधिवद्रसधेनुमेनां लोकं गवां सकलसौख्ययुतो विशेत्सः ॥ 23 ॥
सुवर्णधेनुदानव्रतवर्णनम्
4.155.m:
Having made [her] with betel leaves for a dewlap, a woolen blanket, an āḍhaka of salt, and fruit-udders, named Salt, / and having given this sap-cow according to rule to a twice-born, he would enter the world of cows, endowed with all happiness.
Description of the vow of the gift of the golden cow.

4.156.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi rājankāñcanadhenukām ..
yāṃ dattvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 1 ..
4.156.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि राजन्काञ्चनधेनुकाम् ॥
यां दत्त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ॥ 1 ॥
4.156.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Hereafter I shall speak, O king, of the golden cow, / having given which one is released from all sins; of this there is no doubt.

4.156.s:
surāpo brahmahā goghno bhīrurbhagnavrato'pi vā ..
gurughātī svasṛgāmī paradārarataśca yaḥ .. 2 ..
4.156.d:
सुरापो ब्रह्महा गोघ्नो भीरुर्भग्नव्रतोऽपि वा ॥
गुरुघाती स्वसृगामी परदाररतश्च यः ॥ 2 ॥
4.156.m: A drinker of liquor, a killer of a brāhmaṇa, a cow-killer, a coward, or one who has broken vows, / a slayer of a guru, one who has incest with his sister, and one who delights in another's wife—

4.156.s:
mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvairdattvā kāñcanadhenukām ..
saṃśuddhasya suvarṇasya paṃcāśatpalikāṃ śubhām .. 3 ..
4.156.d:
मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैर्दत्त्वा काञ्चनधेनुकाम् ॥
संशुद्धस्य सुवर्णस्य पंचाशत्पलिकां शुभाम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.156.m: is freed from all sins by giving the golden cow, / an auspicious one made of fifty palas of purified gold.

4.156.s:
arddhena vā prakurvīta śaktyā vā nṛpasattama ..
ukhāṃ paścimabhāge tu dṛṣṭakukṣipayodharām .. 4 ..
4.156.d:
अर्द्धेन वा प्रकुर्वीत शक्त्या वा नृपसत्तम ॥
उखां पश्चिमभागे तु दृष्टकुक्षिपयोधराम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.156.m: Or, O best of kings, one may make it with half that, or according to one's capacity, / with a vessel in the western part, having belly and udders made visible,

4.156.s:
vibhaktāṅgīṃ sujaghanāṃ sumanoharakarṇikām ..
sarvaratnavicitrāṅgīṃ kārayetkapilāṃ śubhām .. 5 ..
4.156.d:
विभक्ताङ्गीं सुजघनां सुमनोहरकर्णिकाम् ॥
सर्वरत्नविचित्राङ्गीं कारयेत्कपिलां शुभाम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.156.m: with well-proportioned limbs, beautiful hips, and charming ears; / one should cause an auspicious brown cow to be fashioned, variegated in all its limbs with all kinds of gems.

4.156.s:
caturthena tu bhāgena vatsaṃ tasyāḥ prakalpayet ..
raupyaghaṭāṃ ca dattvā tu kauśeyaparivāritām .. 6 ..
4.156.d:
चतुर्थेन तु भागेन वत्सं तस्याः प्रकल्पयेत् ॥
रौप्यघटां च दत्त्वा तु कौशेयपरिवारिताम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.156.m: One should fashion her calf with a fourth of the [weight of the] portion, / and having provided a silver milk-pail, surrounded by silk,

4.156.s:
tāmraśṛṃgīṃ tathā kuryādvaiḍūryamayakaṃbalām ..
muktāphalamaye netre vaidrumī rasanā tathā .. 7 ..
4.156.d:
ताम्रशृंगीं तथा कुर्याद्वैडूर्यमयकंबलाम् ॥
मुक्ताफलमये नेत्रे वैद्रुमी रसना तथा ॥ 7 ॥
4.156.m: one should likewise make her with copper horns and a cat's-eye blanket; / the two eyes made of pearls, and the tongue made of coral.

4.156.s:
kṛṣṇājine guḍaprasthaṃ tatrasthāṃ kārayecchubhām..
kuṃbhāṣṭakasamopetāṃ nānā phalasamanvitām .. 8 ..
4.156.d:
कृष्णाजिने गुडप्रस्थं तत्रस्थां कारयेच्छुभाम्॥
कुंभाष्टकसमोपेतां नाना फलसमन्विताम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.156.m: He should cause that auspicious cow to be placed upon a black antelope skin with a prastha of raw sugar, / accompanied by eight jars and endowed with various fruits,

4.156.s:
tathāṣṭādaśa dhānyātapatropānadyugānvitām ..
bhājanaṃ vasanaṃ caiva tāmradohanakaṃ tathā .. 9 ..
4.156.d:
तथाष्टादश धान्यातपत्रोपानद्युगान्विताम् ॥
भाजनं वसनं चैव ताम्रदोहनकं तथा ॥ 9 ॥
4.156.m: equipped with the eighteen grains, an umbrella, and a pair of sandals, / a vessel, clothing, and a copper milking vessel,

4.156.s:
dīpakānnādilavaṇaśarkarādhānyakānvitām ..
pradadyādbrāhmaṇaṃ pūjya vastrairābharaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 4.156.10 ..
4.156.d:
दीपकान्नादिलवणशर्कराधान्यकान्विताम् ॥
प्रदद्याद्ब्राह्मणं पूज्य वस्त्रैराभरणैः शुभैः ॥ 4.156.10 ॥
4.156.m: provided with lamps, cooked food, salt, sugar, and coriander; / having worshipped the brāhmaṇa with auspicious garments and ornaments, he should give it.

4.156.s:
snātaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya dhenuṃ sarvāṅgasaṃyutām ..
guḍadhenūktamaṃtraiśca āvāhya pratipūjya ca .. 11 ..
4.156.d:
स्नातः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य धेनुं सर्वाङ्गसंयुताम् ॥
गुडधेनूक्तमंत्रैश्च आवाह्य प्रतिपूज्य च ॥ 11 ॥
4.156.m: Having bathed, having circumambulated the cow equipped with all limbs, / and having invoked and worshipped it with the mantras spoken for the sugar-cow,

4.156.s:
tvaṃ sarvadevagaṇamandirabhūṣaṇāsi viśveśvaratripathagodadhiparvatānām ..
śraddhāmbutīkṣṇaśakalīkṛtapātakaughaḥ prāpnoti nirvṛtimatīva parāṃ namāmi ..12..
4.156.d:
त्वं सर्वदेवगणमन्दिरभूषणासि विश्वेश्वरत्रिपथगोदधिपर्वतानाम् ॥
श्रद्धाम्बुतीक्ष्णशकलीकृतपातकौघः प्राप्नोति निर्वृतिमतीव परां नमामि ॥12॥
4.156.m: “You are the ornament of the abode of all hosts of gods, of Viśveśvara, the Ganges, the ocean, and the mountains; / he whose heap of sins is sharply shattered by the water of faith attains the highest bliss; I bow to you!

4.156.s:
loke yathepsitaphalārthavidhāyinī tvāmāsādya ko hi bhayabhāgbhavatīha martyaḥ .. (pāṭhā. bhayabhāgyavatīha)
saṃsāraduḥkhaśamanāya yatastvakāmāstvāṃ kāmadhenumiti vedavido vadaṃti .. 13 ..
4.156.d:
लोके यथेप्सितफलार्थविधायिनी त्वामासाद्य को हि भयभाग्भवतीह मर्त्यः ॥ (पाठा। भयभाग्यवतीह)
संसारदुःखशमनाय यतस्त्वकामास्त्वां कामधेनुमिति वेदविदो वदंति ॥ 13 ॥
4.156.m: Bestowing the desired fruit and wealth in the world, having approached you, what mortal here has fear? / Because you fulfill desires for the calming of worldly sorrow, those who know the Vedas call you the wish-fulfilling cow.”

4.156.s:
evamāmantrya tāṃ dhenuṃ viprāya pratipādayet ..
sadakṣiṇopaskarāṃ ca praṇipatya kṣamāpayet .. 14 ..
4.156.d:
एवमामन्त्र्य तां धेनुं विप्राय प्रतिपादयेत् ॥
सदक्षिणोपस्करां च प्रणिपत्य क्षमापयेत् ॥ 14 ॥
4.156.m: Having addressed that cow thus, he should hand it over to the brāhmaṇa / along with the sacrificial fee and accessories, and, having prostrated, ask for pardon.

4.156.s:
dānakāle tu ye devāstīrthāni manavastathā ..
śarīre nivasaṃtyasyāstāñchṛṇuṣva narādhipa .. 15 ..
4.156.d:
दानकाले तु ये देवास्तीर्थानि मनवस्तथा ॥
शरीरे निवसंत्यस्यास्ताञ्छृणुष्व नराधिप ॥ 15 ॥
4.156.m: Hear, O king, which gods, sacred fords, and Manus / reside in her body at the time of giving:

4.156.s:
netrayoḥ sūryaśaśinau jihvāyāṃ tu sarasvatī ..
daṃteṣu maruto devāḥ karṇayośca tathāśvinau .. 16 ..
4.156.d:
नेत्रयोः सूर्यशशिनौ जिह्वायां तु सरस्वती ॥
दंतेषु मरुतो देवाः कर्णयोश्च तथाश्विनौ ॥ 16 ॥
4.156.m: The sun and moon are in her eyes, and Sarasvatī is upon her tongue; / the Maruts are in her teeth, and the two Aśvins in her ears.

4.156.s:
śṛṃgāgragau sadā cāsyā devau rudrapitāmahau ..
gaṃdharvāpsarasaścaiva kakuddeśaṃ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ..
kukṣau samudrāścatvāro yonau tripathagāminī .. 17 ..
4.156.d:
शृंगाग्रगौ सदा चास्या देवौ रुद्रपितामहौ ॥
गंधर्वाप्सरसश्चैव ककुद्देशं प्रतिष्ठिताः ॥
कुक्षौ समुद्राश्चत्वारो योनौ त्रिपथगामिनी ॥ 17 ॥
4.156.m: Rudra and the Grandfather [Brahmā] are always on the tips of her horns; / Gandharvas and Apsarases reside in the region of the hump; / the four oceans are in her belly, and the triple-coursed river [Gaṅgā] is in her vulva.

4.156.s:
ṛṣayo romakūpeṣu apāne vasudhā sthitā ..
antreṣu nāgā vijñeyāḥ parvatāścāsthiṣu sthitāḥ .. .. 18 ..
4.156.d:
ऋषयो रोमकूपेषु अपाने वसुधा स्थिता ॥
अन्त्रेषु नागा विज्ञेयाः पर्वताश्चास्थिषु स्थिताः ॥ ॥ 18 ॥
4.156.m: The sages reside in the hair follicles, and the earth in her anus; / the Nāgas are to be known in her entrails, and mountains in her bones.

4.156.s:
dharmakāmārthamokṣāstu pādeṣu parisaṃsthitāḥ ..
huṃkāre ca caturvedāḥ kaṃṭhe rudrāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ .. 19 ..
4.156.d:
धर्मकामार्थमोक्षास्तु पादेषु परिसंस्थिताः ॥
हुंकारे च चतुर्वेदाः कंठे रुद्राः प्रतिष्ठिताः ॥ 19 ॥
4.156.m: Righteousness, pleasure, wealth, and liberation are established in her feet; / the four Vedas are in her bellow, and the Rudras are established in her neck.

4.156.s:
pṛṣṭhabhāge sthito merurviṣṇuḥ sarvaśarīragaḥ ..
evaṃ sarvamayī devī pāvanī viśvarūpiṇī .. 4.156.20 ..
4.156.d:
पृष्ठभागे स्थितो मेरुर्विष्णुः सर्वशरीरगः ॥
एवं सर्वमयी देवी पावनी विश्वरूपिणी ॥ 4.156.20 ॥
4.156.m: Meru is situated on the dorsal part, and Viṣṇu permeates her entire body; / thus she is the all-embodying, purifying goddess whose form is the universe.

4.156.s:
kāñcanena kṛtā dhenuḥ sarvadevamayī smṛtā ..
yo dadyāttādṛśīṃ dhenuṃ sarvadānaprado hi saḥ .. 21 ..
4.156.d:
काञ्चनेन कृता धेनुः सर्वदेवमयी स्मृता ॥
यो दद्यात्तादृशीं धेनुं सर्वदानप्रदो हि सः ॥ 21 ॥
4.156.m: The cow made of gold is declared to be composed of all gods; / he who gives such a cow is indeed a giver of all gifts.

4.156.s:
karmabhūmau hi martyānāṃ dānametatsudurlabham ..
tasmāddeyamidaṃ śaktyā sarvakalmaṣanāśanam ..22..
4.156.d:
कर्मभूमौ हि मर्त्यानां दानमेतत्सुदुर्लभम् ॥
तस्माद्देयमिदं शक्त्या सर्वकल्मषनाशनम् ॥22॥
4.156.m: For mortals on the earth of action, this gift is exceedingly difficult to obtain; / therefore, this should be given according to one's capacity, destroying all sins,

4.156.s:
pāvanaṃ tāraṇaṃ caiva kīrtidaṃ śāṃtidaṃ tathā ..
varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ svargaloke gato naraḥ .. 23 ..
4.156.d:
पावनं तारणं चैव कीर्तिदं शांतिदं तथा ॥
वर्षकोटिशतं साग्रं स्वर्गलोके गतो नरः ॥ 23 ॥
4.156.m: purifying, carrying across [the ocean of existence], granting fame, and giving peace. / Having gone to the heavenly world for more than a hundred crore years,

4.156.s:
nārī vā pūjyate devairvimānavaramāsthitā ..
gaṃdharvaigīyamānastu puṣpairmālāvibhūṣitaiḥ .. 24 ..
4.156.d:
नारी वा पूज्यते देवैर्विमानवरमास्थिता ॥
गंधर्वैगीयमानस्तु पुष्पैर्मालाविभूषितैः ॥ 24 ॥
4.156.m: a man or a woman, seated upon an excellent celestial chariot, is honoured by the gods, / sung to by Gandharvas, adorned with wreaths of flowers,

4.156.s:
sarvābharaṇasaṃpannaḥ sarvadvaṃdvavivarjitaḥ ..
svarge sthitvā ciraṃ kālaṃ tato martye'bhijāyate .. 25 ..
4.156.d:
सर्वाभरणसंपन्नः सर्वद्वंद्वविवर्जितः ॥
स्वर्गे स्थित्वा चिरं कालं ततो मर्त्येऽभिजायते ॥ 25 ॥
4.156.m: endowed with all ornaments, freed from all dualities; / having dwelt in heaven for a long time, he is then born among mortals

4.156.s:
ādhi vyādhi vinirmukto rūpavānpriyadarśanaḥ ..
evaṃ naro vā nārī vā dattvā dānamidaṃ bhuvi ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti jāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ .. 26 ..
4.156.d:
आधि व्याधि विनिर्मुक्तो रूपवान्प्रियदर्शनः ॥
एवं नरो वा नारी वा दत्त्वा दानमिदं भुवि ॥
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति जायमानः पुनः पुनः ॥ 26 ॥
4.156.m: freed from mental agony and physical disease, handsome, and pleasant to behold. / Thus a man or a woman, having given this gift on earth, / attains all desires, being born again and again.

4.156.s:
āmantrya sādhukulaśīlaguṇānvitāya viprāya yaḥ kanakadhenumimāṃ pradadyāt ..
prāpnoti siddhamunikinnaradevajuṣṭaṃ kanyāśataiḥ parivṛtaṃ padamindumauleḥ..27..
ratnadhenudānavratavidhivarṇanam
4.156.d:
आमन्त्र्य साधुकुलशीलगुणान्विताय विप्राय यः कनकधेनुमिमां प्रदद्यात् ॥
प्राप्नोति सिद्धमुनिकिन्नरदेवजुष्टं कन्याशतैः परिवृतं पदमिन्दुमौलेः॥27॥
रत्नधेनुदानव्रतविधिवर्णनम्
4.156.m:
He who, having addressed [her], presents this golden cow to a brāhmaṇa endowed with a noble lineage, good character, and virtues, / attains the abode of the moon-crested god [Śiva], attended by Siddhas, sages, Kinnaras, and gods, and surrounded by hundreds of celestial maidens.
Description of the rule of the vow of the gift of the gem-cow.

4.157.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dānamanyatsudurllabham ..
ratnadhenviti vikhyātaṃ golokaphaladaṃ nṛṇām .. 1 ..
4.157.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि दानमन्यत्सुदुर्ल्लभम् ॥
रत्नधेन्विति विख्यातं गोलोकफलदं नृणाम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.157.m:
The venerable Kṛṣṇa said:
Now, therefore, I shall fully declare another gift that is exceedingly hard to obtain,
known as the jewel-cow, which grants men the fruit of Goloka.

4.157.s:
puṇyaṃ dinamathāsādya gomayenopalepanam ..
kṛtvā bhūmau mahārāja tatra dhenuṃ prakalpayet .. 2 ..
4.157.d:
पुण्यं दिनमथासाद्य गोमयेनोपलेपनम् ॥
कृत्वा भूमौ महाराज तत्र धेनुं प्रकल्पयेत् ॥ 2 ॥
4.157.m:
Having found an auspicious day, and having smeared
the ground with cow-dung, O great king, one should construct the cow there.

4.157.s:
dhenuṃ ratnamayīṃ kuryāttattatsaṃkalpapūrvikām ..
sthāpayetpadmarāgāṇāmekāśītiṃ mukhe budhaḥ .. 3 ..
4.157.d:
धेनुं रत्नमयीं कुर्यात्तत्तत्संकल्पपूर्विकाम् ॥
स्थापयेत्पद्मरागाणामेकाशीतिं मुखे बुधः ॥ 3 ॥
4.157.m:
One should make a cow consisting of jewels, preceded by the respective solemn resolves.
A wise man should place eighty-one rubies upon her mouth,

4.157.s:
puṣparāgaśataṃ dhenoḥ pādayoḥ parikalpayet ..
lalāṭe hematilakaṃ muktāphalaśataṃ dṛśoḥ .. 4 ..
4.157.d:
पुष्परागशतं धेनोः पादयोः परिकल्पयेत् ॥
ललाटे हेमतिलकं मुक्ताफलशतं दृशोः ॥ 4 ॥
4.157.m:
One should arrange one hundred topazes upon the feet of the cow,
a gold tilaka on her forehead, and a hundred pearls for her eyes.

4.157.s:
bhrūyuge vidrumaśataṃ śuktī karṇadvaye smṛte ..
kāñcanāni ca śṛṅgāṇi śirovajraśatātmakam .. 5 ..
4.157.d:
भ्रूयुगे विद्रुमशतं शुक्ती कर्णद्वये स्मृते ॥
काञ्चनानि च शृङ्गाणि शिरोवज्रशतात्मकम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.157.m:
One hundred corals on her pair of brows, two pearl-oysters are prescribed for her two ears,
her horns of gold, and her head consisting of a hundred diamonds.

4.157.s:
grīvāyāṃ netrapuṭake gomedakaśataṃ tathā ..
indranīlaśataṃ pṛṣṭhe vaidūryaśata pārśvake .. 6 ..
4.157.d:
ग्रीवायां नेत्रपुटके गोमेदकशतं तथा ॥
इन्द्रनीलशतं पृष्ठे वैदूर्यशत पार्श्वके ॥ 6 ॥
4.157.m:
A hundred hessonites on her neck and in the eye-sockets likewise,
a hundred sapphires on her back, and a hundred chrysoberyls on her flank.

4.157.s:
sphāṭikairudaraṃ kāryaṃ saugandhikaśataṃ kaṭau ..
khurā hemamayā kāryāḥ pucchaṃ muktāvalīmayam .. 7 ..
4.157.d:
स्फाटिकैरुदरं कार्यं सौगन्धिकशतं कटौ ॥
खुरा हेममया कार्याः पुच्छं मुक्तावलीमयम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.157.m:
Her belly should be made of crystals, and a hundred carnelians upon her hips.
Her hooves should be made of gold, and her tail consisting of a string of pearls.

4.157.s:
sūryakāntendukāntau ca ghrāṇe karpūracandanaiḥ ..
kuṃkumena ca romāṇi raupyaṃ nābhiṃ ca kārayet .. 8 ..
4.157.d:
सूर्यकान्तेन्दुकान्तौ च घ्राणे कर्पूरचन्दनैः ॥
कुंकुमेन च रोमाणि रौप्यं नाभिं च कारयेत् ॥ 8 ॥
4.157.m:
A sunstone and a moonstone on her nose; with camphor, sandalwood,
and saffron her hair; and one should make her navel of silver.

4.157.s:
gārutmataśataṃ tadvadapāne parikalpayet ..
tathānyāni ca ratnāni sthāpayetsarvasaṃdhiṣu .. 9 ..
4.157.d:
गारुत्मतशतं तद्वदपाने परिकल्पयेत् ॥
तथान्यानि च रत्नानि स्थापयेत्सर्वसंधिषु ॥ 9 ॥
4.157.m:
Likewise, one should arrange a hundred emeralds at her anus;
and similarly, one should place other jewels at all her joints.

4.157.s:
kuryāccharkarayā jihvāṃ gomayaṃ ca guḍātmakam ..
gomūtramājyena tathā dadhidugdhasvarūpataḥ .. 4.157.10 ..
4.157.d:
कुर्याच्छर्करया जिह्वां गोमयं च गुडात्मकम् ॥
गोमूत्रमाज्येन तथा दधिदुग्धस्वरूपतः ॥ 4.157.10 ॥
4.157.m:
One should make her tongue of sugar, her dung of jaggery,
her urine of ghee, and likewise with the nature of curd and milk.

4.157.s:
pucchāgre cāmaraṃ dadyātstanayostāmradohanam ..
kārayedevamevaṃ tu caturthāṃśena vatsakam .. 11 ..
4.157.d:
पुच्छाग्रे चामरं दद्यात्स्तनयोस्ताम्रदोहनम् ॥
कारयेदेवमेवं तु चतुर्थांशेन वत्सकम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.157.m:
One should place a chowrie at the tip of her tail, and a copper milking-vessel at her udders;
and in this very manner one should have a calf made with a fourth part [of the jewels].

4.157.s:
nānāphalāni pārśveṣu kṛtvā pūjāṃ prayatnataḥ ..
guḍadhenuvadāvāhya idaṃ codāharettataḥ .. 12 ..
4.157.d:
नानाफलानि पार्श्वेषु कृत्वा पूजां प्रयत्नतः ॥
गुडधेनुवदावाह्य इदं चोदाहरेत्ततः ॥ 12 ॥
4.157.m:
Having placed various fruits at the flanks and worshipped her with diligence,
and having invoked her as in the rite of the jaggery-cow, one should then recite this:

4.157.s:
tvāṃ sarvadevagaṇavāsamiti stuvaṃti rudrendracandrakamalāsanavāsudevāḥ ..
tasmātsamastabhuvanatrayadehayuktā māṃ pāhi devi bhavasāgara magnamāsu .. 13 ..
4.157.d:
त्वां सर्वदेवगणवासमिति स्तुवंति रुद्रेन्द्रचन्द्रकमलासनवासुदेवाः ॥
तस्मात्समस्तभुवनत्रयदेहयुक्ता मां पाहि देवि भवसागर मग्नमासु ॥ 13 ॥
4.157.m:
“Rudra, Indra, the Moon, the Lotus-Seated One [Brahmā], and Vāsudeva praise you as the dwelling place of the hosts of all the gods.
Therefore, endowed with a body [comprising] all the three worlds, protect me quickly, O goddess, submerged in the ocean of worldly existence!”

4.157.s:
evamāmantrya tāṃ dhenuṃ viprāya pratipādayet ..
saṃpūjya vastrābharaṇairvidhijñaṃ vedapāragam .. 14 ..
4.157.d:
एवमामन्त्र्य तां धेनुं विप्राय प्रतिपादयेत् ॥
संपूज्य वस्त्राभरणैर्विधिज्ञं वेदपारगम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.157.m:
Having thus addressed that cow, one should present her to a Brahmin,
having worshipped him with garments and ornaments, one who knows the ritual and has mastered the Vedas.

4.157.s:
tataśca dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā praṇipatya kṣamāpayet ..
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 15 ..
4.157.d:
ततश्च दक्षिणां दत्त्वा प्रणिपत्य क्षमापयेत् ॥
एवं यः कुरुते पार्थ तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु ॥ 15 ॥
4.157.m:
And then, having given the priestly fee, bowed down, and asked for forgiveness—
hear the meritorious fruit of him who performs this thus, O son of Pṛthā:

4.157.s:
kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ śivaloke sukhaṃ vaset ..
tataḥ kāle bahutithe rājarājo bhavediha .. 16 ..
4.157.d:
कल्पकोटिशतं साग्रं शिवलोके सुखं वसेत् ॥
ततः काले बहुतिथे राजराजो भवेदिह ॥ 16 ॥
4.157.m:
He shall dwell happily in the world of Śiva for a full hundred crores of kalpas.
Then, after a long time, he would become a king of kings in this world,
flourishing with all desires and bringing destruction to the faction of his enemies.

4.157.s:
iti sakalavidhijño ratnadhenupradānaṃ vitarati sa vimānaṃ prāpya dedīpyamānam ..
sakala kaluṣamukto baṃdhubhiḥ putrapautraiḥ sa hi madanasarūpaḥ sthānamabhyeti śaṃbhoḥ .. 18 ..
ubhayamukhīgodānavratavarṇanam
4.157.d:
इति सकलविधिज्ञो रत्नधेनुप्रदानं वितरति स विमानं प्राप्य देदीप्यमानम् ॥
सकल कलुषमुक्तो बंधुभिः पुत्रपौत्रैः स हि मदनसरूपः स्थानमभ्येति शंभोः ॥ 18 ॥
उभयमुखीगोदानव्रतवर्णनम्

4.158.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
prasūyamānā dātavyā dhenurbrāhmaṇapuṅgave ..
vidhinā kena dharmajñaṃ dāne tasyāśca kiṃ phalam .. 1 ..
4.158.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
प्रसूयमाना दातव्या धेनुर्ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवे ॥
विधिना केन धर्मज्ञं दाने तस्याश्च किं फलम् ॥ 1 ॥

4.158.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
prasūyamānātipuṇyaiḥ prāpyate gaurnṛpottama ..
prāpnuvaṃti narāḥ kecitpuṇyasaṃbhāravistarāḥ ..2 ..
4.158.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
प्रसूयमानातिपुण्यैः प्राप्यते गौर्नृपोत्तम ॥
प्राप्नुवंति नराः केचित्पुण्यसंभारविस्तराः ॥2 ॥

4.158.s:
yāvatpādau yonigatau śiraścaiva pradṛśyate ..
tāvadgauḥ pṛthivī jñeyā yāvadgarbhaṃ na muṃcati .. 3 ..
4.158.d:
यावत्पादौ योनिगतौ शिरश्चैव प्रदृश्यते ॥
तावद्गौः पृथिवी ज्ञेया यावद्गर्भं न मुंचति ॥ 3 ॥
4.158.m:
As long as the two feet are in the vulva and the head also is seen,
so long is the cow to be known as the earth, until she discharges the fetus.

4.158.s:
gauryāvaddvimukhī caiva yadā bhavati bhārata ..
tadāsau pṛthivī jñeyā saśailavanakānanā .. 4 ..
4.158.d:
गौर्यावद्द्विमुखी चैव यदा भवति भारत ॥
तदासौ पृथिवी ज्ञेया सशैलवनकानना ॥ 4 ॥
4.158.m:
As long as the cow has two faces, when [this] occurs, O descendant of Bharata,
then she is to be known as the earth together with its mountains, woods, and forests.

4.158.s:
dattvobhayamukhīṃ rājanyatpuṇyaṃ prāpyate nṛbhiḥ ..
na tadvarṇayituṃ yāti mukhenaikena kenacit .. 5 ..
4.158.d:
दत्त्वोभयमुखीं राजन्यत्पुण्यं प्राप्यते नृभिः ॥
न तद्वर्णयितुं याति मुखेनैकेन केनचित् ॥ 5 ॥
4.158.m:
The merit that is attained by men upon giving a two-faced cow, O king—
that cannot be described with a single mouth by anyone.

4.158.s:
kimiṣṭairbahubhiryajñairdānairdattaiśca sattama ..
prasūyamānāṃ gāmekāṃ dehi kiṃ bahunā tava .. 6 ..
4.158.d:
किमिष्टैर्बहुभिर्यज्ञैर्दानैर्दत्तैश्च सत्तम ॥
प्रसूयमानां गामेकां देहि किं बहुना तव ॥ 6 ॥
4.158.m:
What need is there of many sacrifices offered, or gifts bestowed, O best of beings?
Give a single cow in the process of giving birth! What need have you of much?

4.158.s:
ekaiva pāti narakātsukhamekaiva kārayet..
ekāpi dvimukhī dattā gaurgaurbhavati bhārata .. 7 ..
4.158.d:
एकैव पाति नरकात्सुखमेकैव कारयेत्॥
एकापि द्विमुखी दत्ता गौर्गौर्भवति भारत ॥ 7 ॥
4.158.m:
One alone protects from hell; one alone creates happiness;
even a single two-faced cow, when given, becomes the earth, O descendant of Bharata.

4.158.s:
svarṇaśṛṃgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ muktālāṅgūlabhūṣitām ..
kāṃsyopadohanāṃ rājannalaṃkṛtya dvijottame ..
prasūyamānāṃ gāṃ dattvā mahatpuṇyaphalaṃ labhet .. 8 ..
4.158.d:
स्वर्णशृंगीं रौप्यखुरां मुक्तालाङ्गूलभूषिताम् ॥
कांस्योपदोहनां राजन्नलंकृत्य द्विजोत्तमे ॥
प्रसूयमानां गां दत्त्वा महत्पुण्यफलं लभेत् ॥ 8 ॥
4.158.m:
With horns of gold, hooves of silver, adorned with a pearl tail,
with a bronze milking vessel, O king, having adorned her, upon [presenting her to] a best of Brahmins,
having given a cow in the process of giving birth, one obtains great meritorious fruit.

4.158.s:
yāvaṃti dhenuromāṇi vatsasyāpi narādhipa ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate .. 9 ..
4.158.d:
यावंति धेनुरोमाणि वत्सस्यापि नराधिप ॥
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥ 9 ॥
4.158.m:
As many hairs as there are on the cow, and on the calf as well, O lord of men,
for that many thousands of years he is glorified in the heavenly world.

He delivers his fathers, his grandfathers, and likewise his great-grandfathers
from hell without doubt, he who gives an abundant priestly fee.

4.158.s:
ghṛtakṣīravahā nadyo dadhipāyasakardamāḥ ..
tatra te yāṃti yatrāsti drumaścepsitakāmadaḥ .. 11 ..
4.158.d:
घृतक्षीरवहा नद्यो दधिपायसकर्दमाः ॥
तत्र ते यांति यत्रास्ति द्रुमश्चेप्सितकामदः ॥ 11 ॥
4.158.m:
Rivers flowing with ghee and milk, having mud of curd and milk-rice—
there they go, where there is the tree that grants desired wishes.

4.158.s:
yo dadāti suvarṇena bahunā saha bhāvinīm ..
golokaḥ sulabhastasya brahmalokaśca pārthiva .. 12 ..
4.158.d:
यो ददाति सुवर्णेन बहुना सह भाविनीम् ॥
गोलोकः सुलभस्तस्य ब्रह्मलोकश्च पार्थिव ॥ 12 ॥
4.158.m:
He who gives the noble cow together with abundant gold—
Goloka is easily accessible to him, and Brahmaloka, O king.

4.158.s:
na deyā durbalā rājandhenurnaivālpadakṣiṇā ..
kāmyo'yaṃ vidhiruddiṣṭaḥ phalado vidhinā kṛtaḥ .. 13 ..
4.158.d:
न देया दुर्बला राजन्धेनुर्नैवाल्पदक्षिणा ॥
काम्योऽयं विधिरुद्दिष्टः फलदो विधिना कृतः ॥ 13 ॥
4.158.m:
A weak cow must not be given, O king, nor indeed one with a small priestly fee;
this optional rite has been declared, granting fruit when performed according to rule.

4.158.s:
striyaśca ta caṃdrasamānavaktrāḥ prataptajāṃbūnadatulyavarṇāḥ ..
mahānitaṃbāstanuvṛttamadhyāḥ sevaṃtyajasraṃ nalinābhanetrāḥ .. 14 ...
gosahasrapradānavidhivarṇanam
4.158.d:
स्त्रियश्च त चंद्रसमानवक्त्राः प्रतप्तजांबूनदतुल्यवर्णाः ॥
महानितंबास्तनुवृत्तमध्याः सेवंत्यजस्रं नलिनाभनेत्राः ॥ 14 ॥।
गोसहस्रप्रदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.158.m:
And women whose faces resemble the moon, whose complexion equals refined gold,
with large hips, slender and rounded waists, and eyes resembling lotuses, serve him perpetually.
Description of the Rite of Bestowing a Thousand Cows

4.159.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
gosahasravidhānaṃ ca kathayasva janārdana ..
kasminkāle pradātavyaṃ kathaṃ deyaṃ ca tadbhavet .. 1 ..
4.159.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
गोसहस्रविधानं च कथयस्व जनार्दन ॥
कस्मिन्काले प्रदातव्यं कथं देयं च तद्भवेत् ॥ 1 ॥

4.159.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
gāvaḥ pavitrā lokānāṃ gāva eva parāyaṇam ..
brahmaṇā sṛjatā lokānvṛttihetoḥ prajeśvara ..
gāvaḥ prathamataḥ sṛṣṭāstrailokya hitakāmyayā .. 2 ..
4.159.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
गावः पवित्रा लोकानां गाव एव परायणम् ॥
ब्रह्मणा सृजता लोकान्वृत्तिहेतोः प्रजेश्वर ॥
गावः प्रथमतः सृष्टास्त्रैलोक्य हितकाम्यया ॥ 2 ॥
4.159.m:
The venerable Kṛṣṇa said:
Cows are the purifiers of the worlds; cows alone are the supreme refuge.
By Brahmā, when creating the worlds for the purpose of livelihood, O lord of creatures,
cows were created first of all, out of a desire for the welfare of the three worlds.

4.159.s:
yāsāṃ mūtrapurīṣeṇa devatāyatanānyapi ..
śucīni samajāyaṃta kiṃbhūtamadhikaṃ tataḥ .. 3 ..
4.159.d:
यासां मूत्रपुरीषेण देवतायतनान्यपि ॥
शुचीनि समजायंत किंभूतमधिकं ततः ॥ 3 ॥
4.159.m:
Through whose urine and dung even the temples of the deities
became pure—what being could be greater than that?

4.159.s:
mūlaṃ yajñasya kāmyasya sarvadevamayāḥ śubhāḥ ..
gomaye vasate lakṣmīḥ paryāptaṃ tannidarśanam .. 4 ..
4.159.d:
मूलं यज्ञस्य काम्यस्य सर्वदेवमयाः शुभाः ॥
गोमये वसते लक्ष्मीः पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.159.m:
The auspicious [cows] are the root of the sacrificial rite undertaken for desires, embodying all the gods;
Lakṣmī resides in cow-dung—that is an adequate illustration.

4.159.s:
brāhmaṇāścaiva gāvaśca kulamekaṃ dvidhā kṛtam ..
ekatra maṃtrāstiṣṭhanti haviranyatra tiṣṭhati .. 5 ..
4.159.d:
ब्राह्मणाश्चैव गावश्च कुलमेकं द्विधा कृतम् ॥
एकत्र मंत्रास्तिष्ठन्ति हविरन्यत्र तिष्ठति ॥ 5 ॥
4.159.m:
Brahmins and cows are a single family made into two;
in the one place mantras abide, in the other oblation abides.

4.159.s:
yāsāṃ putrairdhṛtā lokā dhāritāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ..
tāsāṃ dānavidhānaṃ ca śṛṇu tatpṛthivīpate .. 6 ..
4.159.d:
यासां पुत्रैर्धृता लोका धारिताः सर्वदेवताः ॥
तासां दानविधानं च शृणु तत्पृथिवीपते ॥ 6 ॥
4.159.m:
By whose sons the worlds are supported and all the deities are sustained—
hear the ordinance of the gift of those [cows], O lord of the earth.

4.159.s:
ekā'pi gaurguṇopetā kṛtsnaṃ tārayate kulam ..
surūpā śīlasaṃpannā yuvatiḥ supayasvinī .. 7 ..
4.159.d:
एकाऽपि गौर्गुणोपेता कृत्स्नं तारयते कुलम् ॥
सुरूपा शीलसंपन्ना युवतिः सुपयस्विनी ॥ 7 ॥
4.159.m:
Even a single cow endowed with good qualities delivers the entire family—
comely, possessed of good nature, young, and yielding abundant milk,

4.159.s:
suvatsā suduhā caiva pāparogavivarjitā ..
vidhivattādṛśā dattā kṛtsnaṃ tārayate kulam .. 8 ..
4.159.d:
सुवत्सा सुदुहा चैव पापरोगविवर्जिता ॥
विधिवत्तादृशा दत्ता कृत्स्नं तारयते कुलम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.159.m:
having a good calf, easy to milk, and free from diseases caused by sin;
given according to the rules, such a cow delivers the entire family.

4.159.s:
kiṃ punardaśa yo dadyācchataṃ vā vidhipūrvakam ..
sahasraṃ tu punardadyāttasya vai kimihocyate .. 9 ..
4.159.d:
किं पुनर्दश यो दद्याच्छतं वा विधिपूर्वकम् ॥
सहस्रं तु पुनर्दद्यात्तस्य वै किमिहोच्यते ॥ 9 ॥
4.159.m:
What then of one who gives ten, or a hundred, according to the rules?
And if one should give a thousand, indeed, what is to be said in this world of his [merit]?

4.159.s:
gosahasraṃ purā dattaṃ nahuṣeṇa mahībhṛtā ..
sa gato brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ yayātiśca mahāmatiḥ .. 4.159.10 ..
4.159.d:
गोसहस्रं पुरा दत्तं नहुषेण महीभृता ॥
स गतो ब्रह्मणः स्थानं ययातिश्च महामतिः ॥ 4.159.10 ॥
4.159.m:
In ancient times, a thousand cows were given by King Nahuṣa;
he went to the realm of Brahmā, as did the high-minded Yayāti.

4.159.s:
gaṃgātīre mahaddattamadityā putrakāmyayā ..
lebhe putraṃ trilokeśaṃ nārāyaṇamakalmaṣam .. 11 ..
4.159.d:
गंगातीरे महद्दत्तमदित्या पुत्रकाम्यया ॥
लेभे पुत्रं त्रिलोकेशं नारायणमकल्मषम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.159.m:
On the bank of the Gaṅgā, a great [gift] was given by Aditi desiring a son;
she obtained as her son Nārāyaṇa, the spotless lord of the three worlds.

4.159.s: śrūyate pitṛbhirgītā gāthāstāḥ śṛṇu bhūpate .. 12 ..
4.159.d: श्रूयते पितृभिर्गीता गाथास्ताः शृणु भूपते ॥ 12 ॥
4.159.m: Verses sung by the ancestors are heard; listen to them, O king:

4.159.s:
yadi kaścitkule'smākaṃ gosahasraṃ pradāpayet ..
yāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ siddhiṃ kāritāṃ puṇyakarmaṇā .. 13 ..
4.159.d:
यदि कश्चित्कुलेऽस्माकं गोसहस्रं प्रदापयेत् ॥
यास्यामः परमां सिद्धिं कारितां पुण्यकर्मणा ॥ 13 ॥
4.159.m:
"If someone in our family would give a thousand cows,
we will attain the highest perfection brought about by that meritorious act.

4.159.s:
duhitā vā kule kācidgosahasrapradāyinī ..
sopānaḥ sugatirdatto bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 14 ..
4.159.d:
दुहिता वा कुले काचिद्गोसहस्रप्रदायिनी ॥
सोपानः सुगतिर्दत्तो भविष्यति न संशयः ॥ 14 ॥
4.159.m:
Or if any daughter in the family becomes a giver of a thousand cows,
a stairway providing a good destination will come to be; of this there is no doubt."

4.159.s:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yajñaṃ vai sarvakāmikam ..
gosahasraṃ tadā dadyācchāstroktavidhivannaraḥ .. 15 ..
4.159.d:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ञं वै सर्वकामिकम् ॥
गोसहस्रं तदा दद्याच्छास्त्रोक्तविधिवन्नरः ॥ 15 ॥
4.159.m:
Hereafter, I shall proclaim the sacrifice that fulfills all desires.
A man should then give a thousand cows according to the rules stated in the scriptures.

4.159.s:
tīrthe goṣṭhe gṛhe vāpi maṃḍapaṃ kārayecchubham ..
daśadvādaśahastaṃ vā caturvaktraṃ satoraṇam .. 16 ..
4.159.d:
तीर्थे गोष्ठे गृहे वापि मंडपं कारयेच्छुभम् ॥
दशद्वादशहस्तं वा चतुर्वक्त्रं सतोरणम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.159.m:
At a sacred ford, in a cowshed, or in a house, he should have an auspicious pavilion constructed,
ten or twelve cubits in size, with four entrances and archways.

4.159.s:
tanmadhye kārayedvediṃ caturhastāmanūpamām ..
hastamātrapramāṇena hastena samalaṃkṛtām ..17..
4.159.d:
तन्मध्ये कारयेद्वेदिं चतुर्हस्तामनूपमाम् ॥
हस्तमात्रप्रमाणेन हस्तेन समलंकृताम् ॥17॥
4.159.m:
In its middle he should have an altar made, four cubits [wide] and peerless,
adorned with a hand[-design] of the measure of one cubit.

4.159.s:
pūrvottare'thadigbhāge grahavediṃ prakalpayet ..
grahayajñavidhānena grahāṃstatra kramādyajet .. 18 ..
4.159.d:
पूर्वोत्तरेऽथदिग्भागे ग्रहवेदिं प्रकल्पयेत् ॥
ग्रहयज्ञविधानेन ग्रहांस्तत्र क्रमाद्यजेत् ॥ 18 ॥
4.159.m:
Then, in the north-eastern direction, he should arrange an altar for the planets;
there he should worship the planets in due order according to the rules of the planet-sacrifice.

4.159.s:
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca pūjyāḥ prathamameva hi ..
ṛtvijaḥ parikartavyā ṣoḍaśāṣṭau ca śobhanāḥ .. 19 ..
4.159.d:
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च पूज्याः प्रथममेव हि ॥
ऋत्विजः परिकर्तव्या षोडशाष्टौ च शोभनाः ॥ 19 ॥
4.159.m:
Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra must indeed be worshipped first of all.
Sixteen or eight excellent officiating priests should be appointed,

4.159.s:
catvāro vā mahārāja upādhyāyaśca paṃcamaḥ ..
sarvābharaṇasaṃpannāḥ karṇaveṣṭāṃgulīyakaiḥ .. 4.159.20 ..
4.159.d:
चत्वारो वा महाराज उपाध्यायश्च पंचमः ॥
सर्वाभरणसंपन्नाः कर्णवेष्टांगुलीयकैः ॥ 4.159.20 ॥
4.159.m:
or four, O great king, and an instructor as the fifth,
endowed with all ornaments, with earrings and finger-rings,

4.159.s:
śobhitāśchatrasaṃpannāstāmrapātradvayānvitāḥ ..
grahayajñoktavidhinā homaṃ havyaṃ samācaret .. 21 ..
4.159.d:
शोभिताश्छत्रसंपन्नास्ताम्रपात्रद्वयान्विताः ॥
ग्रहयज्ञोक्तविधिना होमं हव्यं समाचरेत् ॥ 21 ॥
4.159.m:
adorned, equipped with royal parasols, and provided with two copper vessels.
Following the rules prescribed for the planet-sacrifice, he should perform the fire oblation and sacrificial offerings.

4.159.s:
vedyāḥ pūrvottare bhāge śivakuṃḍaṃ niyojayet ..
kuṃbhadvayaṃ ca dvāreṣu paṃcaratnaṃ sapallavam .. 22 ..
4.159.d:
वेद्याः पूर्वोत्तरे भागे शिवकुंडं नियोजयेत् ॥
कुंभद्वयं च द्वारेषु पंचरत्नं सपल्लवम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.159.m:
In the north-eastern portion of the altar, he should arrange an auspicious sacrificial pit;
and at the doorways, two jars with five jewels and leafy twigs.

4.159.s:
kāryaṃ kurukulaśreṣṭha tato homaṃ samārabhet ..
lokapālabaliṃ dadyāttulāpuruṣadānavat .. 23 ..
4.159.d:
कार्यं कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ ततो होमं समारभेत् ॥
लोकपालबलिं दद्यात्तुलापुरुषदानवत् ॥ 23 ॥
4.159.m:
This is to be done, O best of Kuru's line; then he should begin the fire oblation.
He should present the offering to the world protectors just as in the gift of a man weighed against gold.

4.159.s:
gosahasrādviniṣkṛṣya savatsaṃ daśakaṃ gavām ..
gosahasrādbahiṣkuryādvastramālyavibhūṣaṇam ..
ataḥ praveśya daśakaṃ vastrairmālyaiśca pūjayet .. 24 ..
4.159.d:
गोसहस्राद्विनिष्कृष्य सवत्सं दशकं गवाम् ॥
गोसहस्राद्बहिष्कुर्याद्वस्त्रमाल्यविभूषणम् ॥
अतः प्रवेश्य दशकं वस्त्रैर्माल्यैश्च पूजयेत् ॥ 24 ॥
4.159.m:
Drawing out from the thousand cows a group of ten cows with their calves,
he should place them outside the thousand cows, adorned with garments and garlands.
Then, bringing in the group of ten, he should worship them with clothes and garlands,

4.159.s:
suvarṇaghaṃṭikāyuktaṃ tāmradohanakānvitam ..
suvarṇatilakopetaṃ khurai raupyairalaṃkṛtaiḥ ..
hemaratnamayaiḥ śṛṃgaiścāmaraiścopaśobhitam .. 25 ..
4.159.d:
सुवर्णघंटिकायुक्तं ताम्रदोहनकान्वितम् ॥
सुवर्णतिलकोपेतं खुरै रौप्यैरलंकृतैः ॥
हेमरत्नमयैः शृंगैश्चामरैश्चोपशोभितम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.159.m:
fitted with golden bells, accompanied by copper milking vessels,
provided with golden fore-head marks, with hooves adorned with silver,
with horns of gold and jewels, and beautified with chowries.

4.159.s:
munayaḥ kecidicchanti kāṃcanaṃ naṃdikeśvaram ..
lavaṇadroṇaśikhare bhaktyā tamapi kārayet .. 26 ..
4.159.d:
मुनयः केचिदिच्छन्ति कांचनं नंदिकेश्वरम् ॥
लवणद्रोणशिखरे भक्त्या तमपि कारयेत् ॥ 26 ॥
4.159.m:
Some sages desire a golden Nandikeśvara;
with devotion, one should also have him fashioned on top of a droṇa measure of salt.

4.159.s:
ekā pratyakṣaṛṣabhe keṣāṃciddānamiṣyate ..
grahānsurāṃśca saṃpūjya mālyavastraphalākṣataiḥ .. 27 ..
4.159.d:
एका प्रत्यक्षऋषभे केषांचिद्दानमिष्यते ॥
ग्रहान्सुरांश्च संपूज्य माल्यवस्त्रफलाक्षतैः ॥ 27 ॥
4.159.m:
For some, the gift is desired with an actual bull.
Having worshipped the planets and the gods with garlands, garments, fruits, and unbroken grains,

4.159.s:
patākābhiralaṃkṛtya devatāyatanāni ca ..
gośate'pi daśāṃśena sarvametatprakalpayet .. 28 ..
4.159.d:
पताकाभिरलंकृत्य देवतायतनानि च ॥
गोशतेऽपि दशांशेन सर्वमेतत्प्रकल्पयेत् ॥ 28 ॥
4.159.m:
and having adorned the shrines of the deities with flags—
even in the case of a hundred cows, he should arrange all this in a one-tenth proportion.

4.159.s:
yadi sarvā na vidyante gāvaḥ sarvaguṇottamāḥ..
daśakaṃ pūjya yatnena itaraḥ parikalpayet .. 29 ..
4.159.d:
यदि सर्वा न विद्यन्ते गावः सर्वगुणोत्तमाः॥
दशकं पूज्य यत्नेन इतरः परिकल्पयेत् ॥ 29 ॥
4.159.m:
If all the cows are not found to be highest in all good qualities,
having worshipped the ten with care, he should arrange the rest.

4.159.s:
puṣpakālamatho vādyagītamaṃgalanisvanaiḥ ..
sarvauṣadhyudakasnātaḥ snapito dvijapuṃga vaiḥ ..
imamuccārayenmaṃtraṃ gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ .. 4.159.30 ..
4.159.d:
पुष्पकालमथो वाद्यगीतमंगलनिस्वनैः ॥
सर्वौषध्युदकस्नातः स्नपितो द्विजपुंग वैः ॥
इममुच्चारयेन्मंत्रं गृहीतकुसुमांजलिः ॥ 4.159.30 ॥
4.159.m:
Then, at the time for flowers, amid the sounds of instruments, singing, and auspicious music,
bathed in water containing all medicinal herbs, sprinkled by eminent twice-born men,
he should utter this mantra, holding an offering of flowers in his folded hands:

4.159.s:
namo vo viśvamūrtibhyo viśvamātṛbhya eva ca ..
lokādhivāsinībhyastu rohiṇībhyo namo namaḥ .. 31 ..
4.159.d:
नमो वो विश्वमूर्तिभ्यो विश्वमातृभ्य एव च ॥
लोकाधिवासिनीभ्यस्तु रोहिणीभ्यो नमो नमः ॥ 31 ॥
4.159.m:
"Homage to you whose form is the universe, and mothers of the universe!
To the dwellers of the worlds, to the Rohiṇīs, homage, homage!

4.159.s:
gavāmaṃgeṣu tiṣṭhanti bhuvanānyekaviṃśatiḥ ..
brahmādayastathā devā rohiṇyaḥ pāṃtu mātaraḥ .. 32 ..
4.159.d:
गवामंगेषु तिष्ठन्ति भुवनान्येकविंशतिः ॥
ब्रह्मादयस्तथा देवा रोहिण्यः पांतु मातरः ॥ 32 ॥
4.159.m:
In the limbs of the cows reside the twenty-one worlds,
as well as the gods beginning with Brahmā; may the mothers, the Rohiṇīs, protect us!

4.159.s:
gāvo mamāgrataḥ saṃtu gāvo me saṃtu pṛṣṭhataḥ ..
gāvo me sarvataḥ saṃtu gavāṃ madhye vasāmyaham .. 33 ..
4.159.d:
गावो ममाग्रतः संतु गावो मे संतु पृष्ठतः ॥
गावो मे सर्वतः संतु गवां मध्ये वसाम्यहम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.159.m:
May cows be in front of me; may cows be behind me;
may cows be on all sides of me; may I dwell in the midst of cows!"

4.159.s:
yasmāttvaṃ vṛṣarūpeṇa dharmaścaiva sanātanaḥ .. (pāṭhā. sanānataḥ)
aṣṭamūrtteradhiṣṭhānamataḥ pāhi sanātanaḥ .. ..34..
4.159.d:
यस्मात्त्वं वृषरूपेण धर्मश्चैव सनातनः ॥ (पाठा। सनानतः)
अष्टमूर्त्तेरधिष्ठानमतः पाहि सनातनः ॥ ॥34॥
4.159.m:
"Since you, in the form of a bull, are eternal dharma itself,
and the abode of the eight-formed [Śiva], therefore, O eternal one, protect [me]!"

4.159.s:
ityāmantrya tato dayādgurave naṃdikeśvaram ..
sarvopaskaraṇopetaṃ goyutaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .. 35 ..
4.159.d:
इत्यामन्त्र्य ततो दयाद्गुरवे नंदिकेश्वरम् ॥
सर्वोपस्करणोपेतं गोयुतं च विशेषतः ॥ 35 ॥
4.159.m:
Having thus addressed [him], he should then give Nandikeśvara to the preceptor,
endowed with all utensils, and especially accompanied by a cow.

4.159.s:
gavāṃ śatamathaikaikaṃ tadardhaṃ cāpi viṃśatiḥ ..
daśa pañcaśataṃ dadyādbahubhyastadanujñayā .. 36 ..
4.159.d:
गवां शतमथैकैकं तदर्धं चापि विंशतिः ॥
दश पञ्चशतं दद्याद्बहुभ्यस्तदनुज्ञया ॥ 36 ॥
4.159.m:
With his permission, he should give a hundred cows to each one, or half of that, or twenty,
ten, or fifty, to many [priests].

4.159.s:
naikā bahubhyo dātavyā dātā doṣakaro bhavet ..
bahvyastvekasya dātavyāḥ śrīmadārogyavṛddhaye .. 37 ..
4.159.d:
नैका बहुभ्यो दातव्या दाता दोषकरो भवेत् ॥
बह्व्यस्त्वेकस्य दातव्याः श्रीमदारोग्यवृद्धये ॥ 37 ॥
4.159.m:
One [cow] should not be given to many; the giver would incur fault.
Rather, many should be given to one, for the increase of fortune and health.

4.159.s:
payovratastatastiṣṭhedekāhaṃ gosahasradaḥ ..
tathaiva brahmacārī syādya icchedvipulāṃ śriyam .. 38 ..
4.159.d:
पयोव्रतस्ततस्तिष्ठेदेकाहं गोसहस्रदः ॥
तथैव ब्रह्मचारी स्याद्य इच्छेद्विपुलां श्रियम् ॥ 38 ॥
4.159.m:
Then the giver of a thousand cows should remain on a diet of milk for one day;
likewise, he who desires vast fortune should be celibate.

4.159.s:
na deyā durbalā dhenurnālpakṣīrā na rogiṇī ..
na jīrṇā jīrṇavastrā vā nāpatyagatacetanā .. 39 ..
4.159.d:
न देया दुर्बला धेनुर्नाल्पक्षीरा न रोगिणी ॥
न जीर्णा जीर्णवस्त्रा वा नापत्यगतचेतना ॥ 39 ॥
4.159.m:
A weak cow must not be given, nor one yielding little milk, nor a diseased one,
nor a decrepit one, nor one with tattered clothes, nor one distraught over the loss of her offspring.

4.159.s:
anena vidhinā yastu gosahasraprado bhavet ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ siddhacāraṇasevitaḥ .. .. 4.159.40 ..
4.159.d:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु गोसहस्रप्रदो भवेत् ॥
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः सिद्धचारणसेवितः ॥ ॥ 4.159.40 ॥
4.159.m:
He who becomes a giver of a thousand cows according to this rule,
freed from all sins, attended upon by Siddhas and Cāraṇas,

4.159.s:
vimānenārkavarṇena kiṃkiṇījālamālinā ..
sarveṣāṃ lokapālānāṃ loke saṃpūjyate suraiḥ .. 41 ..
4.159.d:
विमानेनार्कवर्णेन किंकिणीजालमालिना ॥
सर्वेषां लोकपालानां लोके संपूज्यते सुरैः ॥ 41 ॥
4.159.m:
in a celestial chariot shining like the sun and garlanded with a network of small bells,
is worshipped by the gods in the worlds of all the world protectors.

4.159.s:
saptāvarānsapta parānsapta caiva parāvarān ..
puruṣānuddhareddattvā gosahasraṃ vidhānataḥ .. 42 ..
4.159.d:
सप्तावरान्सप्त परान्सप्त चैव परावरान् ॥
पुरुषानुद्धरेद्दत्त्वा गोसहस्रं विधानतः ॥ 42 ॥
4.159.m:
Seven below, seven above, and indeed seven intermediate [ancestors]—
a man delivers these persons after giving a thousand cows according to the ordinance.

4.159.s:
svargalokāccyuto vātha nārī vā satparāyaṇā ..
sapta janmāni rājñī syātstūyamānā punaḥpunaḥ .. 43 ..
4.159.d:
स्वर्गलोकाच्च्युतो वाथ नारी वा सत्परायणा ॥
सप्त जन्मानि राज्ञी स्यात्स्तूयमाना पुनःपुनः ॥ 43 ॥
4.159.m:
Having fallen from the heavenly world, or if a woman devoted to truth,
she becomes a queen for seven births, praised again and again.

4.159.s:
na tvevedaṃ dānamātraṃ praśastaṃ pātraṃ kālo goviśeṣo vighiśca ..
tasmādetāḥ sarvabhūṣāsametāḥ pātre kāle kṣīravatyo vidhānāt ..44 ..
4.159.d:
न त्वेवेदं दानमात्रं प्रशस्तं पात्रं कालो गोविशेषो विघिश्च ॥
तस्मादेताः सर्वभूषासमेताः पात्रे काले क्षीरवत्यो विधानात् ॥44 ॥
4.159.m:
Yet the mere gift is not praised: the recipient, the time, the quality of the cows, and the rite [must be right];
therefore, according to the rule, these milk-yielding [cows], equipped with all ornaments, [should be given] to a worthy recipient at an auspicious time.

4.159.s:
ekāpi gaurbahuguṇā guṇine pradattā dātuḥ kulaṃ tripuruṣaṃ vidhivatpunāti ..
yaḥ śraddhayā vitaratīha gavāṃ sahasraṃ śakyaṃ phalaṃ na nṛpate'sya mayābhidhātum .. 45 .. ..
vṛṣabhadānavratavarṇanam
4.159.d:
एकापि गौर्बहुगुणा गुणिने प्रदत्ता दातुः कुलं त्रिपुरुषं विधिवत्पुनाति ॥
यः श्रद्धया वितरतीह गवां सहस्रं शक्यं फलं न नृपतेऽस्य मयाभिधातुम् ॥ 45 ॥ ॥
वृषभदानव्रतवर्णनम्

4.160.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca.. ..
yuṣmadvākyāmṛtamidaṃ śṛṇvānāha janārdana ..
na tṛptimadhigacchāmi jātaṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me .. 1 ..
4.160.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच॥ ॥
युष्मद्वाक्यामृतमिदं शृण्वानाह जनार्दन ॥
न तृप्तिमधिगच्छामि जातं कौतूहलं हि मे ॥ 1 ॥
4.160.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Listening to this nectar of your words, O Janārdana,
I do not reach satisfaction; indeed, curiosity has arisen in me.

4.160.s:
gopatiḥ kila govindastriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ ..
govṛṣasya pradānena trailokyamabhinaṃdati .. 2 ..
4.160.d:
गोपतिः किल गोविन्दस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः ॥
गोवृषस्य प्रदानेन त्रैलोक्यमभिनंदति ॥ 2 ॥
4.160.m:
Govinda is renowned in the three worlds as the lord of cows;
by the gift of a breeding bull, the three worlds rejoice.

4.160.s:
tadgovṛṣabhadānasya phalaṃ me kathāyācyuta ..
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
vṛṣadānaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṇuṣva kathayāmi te .. 3 ..
4.160.d:
तद्गोवृषभदानस्य फलं मे कथायाच्युत ॥
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
वृषदानफलं पुण्यं शृणुष्व कथयामि ते ॥ 3 ॥
4.160.m:
Tell me, O Acyuta, the fruit of that gift of a bull.
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Listen, I shall tell you the meritorious fruit of the gift of a bull.

4.160.s:
pavitraṃ pāvanaṃ caiva sarvadānottamottamam ..
daśadhenusamo'naḍvānekaścaikadhuraṃdharaḥ ..
daśadhenupradānāddhi sa evaiko viśiṣyate .. 4 ..
4.160.d:
पवित्रं पावनं चैव सर्वदानोत्तमोत्तमम् ॥
दशधेनुसमोऽनड्वानेकश्चैकधुरंधरः ॥
दशधेनुप्रदानाद्धि स एवैको विशिष्यते ॥ 4 ॥

4.160.s:
yo hṛṣṭaścātipuṣṭāṃgo hyarogaḥ pāṃḍunandana ..
yuvā bhadraḥ suśīlaśca sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ .. 5 ..
4.160.d:
यो हृष्टश्चातिपुष्टांगो ह्यरोगः पांडुनन्दन ॥
युवा भद्रः सुशीलश्च सर्वदोषविवर्जितः ॥ 5 ॥
4.160.m: One who is spirited, with very well-nourished limbs, free from disease, O son of Pāṇḍu, / young, auspicious, of good nature, and free of all defects,

4.160.s:
dhuraṃdharaḥ sthāpayate eka eva kulaṃ mahat ..
trātā bhavati saṃsāre nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ..6..
4.160.d:
धुरंधरः स्थापयते एक एव कुलं महत् ॥
त्राता भवति संसारे नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥6॥
4.160.m: bearing the yoke, alone sustains a great lineage; / he becomes a saviour in saṃsāra; there should be no doubt about this.

4.160.s:
alaṃkṛtya vṛṣaṃ śāṃtaṃ puṇyakāla upasthite ..
raupyalāṃgūlasaṃyuktaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet .. 7 ..
4.160.d:
अलंकृत्य वृषं शांतं पुण्यकाल उपस्थिते ॥
रौप्यलांगूलसंयुक्तं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥ 7 ॥
4.160.m: Having adorned a gentle bull when an auspicious time arrives, / endowed with a silver tail, one should present him to a brāhmaṇa,

4.160.s: maṃtreṇānena rājendra taṃ śṛṇuṣva vadāmi te .. 8 ..
4.160.d: मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र तं शृणुष्व वदामि ते ॥ 8 ॥
4.160.m: with this mantra, O king of kings; listen to it, I tell you:

4.160.s:
dharmastvaṃ vṛṣarūpeṇa jagadānandakārakaḥ ..
aṣṭamūrteradhiṣṭhānamataḥ pāhi sanātana .. 9 ..
4.160.d:
धर्मस्त्वं वृषरूपेण जगदानन्दकारकः ॥
अष्टमूर्तेरधिष्ठानमतः पाहि सनातन ॥ 9 ॥
4.160.m: “You are Dharma in the form of a bull, bringing joy to the world, / the abode of the Eightfold Form; therefore protect [me], O Eternal One.”

4.160.s:
dattvaivaṃ dakṣiṇāyuktaṃ praṇipatya visarjayet ..
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vāṅmanaḥ kāyakarmaṇām ..
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti godānasukṛtena ca .. 4.160.10 ..
4.160.d:
दत्त्वैवं दक्षिणायुक्तं प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् ॥
सप्तजन्मकृतं पापं वाङ्मनः कायकर्मणाम् ॥
तत्सर्वं विलयं याति गोदानसुकृतेन च ॥ 4.160.10 ॥
4.160.m: Having thus given [the bull] together with a dakṣiṇā, one should bow down and dismiss [it]; / the sin of actions of speech, mind, and body committed across seven births, / all that dissolves through the merit of the gift of cattle.

4.160.s:
yānaṃ vṛṣabhasaṃyuktaṃ dīpyamānaṃ suśobhanam ..
āruhya kāmagaṃ divyaṃ svalokamadhirohati ... 11 ..
4.160.d:
यानं वृषभसंयुक्तं दीप्यमानं सुशोभनम् ॥
आरुह्य कामगं दिव्यं स्वलोकमधिरोहति ॥। 11 ॥
4.160.m: Mounting a vehicle yoked to bulls, shining, very beautiful, / moving at will and celestial, he ascends to his own world.

4.160.s:
yāvaṃti tasya romāṇi govṛṣasya mahīpate ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi gavāṃ loke mahīyate ..12..
4.160.d:
यावंति तस्य रोमाणि गोवृषस्य महीपते ॥
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि गवां लोके महीयते ॥12॥
4.160.m: As many hairs as that bull has, O protector of the earth, / for so many thousands of years he is glorified in the world of cattle.

4.160.s:
golokādavatīrṇastu iha loke dvijo bhavet ..
yajñayājī mahātejāḥ sarvabrāhmaṇapūjitaḥ .. 13 ..
4.160.d:
गोलोकादवतीर्णस्तु इह लोके द्विजो भवेत् ॥
यज्ञयाजी महातेजाः सर्वब्राह्मणपूजितः ॥ 13 ॥
4.160.m: And descending from Goloka, he becomes a twice-born in this world, / performing sacrifices, of great splendour, and honoured by all brāhmaṇas.

4.160.s:
yathoktaṃ te mahārāja kasya deyo vṛṣottamaḥ ..
tadahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi pātraṃ trāṇapadaṃ nṛṇām .. 14 ..
4.160.d:
यथोक्तं ते महाराज कस्य देयो वृषोत्तमः ॥
तदहं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि पात्रं त्राणपदं नृणाम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.160.m: As you asked, O great king, to whom the best of bulls should be given, / I shall tell you that vessel of salvation for men:

4.160.s:
ye kṣāṃtadāṃtāḥ śrutipūrṇakarṇā jiteṃdriyāḥ prāṇivadhānnivṛttāḥ ..
pratigrahe saṃkucitā gṛhasthāste brāhmaṇāstārayituṃ samarthāḥ .. 15 ..
4.160.d:
ये क्षांतदांताः श्रुतिपूर्णकर्णा जितेंद्रियाः प्राणिवधान्निवृत्ताः ॥
प्रतिग्रहे संकुचिता गृहस्थास्ते ब्राह्मणास्तारयितुं समर्थाः ॥ 15 ॥
4.160.m: Those householders who are patient, self-restrained, whose ears are filled with Vedic knowledge, whose senses are mastered, who abstain from killing living beings, / and who are hesitant to accept gifts—those brāhmaṇas are capable of rescuing [the donor].

4.160.s:
ūrjasvinaṃ bharasahaṃ dṛḍhakaṃdharaṃ ca yacchaṃti ye vṛṣamaśeṣaguṇopapannam ..
dattena yadbhavati godaśakena puṇyaṃ satyaṃ bhavaṃti bhuvi tatphalabhāginaste .. 16 ..
kapilādānamāhātmyavarṇanam
4.160.d:
ऊर्जस्विनं भरसहं दृढकंधरं च यच्छंति ये वृषमशेषगुणोपपन्नम् ॥
दत्तेन यद्भवति गोदशकेन पुण्यं सत्यं भवंति भुवि तत्फलभागिनस्ते ॥ 16 ॥
कपिलादानमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
4.160.m:
Those who give a bull that is vigorous, enduring burdens, firm-necked, and endowed with all virtues / truly become partakers on earth of that fruit which is the merit gained by giving ten cows.
Description of the Greatness of the Gift of a Kapilā Cow

4.161.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kapilādānamāhātmyaṃ kathayasva jagatpate ..
puṇyaṃ yatsarvadānānāṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
4.161.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
कपिलादानमाहात्म्यं कथयस्व जगत्पते ॥
पुण्यं यत्सर्वदानानां सर्वपातकनाशनम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.161.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Tell, O Lord of the universe, the greatness of the gift of a kapilā cow, / which is the merit of all gifts, destroying all wicked deeds.

4.161.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi vinatāśvena yatpurā ..
kathitaṃ kapilādānaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva mahāmate .. 2 ..
4.161.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
तत्तेऽहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि विनताश्वेन यत्पुरा ॥
कथितं कपिलादानं तच्छृणुष्व महामते ॥ 2 ॥
4.161.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
I shall explain that to you which Vinatāśva in ancient times / told concerning the gift of a kapilā cow; listen to that, O noble-minded one.

4.161.s:
.. vinatāśva uvāca .. ..
ataḥ paraṃ mahārājobhayamukhyāḥ samāsataḥ ..
vidhānaṃ yadvarāheṇa dharaṇyai kathitaṃ purā .. 3 ..
4.161.d:
॥ विनताश्व उवाच ॥ ॥
अतः परं महाराजोभयमुख्याः समासतः ॥
विधानं यद्वराहेण धरण्यै कथितं पुरा ॥ 3 ॥
4.161.m:
Vinatāśva said:
Hereafter, O great king, [I shall speak] briefly of the two-faced [cow], / the procedure that was told of old by Varāha to Dharaṇī.

4.161.s:
tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi navapuṇyaphalaṃ ca yat ..
.. dharaṇyuvāca .. ..
yattvayā kapilā nāma pūrvamutpāvitā prabho .. 4 ..
4.161.d:
तदहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि नवपुण्यफलं च यत् ॥
॥ धरण्युवाच ॥ ॥
यत्त्वया कपिला नाम पूर्वमुत्पाविता प्रभो ॥ 4 ॥
4.161.m:
That I shall declare, and what the fruit of the nine merits is.
Dharaṇī said:
The one named kapilā who was produced by you of old, O Lord,

4.161.s:
homadhenuḥ sadā puṇyā dhenuryajñāvatārabhūḥ ..
sā kathaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo hi deyā kasmindine'pi ca .. .. 5 ..
4.161.d:
होमधेनुः सदा पुण्या धेनुर्यज्ञावतारभूः ॥
सा कथं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो हि देया कस्मिन्दिनेऽपि च ॥ ॥ 5 ॥
4.161.m: the cow for the fire-sacrifice, ever auspicious, the cow that is the birthplace of the sacrifice’s descent— / how should she be given to brāhmaṇas, and on which day?

4.161.s:
kīdṛśāya ca viprāya dātavyā puṇyalakṣaṇā ..
kati vā kapilāḥ proktāḥ svayameva svayaṃbhuvā .. 6 ..
4.161.d:
कीदृशाय च विप्राय दातव्या पुण्यलक्षणा ॥
कति वा कपिलाः प्रोक्ताः स्वयमेव स्वयंभुवा ॥ 6 ॥
4.161.m: And to what kind of vipra should she, possessing auspicious marks, be given? / How many kapilās indeed were proclaimed by the Self-born One himself?

4.161.s:
tāsāṃ prayatnāddānena kiṃ puṇyaṃ syācca mādhava ..
etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ vistarānmadhusūdana .. 7 ..
4.161.d:
तासां प्रयत्नाद्दानेन किं पुण्यं स्याच्च माधव ॥
एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं विस्तरान्मधुसूदन ॥ 7 ॥
4.161.m: And what merit would there be from their gift made with effort, O Mādhava? / I wish to hear this in detail, O Madhusūdana.

4.161.s:
.. varāha uvāca .. ..
śṛṇuṣva bhadre tattvena pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam ..
kṛtvā yatsarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 8 ..
4.161.d:
॥ वराह उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणुष्व भद्रे तत्त्वेन पवित्रं पापनाशनम् ॥
कृत्वा यत्सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ॥ 8 ॥
4.161.m:
Varāha said:
Listen in truth, O auspicious one, to that which is pure and destroys sins, / by doing which one is freed from all sins; there is no doubt about this.

4.161.s:
kapilā agnihotrārthaṃ yajñārthe ca varānane ..
uddhṛtya sarvatejāṃsi brahmaṇā nirmitā purā .. 9 ..
4.161.d:
कपिला अग्निहोत्रार्थं यज्ञार्थे च वरानने ॥
उद्धृत्य सर्वतेजांसि ब्रह्मणा निर्मिता पुरा ॥ 9 ॥
4.161.m: The kapilā cow, for the agnihotra and for sacrifice, O fair-faced one, / was fashioned of old by Brahmā, extracting all splendours.

4.161.s:
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca maṅgalānāṃ ca maṃgalam ..
puṇyānāṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ kapilā ca varānane .. 4.161.10 ..
4.161.d:
पवित्राणां पवित्रं च मङ्गलानां च मंगलम् ॥
पुण्यानां परमं पुण्यं कपिला च वरानने ॥ 4.161.10 ॥
4.161.m: The purest of the pure, the most auspicious of the auspicious, / the supreme merit among merits, O fair-faced one, is the kapilā cow.

4.161.s:
tapasastapa evāgryaṃ vratānāmuttamaṃ vrataṃ ..
dānānāmuttamaṃ dānaṃ vidhinā hyetadakṣayam .. 11 ..
4.161.d:
तपसस्तप एवाग्र्यं व्रतानामुत्तमं व्रतं ॥
दानानामुत्तमं दानं विधिना ह्येतदक्षयम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.161.m: The foremost austerity among austerities, the highest vow among vows, / the supreme gift among gifts, this [offering performed] according to rule is imperishable.

4.161.s:
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni guhyānyāyatanāni ca ..
pavitrāṇi ca puṇyāni sarvaloke vasundhare .. 12 ..
4.161.d:
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि गुह्यान्यायतनानि च ॥
पवित्राणि च पुण्यानि सर्वलोके वसुन्धरे ॥ 12 ॥
4.161.m: Whatever sacred fords and secret sanctuaries are on the earth, / pure and holy in all the world, O Vasundharā,

4.161.s:
hotavyānyagnihotrāṇi sāyaṃ prātardvijātibhiḥ ..
kapilāyā ghṛteneha daśa kṣīreṇa vā punaḥ .. 13 ..
4.161.d:
होतव्यान्यग्निहोत्राणि सायं प्रातर्द्विजातिभिः ॥
कपिलाया घृतेनेह दश क्षीरेण वा पुनः ॥ 13 ॥
4.161.m: the agnihotras are to be offered evening and morning by the twice-born / with ghee of the kapilā cow in this world, or with ten parts of milk.

4.161.s:
yajaṃte ye'gnihotrāṇi annaiśca vividhaiḥ sadā ..
pūjayantyatithīṃścaiva parāṃ bhaktimupāgatāḥ .. 14 ..
4.161.d:
यजंते येऽग्निहोत्राणि अन्नैश्च विविधैः सदा ॥
पूजयन्त्यतिथींश्चैव परां भक्तिमुपागताः ॥ 14 ॥
4.161.m: Those who ever worship the agnihotras with diverse foods, / and honour guests, having attained supreme devotion,

4.161.s:
teṣāṃ tvādityavarṇaiśca vimānairjāyate gatiḥ ..
sūryamaṇḍalamadhye ca brahmaṇā nirmitā purā .. 15 ..
4.161.d:
तेषां त्वादित्यवर्णैश्च विमानैर्जायते गतिः ॥
सूर्यमण्डलमध्ये च ब्रह्मणा निर्मिता पुरा ॥ 15 ॥
4.161.m: their departure takes place by means of celestial chariots having the colour of the sun; / and within the orb of the sun [the kapilā] was fashioned of old by Brahmā.

4.161.s:
kapilāyāḥ śiro grīvāṃ sarva tīrthāni bhāmini ..
pitāmahaniyogācca nivasaṃti hi nityaśaḥ .. 16 ..
4.161.d:
कपिलायाः शिरो ग्रीवां सर्व तीर्थानि भामिनि ॥
पितामहनियोगाच्च निवसंति हि नित्यशः ॥ 16 ॥
4.161.m: In the head and neck of the kapilā cow, O lovely one, / all sacred fords dwell perpetually by command of the Grandfather.

4.161.s:
prātarutthāya yo martyaḥ kapilā galamastakāt ..
cyutaṃ tu bhaktyā pānīyaṃ śirasā dhārayennaraḥ .. 17 ..
4.161.d:
प्रातरुत्थाय यो मर्त्यः कपिला गलमस्तकात् ॥
च्युतं तु भक्त्या पानीयं शिरसा धारयेन्नरः ॥ 17 ॥
4.161.m: Having risen in the morning, whichever mortal man with devotion / bears upon his head water dripping from the throat and head of a kapilā cow,

4.161.s:
sa tena puṇyenopetastatkṣaṇādgatakilviṣaḥ ..
viṃśadvarṣakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ dahatyagnirivendhanam .. 18 ..
4.161.d:
स तेन पुण्येनोपेतस्तत्क्षणाद्गतकिल्विषः ॥
विंशद्वर्षकृतं पापं दहत्यग्निरिवेन्धनम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.161.m: endowed with that merit, his sins are gone that very moment; / it burns away the sin committed across twenty years, as fire burns fuel.

4.161.s:
kalya utthāya yo martyaḥ kuryāttāsāṃ pradakṣiṇam ..
pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena pṛthivī syādvasundhare .. 19 ..
4.161.d:
कल्य उत्थाय यो मर्त्यः कुर्यात्तासां प्रदक्षिणम् ॥
प्रदक्षिणीकृता तेन पृथिवी स्याद्वसुन्धरे ॥ 19 ॥
4.161.m: Having risen at dawn, whichever mortal performs circumambulation of them, / by him the earth has been circumambulated, O Vasundharā.

4.161.s:
pradakṣiṇāyāṃ caikāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ ca vasundhare ..
daśavarṣakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ naśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 4.161.20 ..
4.161.d:
प्रदक्षिणायां चैकायां कृतायां च वसुन्धरे ॥
दशवर्षकृतं पापं नश्यते नात्र संशयः ॥ 4.161.20 ॥
4.161.m: And when a single circumambulation is performed, O Vasundharā, / the sin committed across ten years is destroyed; there is no doubt about this.

4.161.s:
kapilāyāstu mūtreṇa snāyādvai yaḥ śucivrataḥ ..
sa gaṅgādyeṣu tīrtheṣu snāto bhavati mānavaḥ .. 21 ..
4.161.d:
कपिलायास्तु मूत्रेण स्नायाद्वै यः शुचिव्रतः ॥
स गङ्गाद्येषु तीर्थेषु स्नातो भवति मानवः ॥ 21 ॥
4.161.m: He who, observing a pure vow, bathes with the urine of a kapilā cow, / that man becomes one who has bathed in the Gaṅgā and other sacred fords.

4.161.s:
yena snānena caikena bhavamukto bhavennaraḥ ..
yāvajjīvakṛtātpāpāttatkṣaṇādeva mucyate .. 22 ..
4.161.d:
येन स्नानेन चैकेन भवमुक्तो भवेन्नरः ॥
यावज्जीवकृतात्पापात्तत्क्षणादेव मुच्यते ॥ 22 ॥
4.161.m: By which single bath a man becomes liberated from worldly existence; / he is freed that very moment from the sin committed throughout his life.

4.161.s:
gosahasraṃ ca yo dadyādekāṃ vā kapilāṃ naraḥ ..
samametatpurā prāha brahmaloke pitāmahaḥ .. 23 ..
4.161.d:
गोसहस्रं च यो दद्यादेकां वा कपिलां नरः ॥
सममेतत्पुरा प्राह ब्रह्मलोके पितामहः ॥ 23 ॥
4.161.m: Whether a man gives a thousand cows or a single kapilā cow, / the Grandfather declared of old in the world of Brahmā that these are equal.

4.161.s:
yaścaikāṃ kapilāṃ hanyānnaro rajjukaro yadi ..
gosahasraṃ hataṃ tena bhavatīha na saṃśayaḥ .. 24 ..
4.161.d:
यश्चैकां कपिलां हन्यान्नरो रज्जुकरो यदि ॥
गोसहस्रं हतं तेन भवतीह न संशयः ॥ 24 ॥
4.161.m: And if a man should kill a single kapilā cow, even if making a halter, / a thousand cows have been killed by him in this world; there is no doubt.

4.161.s:
gavāṃ sthitiṃ kalpayeta ghṛtaṃ gavyaṃ na dūṣayet ..
yāvaddhi varddhate gavyaṃ tāvatpāpaistu pūyate .. 25 ...
4.161.d:
गवां स्थितिं कल्पयेत घृतं गव्यं न दूषयेत् ॥
यावद्धि वर्द्धते गव्यं तावत्पापैस्तु पूयते ॥ 25 ॥।
4.161.m: One should arrange shelter for cattle and not spoil cow’s ghee; / for as long as the products of the cow increase, so long is one purified of sins.

4.161.s:
gavāṃ kaṃḍūyanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tathā ca pratipālanam ..
tulyaṃ goghṛtadānasya bhayarogādipālanam .. 26 ..
4.161.d:
गवां कंडूयनं श्रेष्ठं तथा च प्रतिपालनम् ॥
तुल्यं गोघृतदानस्य भयरोगादिपालनम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.161.m: Scratching cows is excellent, as is tending to them; / protecting [them] from fear, disease, and the like is equal to the gift of cow’s ghee.

4.161.s:
tṛṇādibhakṣaṇārthaṃ ca gavāṃ dadyāddharādikam ..
svargavāsaphalaṃ divyaṃ labhate mānavottamaḥ .. 27 ..
4.161.d:
तृणादिभक्षणार्थं च गवां दद्याद्धरादिकम् ॥
स्वर्गवासफलं दिव्यं लभते मानवोत्तमः ॥ 27 ॥
4.161.m: And for cows to feed on grass and the like, one should give land and other [possessions]; / the best of men obtains the celestial reward of dwelling in heaven.

4.161.s:
daśeha kapilāḥ proktāḥ svayameva svayaṃbhuvā ..
yo dadyācchrotriyasyaiva svargaṃ gatvā sa mānavaḥ .. 28 ..
4.161.d:
दशेह कपिलाः प्रोक्ताः स्वयमेव स्वयंभुवा ॥
यो दद्याच्छ्रोत्रियस्यैव स्वर्गं गत्वा स मानवः ॥ 28 ॥
4.161.m: Ten kinds of tawny cows are proclaimed here by the Self-born One himself. / The man who gives [one] to a learned Brāhmaṇa alone, having gone to heaven,

4.161.s:
vimānairvividhairdivyairdivyakanyābhirarcitaḥ ..
sevyamānastu gaṃdharvairdīpyamānā yathāgnayaḥ .. 29 ..
4.161.d:
विमानैर्विविधैर्दिव्यैर्दिव्यकन्याभिरर्चितः ॥
सेव्यमानस्तु गंधर्वैर्दीप्यमाना यथाग्नयः ॥ 29 ॥
4.161.m: Honoured by celestial maidens in various divine aerial chariots, / and served by Gandharvas, blazes like fires.

4.161.s:
suvarṇakapilā pūrvā dvitīyā gaurapiṅgalā ..
āśā caiva tṛtīyā syādagnijvālā caturthikā .. 4.161.30 ..
4.161.d:
सुवर्णकपिला पूर्वा द्वितीया गौरपिङ्गला ॥
आशा चैव तृतीया स्यादग्निज्वाला चतुर्थिका ॥ 4.161.30 ॥
4.161.m: The first is the golden-tawny; the second is the yellowish-red; / the third is the Āśā; and the fourth is the Agnijvālā.

4.161.s:
paṃcamī juhuvarṇā syātṣaṣṭhī tu ghṛtapiṅgalā ..
saptamī śvetapiṅgā syādaṣṭamī kṣīrapiṅgalā .. 31 ..
4.161.d:
पंचमी जुहुवर्णा स्यात्षष्ठी तु घृतपिङ्गला ॥
सप्तमी श्वेतपिङ्गा स्यादष्टमी क्षीरपिङ्गला ॥ 31 ॥
4.161.m: The fifth is of sacrificial ladle colour, and the sixth is ghee-reddish; / the seventh is white-reddish, and the eighth is milk-reddish.

4.161.s:
navamī pāṭalā jñeyā daśamī puṣpapiṅgalā ..
etā daśa samākhyātāḥ kapilāśca vasuṃdhare .. 32 ..
4.161.d:
नवमी पाटला ज्ञेया दशमी पुष्पपिङ्गला ॥
एता दश समाख्याताः कपिलाश्च वसुंधरे ॥ 32 ॥
4.161.m: The ninth is to be known as Pāṭalā, and the tenth as flower-reddish. / These ten tawny cows are described, O Earth!

4.161.s:
sarvā hyetā mahābhāgāstārayaṃti na saṃśayaḥ ..
saṃgameṣu praśastāśca sarvapāpapraṇāśanāḥ .. 33 ..
4.161.d:
सर्वा ह्येता महाभागास्तारयंति न संशयः ॥
संगमेषु प्रशस्ताश्च सर्वपापप्रणाशनाः ॥ 33 ॥
4.161.m: For all these highly fortunate ones cause [one] to cross over, without doubt; / they are praised at confluences and destroy all sins.

4.161.s:
evametāstu kapilāḥ pāpaghnyaśca vasundhare ..
āśā caiva tu yā proktā agnigarbhānalaprabhā ..34..
4.161.d:
एवमेतास्तु कपिलाः पापघ्न्यश्च वसुन्धरे ॥
आशा चैव तु या प्रोक्ता अग्निगर्भानलप्रभा ॥34॥
4.161.m: Thus these tawny cows destroy sins, O Earth! / And that which is called Āśā has the womb of fire and the radiance of fire,

4.161.s:
agnijvālojjvalaiḥ śṛṃgaiḥ pradīptāṃgāralocanā ..
agnipuṣpā agnilomā tathānyā cānalaprabhā ..35..
4.161.d:
अग्निज्वालोज्ज्वलैः शृंगैः प्रदीप्तांगारलोचना ॥
अग्निपुष्पा अग्निलोमा तथान्या चानलप्रभा ॥35॥
4.161.m: With horns blazing like flames of fire, with eyes like glowing coals, / with fire-like spots, with fire-coloured hair, and another with the radiance of fire.

4.161.s:
tāmāgneyyāṃ sadā dadyādbrāhmaṇāyetaraiḥ sadā ..
gṛhītvā kapilāṃ śūdraḥ kāmatastatpayaḥ pibet ..36..
4.161.d:
तामाग्नेय्यां सदा दद्याद्ब्राह्मणायेतरैः सदा ॥
गृहीत्वा कपिलां शूद्रः कामतस्तत्पयः पिबेत् ॥36॥
4.161.m: One should always give her in the south-east to a Brāhmaṇa, always by others. / If a Śūdra, taking a tawny cow, should drink her milk out of desire,

4.161.s:
patitaśca bhavennityaṃ caṃḍālasadṛśaḥ pumān..
tasmānna pratigṛhṇīyācchabalāṃ gāṃ kathaṃcana ..37..
4.161.d:
पतितश्च भवेन्नित्यं चंडालसदृशः पुमान्॥
तस्मान्न प्रतिगृह्णीयाच्छबलां गां कथंचन ॥37॥
4.161.m: That man would constantly become fallen, equal to a Caṇḍāla. / Therefore one should never accept a spotted cow.

4.161.s:
dvārāṃte parihartavyā kapilā gaurdvijetaraiḥ ..
lokeṣu te mṛḍhatamāḥ kapilākṣīrabhojanāḥ ..38..
4.161.d:
द्वारांते परिहर्तव्या कपिला गौर्द्विजेतरैः ॥
लोकेषु ते मृढतमाः कपिलाक्षीरभोजनाः ॥38॥
4.161.m: A tawny cow should be avoided at the house's threshold by those other than the twice-born. / Those who consume the milk of a tawny cow are the most foolish in the worlds.

4.161.s:
asaṃbhāṣyāśca patitāḥ śūdrāste pāpakarmiṇaḥ ..
pibaṃti yāvatkapilāṃ tāvatteṣāṃ pitāmahāḥ ..
amedhyaṃ bhuñjate'tastāṃ nopajīveddvijetaraḥ .. 39 ..
4.161.d:
असंभाष्याश्च पतिताः शूद्रास्ते पापकर्मिणः ॥
पिबंति यावत्कपिलां तावत्तेषां पितामहाः ॥
अमेध्यं भुञ्जतेऽतस्तां नोपजीवेद्द्विजेतरः ॥ 39 ॥
4.161.m: Those sinful Śūdras are unfit to be spoken to and are fallen. / As long as they drink [from] a tawny cow, so long their ancestors / eat impure matter; therefore, one other than a twice-born must not subsist on her.

4.161.s:
tāsāṃ ghṛtaṃ ca kṣīraṃ vā navanītamathāpi vā ..
upajīvaṃti ye śūdrāste prayāṃti yamālayam ..4.161.40..
4.161.d:
तासां घृतं च क्षीरं वा नवनीतमथापि वा ॥
उपजीवंति ये शूद्रास्ते प्रयांति यमालयम् ॥4.161.40॥
4.161.m: Those Śūdras who subsist on their ghee, milk, or butter, / go to the abode of Yama.

4.161.s:
kapilājīvinaḥ śūdrāḥ sarve gacchaṃti rauravam ..
raurave bhuñjate duḥkhaṃ varṣakoṭi śatoṣitāḥ ..41..
4.161.d:
कपिलाजीविनः शूद्राः सर्वे गच्छंति रौरवम् ॥
रौरवे भुञ्जते दुःखं वर्षकोटि शतोषिताः ॥41॥
4.161.m: All Śūdras who subsist on a tawny cow go to Raurava; / dwelling for hundreds of millions of years in Raurava, they experience suffering.

4.161.s:
tato vimuktāḥ kālena jāyaṃte śvānayoniṣu ..
śvānayonervimuktāste viṣṭhāyāṃ kṛmiyonigāḥ ..42..
4.161.d:
ततो विमुक्ताः कालेन जायंते श्वानयोनिषु ॥
श्वानयोनेर्विमुक्तास्ते विष्ठायां कृमियोनिगाः ॥42॥
4.161.m: Then, released in the course of time, they are born in the wombs of dogs; / released from the womb of a dog, they enter the wombs of worms in feces.

4.161.s:
viṣṭhāsveva ca pāpiṣṭhā durgaṃdheṣu ca nityaśaḥ..
bhūyo'pi jāyamānāste tatrottāro na vidyate ..43..
4.161.d:
विष्ठास्वेव च पापिष्ठा दुर्गंधेषु च नित्यशः॥
भूयोऽपि जायमानास्ते तत्रोत्तारो न विद्यते ॥43॥
4.161.m: Constantly being born again in feces and foul odors, / those most sinful ones find no rescue there.

4.161.s:
brāhmaṇaścaiva yo devi kuryātteṣāṃ pratigraham ..
tataḥ prabhṛtyamedhyāyāṃ pitarastasya śerate .. 44 ..
4.161.d:
ब्राह्मणश्चैव यो देवि कुर्यात्तेषां प्रतिग्रहम् ॥
ततः प्रभृत्यमेध्यायां पितरस्तस्य शेरते ॥ 44 ॥
4.161.m: And whatever Brāhmaṇa, O goddess, should accept [a gift] from them, / from then on his ancestors lie in impurity.

4.161.s:
taṃ vipraṃ nānubhāṣeta na cāpyekāsane viśet ..
sa nityaṃ varjanīyo vai dūrāttu brāhmaṇādhamaḥ ..45..
4.161.d:
तं विप्रं नानुभाषेत न चाप्येकासने विशेत् ॥
स नित्यं वर्जनीयो वै दूरात्तु ब्राह्मणाधमः ॥45॥
4.161.m: One should not converse with that Vipra, nor sit on the same seat [with him]; / that lowest of Brāhmaṇas is indeed always to be avoided from afar.

4.161.s:
yastena saha bhāṣeta prāyaścittī bhave ddvijaḥ ..
ekasya gopradānasya sahasrāṃśo na pūryate ..46..
4.161.d:
यस्तेन सह भाषेत प्रायश्चित्ती भवे द्द्विजः ॥
एकस्य गोप्रदानस्य सहस्रांशो न पूर्यते ॥46॥
4.161.m: A twice-born who speaks with him must perform an expiation. / A thousandth part of [the merit of] giving a single cow is not equalled [by other gifts].

4.161.s: kimanyairbahubhirdānaiḥ koṭisaṃkhyātavistaraiḥ..47..
4.161.d: किमन्यैर्बहुभिर्दानैः कोटिसंख्यातविस्तरैः॥47॥
4.161.m: What need of other numerous gifts, extensive by the tens of millions?

4.161.s:
śrotriyāya daridrāya suvṛttāyāhitāgnaye ..
dattvaikāṃ kapilāṃ dhenuṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ..48..
4.161.d:
श्रोत्रियाय दरिद्राय सुवृत्तायाहिताग्नये ॥
दत्त्वैकां कपिलां धेनुं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥48॥
4.161.m: By giving a single tawny milch cow to a poor learned Brāhmaṇa of good conduct / who maintains the sacred fire, one is freed from all sins.

4.161.s:
māse prasavinīṃ dhenuṃ dānārthī pratipālayet ..
ātmārthe na prapālyā hi sadā narakabhīrubhiḥ ..49...
4.161.d:
मासे प्रसविनीं धेनुं दानार्थी प्रतिपालयेत् ॥
