आत्मार्थे न प्रपाल्या हि सदा नरकभीरुभिः ॥49॥।
4.161.m: One desirous of giving should tend a cow about to calve within a month; / she should never be kept for oneself by those afraid of hell.

4.161.s:
kapilā'rdhaprasūtā ca dātavyā hi dvijanmane ..
jāyamānasya vatsasya mukhaṃ yonyāṃ pradṛśyate .. 4.161.50 ..
4.161.d:
कपिलाऽर्धप्रसूता च दातव्या हि द्विजन्मने ॥
जायमानस्य वत्सस्य मुखं योन्यां प्रदृश्यते ॥ 4.161.50 ॥
4.161.m: A tawny cow half-delivered should indeed be given to a twice-born. / When the face of the calf being born is seen in the vulva,

4.161.s: tāvatsā pṛthivī jñeyā yāvadgarbhaṃ na muṃcati .. .. 51 ..
4.161.d: तावत्सा पृथिवी ज्ञेया यावद्गर्भं न मुंचति ॥ ॥ 51 ॥
4.161.m: She is to be considered the earth so long as she does not discharge the fetus.

4.161.s:
dhenoryāvaṃti romāṇi savatsāyā vasundhare ..
bhūmyāṃ tu pāṃsavo yāvadyāvannakṣatratārakāḥ .. 52 ..
4.161.d:
धेनोर्यावंति रोमाणि सवत्साया वसुन्धरे ॥
भूम्यां तु पांसवो यावद्यावन्नक्षत्रतारकाः ॥ 52 ॥
4.161.m: As many hairs as there are on the milch cow with her calf, O Earth, / and as many specks of dust as there are on the ground, and as many as the stars and asterisms,

4.161.s:
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi brahmeśādibhirarcitaḥ ..
brahmaloke nivasati yaścaikakapilāpradaḥ .. 53 ..
4.161.d:
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि ब्रह्मेशादिभिरर्चितः ॥
ब्रह्मलोके निवसति यश्चैककपिलाप्रदः ॥ 53 ॥
4.161.m: For that many thousands of years does the giver of a single tawny cow / dwell in the world of Brahmā, worshipped by Brahmā, Īśa, and the others.

4.161.s:
suvarṇaśṛṅgīṃ yaḥ kṛtvā khurai raupyaiḥ samarcitām ..
brāhmaṇasya kare dattvā suvarṇaṃ raupyameva ca .. 54 ..
4.161.d:
सुवर्णशृङ्गीं यः कृत्वा खुरै रौप्यैः समर्चिताम् ॥
ब्राह्मणस्य करे दत्त्वा सुवर्णं रौप्यमेव च ॥ 54 ॥
4.161.m: One who makes [her] golden-horned, adorned with silver hooves, / placing gold and silver in the hand of the Brāhmaṇa,

4.161.s:
kapilāyāstadā putraṃ brāhmaṇasya kare nyaset ..
udakaṃ ca kare dattvā vācayeta svaśaktitaḥ .. 55 ..
4.161.d:
कपिलायास्तदा पुत्रं ब्राह्मणस्य करे न्यसेत् ॥
उदकं च करे दत्त्वा वाचयेत स्वशक्तितः ॥ 55 ॥
4.161.m: Should then place the son of the tawny cow in the hand of the Brāhmaṇa. / And having given water in his hand, he should recite [the formula] according to his ability.

4.161.s:
suvarṇaistu caturbhiśca tribhirdvābhyāmathāpi vā ..
ekahīnā na dātavyā yadīcchecchubhamātmanaḥ .. 56 ..
4.161.d:
सुवर्णैस्तु चतुर्भिश्च त्रिभिर्द्वाभ्यामथापि वा ॥
एकहीना न दातव्या यदीच्छेच्छुभमात्मनः ॥ 56 ॥
4.161.m: With four suvarṇas [of gold], or three, or even two; / it should not be given deficient by one, if one desires his own welfare.

4.161.s:
sa samudravanopetā saśailavanakānanā ..
ratnapūrṇā bhaveddattā pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 57 ..
4.161.d:
स समुद्रवनोपेता सशैलवनकानना ॥
रत्नपूर्णा भवेद्दत्ता पृथिवी नात्र संशयः ॥ 57 ॥
4.161.m: The earth with its oceans and forests, with its mountains and woodlands, / full of jewels, is given; of this there is no doubt.

4.161.s:
pṛthivīdānatulyena dānenaitena vai naraḥ ..
tārito yāti pitṛbhirvaiṣṇavaṃ yatpadaṃ param .. 58 ..
4.161.d:
पृथिवीदानतुल्येन दानेनैतेन वै नरः ॥
तारितो याति पितृभिर्वैष्णवं यत्पदं परम् ॥ 58 ॥
4.161.m: By this gift, equal to the gift of the earth, a man indeed, / rescued together with his ancestors, goes to the supreme abode of Viṣṇu.

4.161.s:
brahmasvaharaṇo goghno bhrūṇahā brahmaghātakaḥ ..
pāpakṛccobhayamukhīṃ dadyātsatkanakānvitām ..
taddinaṃ ca payobhojī saṃyataścātivāhayet .. 59 ..
4.161.d:
ब्रह्मस्वहरणो गोघ्नो भ्रूणहा ब्रह्मघातकः ॥
पापकृच्चोभयमुखीं दद्यात्सत्कनकान्विताम् ॥
तद्दिनं च पयोभोजी संयतश्चातिवाहयेत् ॥ 59 ॥
4.161.m: A thief of Brāhmaṇa's property, a cow-killer, a destroyer of an embryo, a killer of a Brāhmaṇa, / or an evildoer should give a cow with faces on both ends, adorned with fine gold; / and on that day, subsisting on milk and restrained, he should pass the time.

4.161.s:
gomayenopalipyātha maṇḍalaṃ vidhipūrvakam ..
svaśākhoktena maṃtreṇa homayettu vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 4.161.60 ..
4.161.d:
गोमयेनोपलिप्याथ मण्डलं विधिपूर्वकम् ॥
स्वशाखोक्तेन मंत्रेण होमयेत्तु विचक्षणः ॥ 4.161.60 ॥
4.161.m: Then, having smeared a circle with cow dung according to rule, / the wise one should perform an oblation with the mantra taught in his own school.

4.161.s:
vyāhṛtyā homayetpūrvaṃ paṃcavāruṇakaṃ tathā ..
irāvatī dhenumatī devasya tveti vā punaḥ .. 61 ..
4.161.d:
व्याहृत्या होमयेत्पूर्वं पंचवारुणकं तथा ॥
इरावती धेनुमती देवस्य त्वेति वा पुनः ॥ 61 ॥
4.161.m: He should first offer oblations with the vyāhṛtis, and likewise the five Vāruṇa [mantras], / or again with 'Irāvatī dhenumatī...' and 'Devasya tvā...'.

4.161.s:
syonā pṛthivi maṃtreṇa gaurvatsasahitā navā ..
nikāmaphaladā dhenuḥ sā syātsurabhinaṃdinī .. 62 ..
4.161.d:
स्योना पृथिवि मंत्रेण गौर्वत्ससहिता नवा ॥
निकामफलदा धेनुः सा स्यात्सुरभिनंदिनी ॥ 62 ॥
4.161.m: With the mantra 'Syonā pṛthivi...', a new cow together with her calf, / yielding all desired fruits, becomes a daughter of Surabhi.

4.161.s:
yā te sarasvatī devī viṣṇunā ca tathā mahī ..
gaurī viṣṇupadaṃ coktvā śāṃtikarmaṇi vācayet .. 63 ..
4.161.d:
या ते सरस्वती देवी विष्णुना च तथा मही ॥
गौरी विष्णुपदं चोक्त्वा शांतिकर्मणि वाचयेत् ॥ 63 ॥
4.161.m: Having recited 'Yā te sarasvatī devī...' and likewise the Earth with Viṣṇu, / 'Gaurī', and the abode of Viṣṇu, he should cause [them] to be recited in the rite of pacification.

4.161.s:
yāvadvatsasyadvau pādau śiraścaiva pradṛśyate ..
tāvadvai pṛthivī jñeyā yāvadgarbhaṃ na muñcati ..
tasminkāle pradātavyā brāhmaṇāya vasuṃdhare .. 64 ..
4.161.d:
यावद्वत्सस्यद्वौ पादौ शिरश्चैव प्रदृश्यते ॥
तावद्वै पृथिवी ज्ञेया यावद्गर्भं न मुञ्चति ॥
तस्मिन्काले प्रदातव्या ब्राह्मणाय वसुंधरे ॥ 64 ॥
4.161.m: As long as the two feet and the head of the calf are seen, / so long she is indeed to be considered the earth, as long as she does not discharge the fetus; / at that time she should be given to a Brāhmaṇa, O Earth!

4.161.s:
suvarṇaśṛṃgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ kāsyadohāṃ satāmrakām ..
savastraghaṃṭābharaṇāṃ gaṃdhapuṣpairalaṃkṛtām ..
vastrākṣataiḥ samabhyarcya brāhmaṇāya samarpayet 65 ..
4.161.d:
सुवर्णशृंगीं रौप्यखुरां कास्यदोहां सताम्रकाम् ॥
सवस्त्रघंटाभरणां गंधपुष्पैरलंकृताम् ॥
वस्त्राक्षतैः समभ्यर्च्य ब्राह्मणाय समर्पयेत् 65 ॥
4.161.m: With golden horns, silver hooves, a bronze milking vessel, accompanied by copper, / equipped with garments, bells, and ornaments, adorned with perfumes and flowers, / having worshipped her with cloths and unbroken rice grains, he should present her to a Brāhmaṇa,

4.161.s:
suvarṇasya sahasreṇa tadardhenāpi bhāmini ..
tasyāpyardhena śaktyā'tha tasyāpyarddhena vā punaḥ .. .. 66 ..
4.161.d:
सुवर्णस्य सहस्रेण तदर्धेनापि भामिनि ॥
तस्याप्यर्धेन शक्त्याऽथ तस्याप्यर्द्धेन वा पुनः ॥ ॥ 66 ॥
4.161.m: With a thousand [measures] of gold, or even half of that, O spirited lady, / or half of that according to ability, or again half of that,

4.161.s:
yathā śaktyā pradātavyā vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaiḥ ..
kare dattvā suvarṇaṃ ca athavā rūpyameva ca ..
gṛhāṇemāṃ mahādhenuṃ bhava bhrātā mamāśu vai ..
sarvapāpakṣayaṃ kṛtvā sadā svastikaro bhava ..68..
4.161.d:
यथा शक्त्या प्रदातव्या वित्तशाठ्यविवर्जितैः ॥
करे दत्त्वा सुवर्णं च अथवा रूप्यमेव च ॥
गृहाणेमां महाधेनुं भव भ्राता ममाशु वै ॥
सर्वपापक्षयं कृत्वा सदा स्वस्तिकरो भव ॥68॥
4.161.m: It should be given according to capacity by those free from dishonesty regarding wealth. / Placing gold or silver in his hand, [one should say:] / 'Accept this great milch cow; become at once my brother indeed! / Having destroyed all sins, always bring welfare!'

4.161.s:
irāvatī dhenumatī jāhnavī tadanantaram ..
pratidāsyāmi te dhenuṃ kuṭumbārthe viśeṣataḥ ..69..
4.161.d:
इरावती धेनुमती जाह्नवी तदनन्तरम् ॥
प्रतिदास्यामि ते धेनुं कुटुम्बार्थे विशेषतः ॥69॥
4.161.m: 'Irāvatī, Dhenumatī, and then Jāhnavī— / I will give the cow back to you, especially for the sake of your family.'

4.161.s:
bhavatātsvasti me nityaṃ sukhaṃ cānuttamaṃ tathā ..
dattā tu pṛthivī devī tvayeyaṃ pratigṛhyatām ..4.161.70..
4.161.d:
भवतात्स्वस्ति मे नित्यं सुखं चानुत्तमं तथा ॥
दत्ता तु पृथिवी देवी त्वयेयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॥4.161.70॥
4.161.m: 'May there always be welfare for me, and likewise unsurpassed happiness! / This goddess Earth has been given; let her be accepted by you.'

4.161.s:
ko'dāditi ca vai maṃtro japitavyo dvijena ca ...
visṛjya brāhmaṇaṃ so'pi tāṃ dhenuṃ svagṛhaṃ nayet .. 71 ..
4.161.d:
कोऽदादिति च वै मंत्रो जपितव्यो द्विजेन च ॥।
विसृज्य ब्राह्मणं सोऽपि तां धेनुं स्वगृहं नयेत् ॥ 71 ॥
4.161.m: And the mantra 'Who gave?' should indeed be recited by the twice-born; / having taken leave of the brāhmaṇa, he too should lead that cow to his home.

4.161.s:
evaṃ prasūyamānāṃ gāṃ yo dadāti vasundhare ..
sā samudravanopetā saśailavanakānanā ..
ratnapūrṇā bhaveddattā pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 72 ..
4.161.d:
एवं प्रसूयमानां गां यो ददाति वसुन्धरे ॥
सा समुद्रवनोपेता सशैलवनकानना ॥
रत्नपूर्णा भवेद्दत्ता पृथिवी नात्र संशयः ॥ 72 ॥
4.161.m: Whoever gives a cow while it is giving birth in this manner, O Earth, / by him the earth, with its oceans and groves, with its mountains, forests, and woods, / filled with jewels, has been given—there is no doubt about this.

4.161.s:
prataptajāṃbūnadatulyavarṇāṃ mahānitaṃbāṃ tanuvṛttamadhyām ..
arddhaprasūtāṃ dvimukhīṃ suśīlāṃ sevantyajasraṃ kapilāṃ hi devāḥ .. 73 ..
4.161.d:
प्रतप्तजांबूनदतुल्यवर्णां महानितंबां तनुवृत्तमध्याम् ॥
अर्द्धप्रसूतां द्विमुखीं सुशीलां सेवन्त्यजस्रं कपिलां हि देवाः ॥ 73 ॥
4.161.m: With a complexion resembling molten gold, broad hips, and a slender, rounded waist, / half-calved, two-faced, and gentle-natured—the gods ever attend upon such a Kapila cow.

4.161.s:
prātarutthāya yo bhaktyā dhenukalpaṃ naro bhuvi ..
jitendriyaḥ śucirbhūtvā paṭhedbhaktyā samanvitaḥ .. 74 ..
4.161.d:
प्रातरुत्थाय यो भक्त्या धेनुकल्पं नरो भुवि ॥
जितेन्द्रियः शुचिर्भूत्वा पठेद्भक्त्या समन्वितः ॥ 74 ॥
4.161.m: Having risen in the morning, whichever man on earth with devotion, / self-controlled and purified, recites the ritual manual of the cow endowed with devotion,

4.161.s:
trikālaṃ paṭhate yastu pāpaṃ varṣaśatodbhavam ..
naśyatyekakṣaṇādeva vāyunā pāṃsavo yathā .. 75 ..
4.161.d:
त्रिकालं पठते यस्तु पापं वर्षशतोद्भवम् ॥
नश्यत्येकक्षणादेव वायुना पांसवो यथा ॥ 75 ॥
4.161.m: Whoever recites it at the three junctures of the day, his sin arising from a hundred years / is destroyed in an instant, just as dust by the wind.

4.161.s:
śrāddhakāle paṭhedyastu idaṃ pāvanamuttamam ..
tasyānnaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ tadvai pitaro'śnaṃti dhīmataḥ .. 76 ..
4.161.d:
श्राद्धकाले पठेद्यस्तु इदं पावनमुत्तमम् ॥
तस्यान्नं संस्कृतं तद्वै पितरोऽश्नंति धीमतः ॥ 76 ॥
4.161.m: Whoever recites this supreme purifying [text] at the time of an ancestral rite, / his ancestors indeed consume that food of the wise man properly consecrated.

4.161.s:
amāvāsyāṃ ca yo vidvāndvijānāmagrataḥ paṭhet ..
pitarastasya tuṣyaṃti varṣāṇāṃ śatameva ca .. 77 ..
4.161.d:
अमावास्यां च यो विद्वान्द्विजानामग्रतः पठेत् ॥
पितरस्तस्य तुष्यंति वर्षाणां शतमेव च ॥ 77 ॥
4.161.m: And whichever learned man recites it on the new-moon day before twice-born men, / his ancestors are pleased for a full hundred years.

4.161.s:
yaścaitatchṛṇuyātpuṇyaṃ tadgatenāṃtarātmanā ..
saṃvatsarakṛtātpāpāttatkṣaṇādeva mucyate .. 78..
4.161.d:
यश्चैतत्छृणुयात्पुण्यं तद्गतेनांतरात्मना ॥
संवत्सरकृतात्पापात्तत्क्षणादेव मुच्यते ॥ 78॥
4.161.m: And whoever listens to this sacred [manual] with a concentrated inner self / is freed instantly from the sin committed throughout a year.

4.161.s:
idaṃ rahasyaṃ rājendra varāhamukhanirgatam..
dharaṇyai kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 79 ..
mahiṣīdānavratavidhivarṇanam
4.161.d:
इदं रहस्यं राजेन्द्र वराहमुखनिर्गतम्॥
धरण्यै कथितं पूर्वं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥ 79 ॥
महिषीदानव्रतविधिवर्णनम्
4.161.m:
This secret, O king of kings, issued from the mouth of the Boar, / was told to the Earth of old, destroying all sins.
Description of the procedure for the observance of the gift of a female buffalo.

4.162.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
mahiṣīdānamāhātmyaṃ kathayāmi yudhiṣṭhira ..
puṇyaṃ pāpavināśaṃ ca āyuṣyaṃ sarvakāmadam .. 1 ..
4.162.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
महिषीदानमाहात्म्यं कथयामि युधिष्ठिर ॥
पुण्यं पापविनाशं च आयुष्यं सर्वकामदम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.162.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / I shall describe the greatness of the gift of a female buffalo, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / which is meritorious, destroys sins, bestows longevity, and grants all desires.

4.162.s:
candrasūryagrahe puṇye kārttikyāmayane tathā ..
śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ sūryasaṃkrāntivāsare .. 2 ..
4.162.d:
चन्द्रसूर्यग्रहे पुण्ये कार्त्तिक्यामयने तथा ॥
शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां सूर्यसंक्रान्तिवासरे ॥ 2 ॥
4.162.m: At an eclipse of the moon or the sun, on the holy full moon of Kārttika, on a solstice, / on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight, on the day of the sun's transit,

4.162.s:
yadā vā jāyate cittaṃ vittaṃ ca kurunandana ..
tadaiva deyā mahiṣī saṃsārabhayabhīruṇā .. 3 ..
4.162.d:
यदा वा जायते चित्तं वित्तं च कुरुनन्दन ॥
तदैव देया महिषी संसारभयभीरुणा ॥ 3 ॥
4.162.m: Or whenever the inclination arises and wealth is present, O descendant of Kuru, / then indeed should a female buffalo be given by one fearful of the terrors of worldly existence.

4.162.s:
supayodharaśobhāḍhyā suśṛṃgī sukhurā tathā ..
prathamaprasūtā taruṇī suśīlā doṣavarjitā .. 4 ..
4.162.d:
सुपयोधरशोभाढ्या सुशृंगी सुखुरा तथा ॥
प्रथमप्रसूता तरुणी सुशीला दोषवर्जिता ॥ 4 ॥
4.162.m: Possessing the beauty of good udders, having fine horns and fine hooves, / having given birth for the first time, young, gentle-natured, and free from defects;

4.162.s:
suvarṇaśṛṅgatilakā ghaṃṭābharaṇabhūṣitā ..
raktavastrāvṛtā ramyā kāṃsyadohanakānvitā .. 5 ..
4.162.d:
सुवर्णशृङ्गतिलका घंटाभरणभूषिता ॥
रक्तवस्त्रावृता रम्या कांस्यदोहनकान्विता ॥ 5 ॥
4.162.m: Marked with a golden mark on her forehead between the horns, adorned with bells as ornaments, / covered with red cloth, beautiful, accompanied by a bell-metal milking pail;

4.162.s:
piṇyākapiṭikopetā sahiraṇyā ca śaktitaḥ ..
saptadhānyayutā deyā brāhmaṇe vedapārage .. 6 ..
4.162.d:
पिण्याकपिटिकोपेता सहिरण्या च शक्तितः ॥
सप्तधान्ययुता देया ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे ॥ 6 ॥
4.162.m: Provided with a small basket of oil-cake, together with gold according to one's means, / accompanied by the seven grains, she should be given to a brāhmaṇa who has mastered the Vedas,

4.162.s:
purāṇapāṭhake tadvajjyotiḥśāstravide tathā ..
deyā na vedarahite na ca kuvratine kvacit .. 7 ..
4.162.d:
पुराणपाठके तद्वज्ज्योतिःशास्त्रविदे तथा ॥
देया न वेदरहिते न च कुव्रतिने क्वचित् ॥ 7 ॥
4.162.m: Or likewise to a reciter of the Purāṇas, or to one knowledgeable in astrology; / she should never be given to one devoid of Vedic knowledge, nor ever to one following bad observances.

4.162.s:
dravyairebhiḥ samāyuktāṃ puṇye'hni vidhipūrvakam ..
dadyānmaṃtreṇa rājendra purāṇapaṭhitena tu .. 8 ..
4.162.d:
द्रव्यैरेभिः समायुक्तां पुण्येऽह्नि विधिपूर्वकम् ॥
दद्यान्मंत्रेण राजेन्द्र पुराणपठितेन तु ॥ 8 ॥
4.162.m: Endowed with these articles, on an auspicious day according to the prescribed rules, / one should present her, O king of kings, with the mantra recited in the Purāṇa:

4.162.s:
indrādilokapālānāṃ yā rājamahiṣī śubhā ..
mahiṣī dānamāhātmyātsāstu me sarvakāmadā .. 9 ..
4.162.d:
इन्द्रादिलोकपालानां या राजमहिषी शुभा ॥
महिषी दानमाहात्म्यात्सास्तु मे सर्वकामदा ॥ 9 ॥
4.162.m: 'She who is the auspicious chief queen among the world protectors beginning with Indra, / may she, through the greatness of the gift of a buffalo cow, grant all my desires.

4.162.s:
dharmarājasya sāhāyye yasyāḥ putraḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
mahiṣāsurasya jananī yā sāstu varadā mama ..4.162.10.. (iti dānamaṃtraḥ)
4.162.d:
धर्मराजस्य साहाय्ये यस्याः पुत्रः प्रतिष्ठितः ॥
महिषासुरस्य जननी या सास्तु वरदा मम ॥4.162.10॥ (इति दानमंत्रः)
4.162.m: Whose son is established to aid the King of Dharma, / she who is the mother of Mahiṣāsura, may she grant me boons.' (Thus the formula of donation.)

4.162.s:
dadyātpradakṣiṇīkṛtya brāhmaṇe tāṃ payasvinīm..
pratigrahaḥ smṛtastasyāḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe svayaṃbhuvā..11..
4.162.d:
दद्यात्प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य ब्राह्मणे तां पयस्विनीम्॥
प्रतिग्रहः स्मृतस्तस्याः पृष्ठदेशे स्वयंभुवा॥11॥
4.162.m: Having circumambulated her, one should give that milch cow to the brāhmaṇa; / her acceptance was decreed by the Self-born to be on her back.

4.162.s:
evaṃ dattvā vidhānena brāhmaṇasya gṛhaṃ nayet ..
vastrairābharaṇaiḥ pūjya bhaktyā ca kurunandana .. 12 ..
4.162.d:
एवं दत्त्वा विधानेन ब्राह्मणस्य गृहं नयेत् ॥
वस्त्रैराभरणैः पूज्य भक्त्या च कुरुनन्दन ॥ 12 ॥
4.162.m: Having thus given [her] according to the ritual, he should lead her to the brāhmaṇa's house, / having honoured him with garments and ornaments, and with devotion, O descendant of Kuru, [saying:]

4.162.s: saṃpāditā mayā tubhyaṃ saṃtuṣṭo me bhava dvija .. 13 ..
4.162.d: संपादिता मया तुभ्यं संतुष्टो मे भव द्विज ॥ 13 ॥
4.162.m: 'She has been procured by me for you; be pleased with me, O twice-born!'

4.162.s:
anena vidhinā dattvā mahiṣīṃ dvijapuṅgave ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti iha loke paratra ca .. 14 ..
4.162.d:
अनेन विधिना दत्त्वा महिषीं द्विजपुङ्गवे ॥
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति इह लोके परत्र च ॥ 14 ॥
4.162.m: Having given a female buffalo to an eminent twice-born man by this procedure, / he attains all desires in this world and in the next.

4.162.s:
yā sā dadāti mahiṣīṃ sā rājamahiṣī bhavet ..
mahārājaḥ pumānrājanvyāsasya vacanaṃ yathā .. 15 ..
4.162.d:
या सा ददाति महिषीं सा राजमहिषी भवेत् ॥
महाराजः पुमान्राजन्व्यासस्य वचनं यथा ॥ 15 ॥
4.162.m: Whichever woman gives a female buffalo, she becomes a king's chief queen; / a man becomes an emperor, O king, according to the word of Vyāsa.

4.162.s:
yajñayājī bhavedvipraḥ kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet ..
bhavedvaiśyastu dhanavāñchūdraḥ sarvārthasaṃyutaḥ .. 16 ..
4.162.d:
यज्ञयाजी भवेद्विप्रः क्षत्रियो विजयी भवेत् ॥
भवेद्वैश्यस्तु धनवाञ्छूद्रः सर्वार्थसंयुतः ॥ 16 ॥
4.162.m: A vipra becomes a performer of Vedic sacrifices; a kṣatriya becomes victorious; / a vaiśya becomes wealthy; and a śūdra becomes endowed with all riches.

4.162.s:
tasmānnareṇa dātavyā mahiṣī vibhave sati ..
putrapautraprapautrārthamātmanaḥ śubhamicchatā .. 17 ..
4.162.d:
तस्मान्नरेण दातव्या महिषी विभवे सति ॥
पुत्रपौत्रप्रपौत्रार्थमात्मनः शुभमिच्छता ॥ 17 ॥
4.162.m: Therefore, when wealth is available, a female buffalo should be given by a man / who desires good fortune for himself and for his sons, grandsons, and great-grandsons.

4.162.s:
daśadhenusamāṃ rājanmahiṣīṃ nārado'bravīt ..
viṃśatigosamāṃ vyāsaḥ sarvadānottamaṃ raviḥ .. 18 ..
4.162.d:
दशधेनुसमां राजन्महिषीं नारदोऽब्रवीत् ॥
विंशतिगोसमां व्यासः सर्वदानोत्तमं रविः ॥ 18 ॥
4.162.m: Nārada declared a female buffalo to be equal to ten cows, O king; / Vyāsa [declared her] equal to twenty cows; the Sun declared it the highest of all gifts.

4.162.s:
sagareṇa kakutsthena dhuṃdhumāreṇa gādhinā ..
dattāḥ saṃpūjya viprebhyo mahiṣyaḥ sarvakāmadāḥ .. 19 ..
4.162.d:
सगरेण ककुत्स्थेन धुंधुमारेण गाधिना ॥
दत्ताः संपूज्य विप्रेभ्यो महिष्यः सर्वकामदाः ॥ 19 ॥
4.162.m: By Sagara, by Kakutstha, by Dhundhumāra, by Gādhi, / female buffaloes fulfilling all desires were given to vipras after honouring them.

4.162.s:
mahiṣī dānamāhātmyaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti sadā naraḥ ..
sa sarvapāpanirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate .. 4.162.20 ..
4.162.d:
महिषी दानमाहात्म्यं यः शृणोति सदा नरः ॥
स सर्वपापनिर्मुक्तः शिवलोके महीयते ॥ 4.162.20 ॥
4.162.m: Whichever man constantly hears the greatness of the gift of a female buffalo, / freed from all sins, he is glorified in the world of Śiva.

4.162.s:
dugdhādhikāṃ hi mahiṣīṃ jalameghavarṇāṃ sapuṣṭapaṭṭakavatīṃ jaghanābhirāmām ..
dattvā suvarṇatilakāṃ dvijapuṃgavāya lokadvayaṃ vijayate kimu tatra citram .. 21 ..
avidānavratavidhivarṇanam
4.162.d:
दुग्धाधिकां हि महिषीं जलमेघवर्णां सपुष्टपट्टकवतीं जघनाभिरामाम् ॥
दत्त्वा सुवर्णतिलकां द्विजपुंगवाय लोकद्वयं विजयते किमु तत्र चित्रम् ॥ 21 ॥
अविदानव्रतविधिवर्णनम्
4.162.m:
Having given an abundant producer of milk, having the colour of a raincloud, / possessed of robust flanks and pleasing hips, bearing a golden forehead mark, to an eminent twice-born man, / he conquers both worlds; what wonder is there in that?
Description of the procedure for the observance of the gift of a female sheep.
